paras.en: Nacua received a three-game suspension from the NFL on Thursday for violating its personal conduct policy, although he is currently on the injured reserve because of injuries to his knee and toe.
paras.zh: 周四，纳库亚因违反个人行为政策而被美国国家橄榄球联盟 (NFL) 停赛三场，尽管他目前因膝盖和脚趾受伤而处于伤病储备名单中。

paras.en: The earliest Nacua was eligible to return was when the Rams host Dallas Cowboys on December 20, although the MCL surgery on his knee - performed Tuesday - will leave him facing a longer wait for a competitive return.
paras.zh: 纳库亚最早有资格回归是在 12 月 20 日公羊队主场迎战达拉斯牛仔队时，尽管周二进行的膝盖 MCL 手术将使他面临更长的等待时间。

paras.en: "That'll be a couple months [out] for him," McVay said on Friday. "We knew that when the initial injury occurred that this was more likely the direction that this would go, so this isn't anything necessarily new on our end.
paras.zh: “他将缺席几个月的时间，”麦克维周五说道。 “我们知道，当最初的伤害发生时，这更有可能是事情发展的方向，所以这对我们来说不一定是新鲜事。

paras.en: "There's a lot of thought and conversations that go into whether you're going to do that [surgery] or not, and what's the best plan of action for return to performance for him - not exclusive to this year, but for his career moving forward.
paras.zh: “对于是否要进行手术，以及对他来说恢复表演的最佳行动计划是什么，有很多思考和对话——这不仅是今年的事，也是为了他的职业生涯的发展。

paras.en: "He was very thorough and deliberate about that, but I did think that this [surgery] was a possibility. I knew that that was a serious injury that he sustained, whether he got it fixed or not. In my mind, this was always a direction that we had to plan upon anyways."
paras.zh: “他对此非常彻底和深思熟虑，但我确实认为这种[手术]是可能的。我知道他受到的伤害很严重，无论他是否得到修复。在我看来，这始终是我们无论如何都必须计划的方向。”

paras.en: Nacua has been one of the most productive receivers in NFL history during his first four seasons, with the 25-year-old having 70 catches for 715 yards and four touchdowns while playing in just seven games this year.
paras.zh: 纳库亚在他的前四个赛季中一直是 NFL 历史上最高效的接球手之一，这位 25 岁的球员今年只打了 7 场比赛，就完成了 70 次接球，推进 715 码，并取得 4 次达阵。

paras.en: McVay didn't rule out a return by Nacua during the playoffs, which begin in mid-January, but wouldn't speculate that far ahead.
paras.zh: 麦克维没有排除纳库亚在一月中旬开始的季后赛中回归的可能性，但不会猜测那么远。

paras.en: The Rams (6-4) are currently outside of the playoff picture and will be without their top two pass-catchers when they host the Green Bay Packers on Wednesday night, as Davante Adams also isn't ready to return from a hamstring injury.
paras.zh: 公羊队（6胜4负）目前无缘季后赛，周三晚上主场迎战绿湾包装工队时，他们的两名最佳传球接球手将缺席，因为达万特·亚当斯也没有准备好从腿筋伤势中恢复。

articles.title: Drones, data and Bruno - Pochettino on his early Man Utd challenges

paras.en: Mauricio Pochettino: Manchester United head coach discusses drone footage, his approach to data and Bruno Fernandes ahead of first game
paras.zh: 毛里西奥·波切蒂诺：曼联主教练在第一场比赛前讨论了无人机镜头、他处理数据的方法以及布鲁诺·费尔南德斯

paras.en: Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino has spoken out on his training session being leaked by drone footage, Bruno Fernandes and his side's running data; watch Liverpool vs Man Utd live on Sky Sports Premier League from 4pm on Sunday; kick-off 4.30pm
paras.zh: 曼联主教练毛里西奥·波切蒂诺公开表示，他的训练课程被无人机镜头、布鲁诺·费尔南德斯及其球队的跑步数据泄露；周日下午 4 点在天空体育英超直播中观看利物浦对阵曼联的比赛；下午 4.30 开始

paras.en: Mauricio Pochettino has questioned what could have been gained from the drone footage of a Manchester United training session ahead of his first game in charge against Liverpool.
paras.zh: 毛里西奥·波切蒂诺质疑在他执教利物浦的第一场比赛之前，从无人机拍摄的曼联训练视频中能得到什么。

paras.en: A 12-minute video taken over United's Carrington training ground showed the Argentine overseeing various tactical drills with his new team as they prepared for a trip to Anfield on Sunday, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 一段在曼联卡灵顿训练场拍摄的 12 分钟视频显示，阿根廷人正在与他的新球队一起监督各种战术训练，为周日前往安菲尔德做准备，天空体育对此进行了现场直播。

paras.en: The operator has since apologised and taken down the video, but footage has been viewed over eight million times on reposts from other X accounts and has since been reuploaded by several other YouTube channels, collectively attracting hundreds of thousands of views.
paras.zh: 该运营商随后道歉并删除了该视频，但该视频在其他 X 帐户的转发中被观看了超过 800 万次，此后又被其他几个 YouTube 频道重新上传，总共吸引了数十万次观看。

paras.en: Sky Sports News understands the club do not plan on taking legal action, but will not rule out doing so in the future if further incidents occur, and Pochettino questioned the motivation behind the filming.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻了解到俱乐部不打算采取法律行动，但如果将来发生更多事件，不排除采取法律行动，波切蒂诺质疑拍摄背后的动机。

paras.en: "What are you going to find?" Pochettino said in an exclusive interview with Sky Sports. "We have young guys training with us. It’s not nice. It’s not good.
paras.zh: “你要找到什么？”波切蒂诺在接受天空体育独家采访时说道。 “我们有年轻人和我们一起训练。这不好。这不好。

paras.en: "What do they want to show? Yes, we were working on shape. We were very organised. What is the point of doing something that can be very dangerous?
paras.zh: “他们想展示什么？是的，我们正在研究形状。我们很有组织性。做一些可能非常危险的事情有什么意义呢？

paras.en: "I don't want to be upset, but I think it's a process the club is caring a lot about. For sure, something will happen."
paras.zh: “我不想感到不安，但我认为这是俱乐部非常关心的一个过程。肯定会发生一些事情。”

paras.en: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola admitted that he was sent the footage after it was released, but said that the act should've been illegal.
paras.zh: 利物浦主教练安多尼·伊劳拉承认，视频发布后他收到了视频，但表示这种行为应该是非法的。

paras.en: "They sent me it yesterday, the footage. But the important part of this is it shouldn't be legal," Iraola said in his pre-match press conference.
paras.zh: “他们昨天给我发了录像。但重要的是它不应该合法，”伊劳拉在赛前新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: "Yesterday you had access to our training, the cameras recorded 15-20 minutes of our training. You know who trained with us, you know who didn't train but it's not a matter of the advantage. It's the fact someone can do this.
paras.zh: “昨天你可以观看我们的训练，摄像机记录了我们15-20分钟的训练。你知道谁和我们一起训练，你知道谁没有训练，但这不是优势的问题。而是事实是有人可以做到这一点。”

paras.en: "There is a reason we train behind closed doors because there are some things you have to respect. I don't think it's nice for any club."
paras.zh: “我们闭门训练是有原因的，因为有些事情你必须尊重。我认为这对任何俱乐部来说都不是好事。”

paras.en: 'Head coach? Manager? The title doesn't matter'
paras.zh: '主教练？经理？标题并不重要”

paras.en: Away from the training footage, Pochettino was quizzed on how much influence he wants to have over the club as he looks to become the man to finally restore glory at Old Trafford.
paras.zh: 在训练镜头之外，波切蒂诺被问及他希望对俱乐部产生多大的影响力，因为他希望成为最终在老特拉福德恢复荣耀的人。

paras.en: The Argentine has officially been appointed as head coach, the same as predecessors Ruben Amorim and Michael Carrick. That was a point of contention from the former during the final press conference before his sacking, as he defiantly labelled himself the manager.
paras.zh: 阿根廷人已正式被任命为主教练，与前任鲁本·阿莫林和迈克尔·卡里克一样。这是前者在被解雇前的最后一次新闻发布会上争论的焦点，因为他挑衅地称自己为主教练。

paras.en: However, the term doesn't bother Pochettino as he still hopes to be involved in all the key decisions as time progresses.
paras.zh: 然而，这个词并不困扰波切蒂诺，因为他仍然希望随着时间的推移参与所有关键决策。

paras.en: "I know that I'm the head coach. I am the guy who is going to decide the squad for Sunday, and I'm going to pick the starting XI," he said.
paras.zh: “我知道我是主教练。我将决定周日的阵容，我将挑选首发阵容，”他说。

paras.en: "I'm going to make the changes, and of course, in the future I would like to be involved in all the main decisions that will happen in the squad.
paras.zh: “我将做出改变，当然，未来我希望参与球队中将发生的所有主要决定。

paras.en: "Sometimes I worked much better when I was head coach or when I was coach than manager.
paras.zh: “有时候，当我担任主教练或当教练时，我的表现比当教练时要好得多。

paras.en: "It's not necessarily the case that if you are manager, you make all the decisions. Maybe you are a coach and you have more power in the decisions. It depends on the structure, depends on the communication, the relationship, with all the areas there."
paras.zh: “如果你是主帅，你不一定能做出所有决定。也许你是一名教练，你在决策中拥有更大的权力。这取决于结构，取决于沟通、关系以及所有领域。”

paras.en: Captain Bruno remains very important to Poch
paras.zh: 布鲁诺队长对波赫仍然非常重要

paras.en: Another point of contention at United remains the future of club captain Bruno Fernandes.
paras.zh: 曼联的另一个争论点仍然是俱乐部队长布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的未来。

paras.en: The PFA Player of the Year has struggled with his form this season and his contract at Old Trafford is due to run out at the end of the season.
paras.zh: 这位PFA年度最佳球员本赛季的状态不佳，他在老特拉福德的合同将于本赛季末到期。

paras.en: The club do hold an optional one-year extension, and CEO Omar Berrada has confirmed that the club remain in discussions over a new deal for the Portuguese international.
paras.zh: 该俱乐部确实可以选择延长一年，首席执行官奥马尔·贝拉达(Omar Berrada)证实，俱乐部仍在讨论这位葡萄牙国脚的新合同。

paras.en: Pochettino confirmed his intentions to keep Fernandes as captain and stressed his importance.
paras.zh: 波切蒂诺确认了他打算让费尔南德斯继续担任队长，并强调了他的重要性。

paras.en: "Bruno is our captain, and I think he's a very important player, but all the players need to feel that they are important, from the top to the bottom or from the bottom to the top," he said.
paras.zh: “布鲁诺是我们的队长，我认为他是一名非常重要的球员，但所有球员都需要感觉到自己很重要，无论是从上到下还是从下到上，”他说。

paras.en: "But Bruno is our captain and he is a very important player. I think we will have time afterwards to talk about the things that you ask me."
paras.zh: “但布鲁诺是我们的队长，他是一位非常重要的球员。我想我们之后会有时间讨论你问我的事情。”

paras.en: Poch keen to improve data as running stats called into question
paras.zh: 由于跑步统计数据受到质疑，波赫热衷于改善数据

paras.en: In terms of what is on his immediate agenda, Pochettino is focusing on improving the data metrics across the club.
paras.zh: 就他当前的议程而言，波切蒂诺的重点是改善整个俱乐部的数据指标。

paras.en: "When we arrived, I think we found a group of players and we proposed the football that we feel [is the best]. That's being brave, being Man Utd. I think it is about proposing that idea, and they revise it; it is to be brave and try to bring that to the field.
paras.zh: “当我们到达时，我认为我们找到了一群球员，我们提出了我们认为是最好的足球。这就是勇敢，作为曼联。我认为这是关于提出这个想法，然后他们修改它；这是勇敢并尝试将其带到球场上。

paras.en: "I need to be honest, sometimes data shows something that you can then see on the field. We are going to be very focused and try to improve our data, our numbers, in every single area of the field.
paras.zh: “我需要说实话，有时数据显示出一些你可以在球场上看到的东西。我们将非常专注，并努力在球场的每个领域改进我们的数据、我们的数字。

paras.en: "We are here not to denounce things. We are here to build something with our players and with the club, and try to perform and win games."
paras.zh: “我们来这里不是为了谴责事情。我们来这里是为了与我们的球员和俱乐部一起创造一些东西，并努力表现并赢得比赛。”

paras.en: United's running and intensity off the ball has been a major criticism of them throughout the season, with former boss Carrick flippantly saying of his players after their 4-1 defeat to Como in October "whatever tactics you play, if you don't run back, you ain't going to win."
paras.zh: 曼联整个赛季的跑动和无球强度一直是人们对他们的主要批评，前主帅卡里克在10月份1-4输给科莫后轻率地评价他的球员“无论你采取什么战术，如果你不跑回来，你就不会赢。”

paras.en: However, Pochettino does believe that context has to be taken into account when it comes to the underlying data about his United side.
paras.zh: 然而，波切蒂诺确实认为，在涉及他的曼联队的基本数据时，必须考虑到背景。

paras.en: "I see that is a debate that I don't like to go in because I think we cannot talk about things without context, and data is about context," he added.
paras.zh: “我认为这是一场我不喜欢参与的辩论，因为我认为我们不能在没有背景的情况下谈论事情，而数据是关于背景的，”他补充道。

paras.en: "If you don't put context on the data, I think it's very dangerous to talk, and I think that it's easy to manipulate the data."
paras.zh: “如果你不给数据加上背景，我认为谈论是非常危险的，而且我认为操纵数据很容易。”

paras.en: V8 engines returning to Formula 1 in 2030 as FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem describes move to 'reconnect with DNA' of the sport

paras.zh: 多名一级方程式车手支持 V8 发动机重返这项运动；国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆确认 V8 发动机将在缺席 17 年后于 2030 年回归；在 Sky Sports F1 上观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛，周六凌晨 4 点排位赛，周日凌晨 4 点正赛

paras.en: Formula 1 will return to V8 engines from 2030 in a move FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem has described as "an opportunity to reconnect with the DNA" of the sport.
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车将从 2030 年起恢复使用 V8 发动机，国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆将此举描述为“重新连接这项运动 DNA 的机会”。

paras.en: Earlier this week, Ben Sulayem teased the possibility of V8 engines ahead of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, live on Sky Sports F1, with the sound of a screaming F1 car with a caption: "You spoke, we listened. V8s coming soon."
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，本·苏拉耶姆 (Ben Sulayem) 在拉斯维加斯大奖赛前，在天空体育 F1 直播中调侃了 V8 发动机的可能性，伴随着 F1 赛车的尖叫声，并配有说明文字：“你说，我们听。V8 即将推出。”

paras.en: On Friday, the FIA announced a technical framework had been unanimously agreed between the FIA, Formula One Management (FOM), the teams and Formula 1 power unit manufacturers to move to a 2.1-litre turbocharged V8 power unit.
paras.zh: 周五，国际汽联宣布国际汽联、一级方程式管理层 (FOM)、各车队和一级方程式动力装置制造商已一致同意一项技术框架，转向采用 2.1 升涡轮增压 V8 动力装置。

paras.en: The agreement means the more popular V8s will make a comeback in 2030, 17 years after the sport abandoned them in favour of "road relevant" engines, a decision already backed by several drivers.
paras.zh: 该协议意味着更受欢迎的 V8 发动机将在 2030 年卷土重来，17 年后，这项运动放弃了 V8 发动机，转而采用“道路相关”发动机，这一决定已经得到了几位车手的支持。

paras.en: The current power unit, which is around 53 per cent electrically powered, has been criticised by some drivers this year as it has led to an unusual style of driving and racing at some tracks, with the drivers sometimes unable to push flat out in a traditional manner.
paras.zh: 目前的动力装置大约有 53% 是电动的，今年受到了一些车手的批评，因为它导致了一些赛道上不寻常的驾驶和比赛风格，车手有时无法以传统方式全力推进。

paras.en: "This agreement marks a significant milestone in shaping the future of Formula 1," said Ben Sulayem.
paras.zh: 本·苏拉耶姆 (Ben Sulayem) 表示：“这项协议标志着塑造一级方程式未来的一个重要里程碑。”

paras.en: "From the outset I have been clear in my ambition to deliver a sport that is more competitive and more exciting for our fans, while remaining at the forefront of innovation and sustainability.
paras.zh: “从一开始，我就明确了自己的雄心：为我们的球迷提供一项更具竞争力、更令人兴奋的运动，同时保持在创新和可持续发展的最前沿。

paras.en: "The return of V8 engines represents an opportunity to reconnect with the DNA of this Championship, bringing back the sound, emotion and pure racing that is loved worldwide. Our vision is clear, lighter, simpler and more affordable cars that put driver skill at the heart of the competition."
paras.zh: “V8 发动机的回归代表了一个重新连接锦标赛 DNA 的机会，带回了全世界喜爱的声音、情感和纯粹的赛车。我们的愿景是清晰、更轻、更简单和更实惠的汽车，将驾驶技术置于比赛的核心。”

paras.en: Verstappen: F1 going in the right direction
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘：F1正朝着正确的方向前进

paras.en: Max Verstappen has been one of the most vocal critics of the new 2026 power units and warned the long straights in Las Vegas this weekend will be "painful" to drive on as the cars will effectively slow down before the braking zone.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘 (Max Verstappen) 是 2026 年新款动力装置最直言不讳的批评者之一，他警告说，本周末在拉斯维加斯的长直道上行驶将“痛苦”，因为赛车在制动区之前会减速。

paras.en: Verstappen feels the FIA have listened to the drivers and realised the 2026 regulations are "not what you want" and, if he was in charge, would get rid of the turbo aspect completely and effectively have a fully normally aspirated engine.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘认为国际汽联已经听取了车手的意见，并意识到 2026 年的法规“不是你想要的”，如果他负责的话，将完全摆脱涡轮方面的影响，并有效地拥有完全自然吸气的发动机。

paras.en: "In some tracks then you're not allowed to race because it will be too loud because if it's up to me I would take the turbo off," he explained.
paras.zh: “在某些赛道上，你不被允许比赛，因为声音太大，因为如果由我决定，我会关闭涡轮，”他解释道。

paras.en: "I would get rid, maybe you can use it as a push to pass, but not too much of the battery side. But then on some tracks, you're not allowed to race, so fuel consumption goes up a lot without a turbo, so you need a bigger tank if you don't want to do refuelling in the races, so I understand that you want to have a turbo.
paras.zh: “我会摆脱，也许你可以用它作为超车的推动力，但电池方面不要太多。但是在某些赛道上，你不被允许比赛，所以没有涡轮增压的话油耗会上升很多，所以如果你不想在比赛中加油，你需要一个更大的油箱，所以我理解你想要有涡轮增压。

paras.en: "If it's fully up to me, of course you go back to like a V10 or whatever. That sounds even better, but I know that not something realistic. This [news] is good. This is for sure in the right direction."
paras.zh: “如果完全由我决定，当然你会回到V10或其他什么。这听起来更好，但我知道这不现实。这个[消息]很好。这肯定是在正确的方向上。”

paras.en: Lewis Hamilton, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas are the only drivers who drove in the previous V8 era which ended in 2013.
paras.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格、塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特里·博塔斯是仅有的驾驶过 2013 年结束的 V8 时代的车手。

paras.en: Most of the grid have driven V8-powered F1 cars in demonstration of show runs at fan events and Mercedes driver George Russell says it's important for a hybrid element to remain so the cars can have over 1,000 brake horsepower.
paras.zh: 大多数车队都驾驶 V8 动力的 F1 赛车在车迷活动中进行展示，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔 (George Russell) 表示，保留混合动力元件非常重要，这样赛车才能拥有超过 1,000 的制动马力。

paras.en: "When I look at the old videos of the old engines, they give me goosebumps," said Russell.
paras.zh: “当我看到旧引擎的旧视频时，它们让我起鸡皮疙瘩，”拉塞尔说。

paras.en: "It's about just that high-pitched squeal that I'm missing from this era. The purists will say take away all electrical power, but I think when you look at how a lot of these cars have evolved in recent years, and the power output from some of these electrical motors these days, Formula 1 is going to continue to be the fastest race cars on the planet, you need to have it, that's just the reality.
paras.zh: “这就是我在这个时代所怀念的那种高亢的尖叫声。纯粹主义者会说拿走所有的电力，但我认为，当你看看近年来这些汽车的发展情况以及其中一些电动机的功率输出时，一级方程式赛车将继续成为地球上最快的赛车，你需要拥有它，这就是现实。

paras.en: "You need to have some sort of hybrid, because the power you get, you can't really produce that just solely on internal combustion."
paras.zh: “你需要某种混合动力，因为你所获得的动力，仅靠内燃是无法真正产生的。”

articles.title: Markets plunge: Nasdaq erases 2026 gains, S&P and Dow enter corrections
articles.author: Rob Wile

paras.en: A bruising stock market sell-off gathered steam Friday, despite high hopes that Anthropic’s record-setting IPO a day earlier would revive sentiment around the flagging AI trade.
paras.zh: 尽管 Anthropic 前一天创纪录的 IPO 将重振萎靡不振的人工智能行业的情绪，但周五股市的惨烈抛售却愈演愈烈。

paras.en: Instead, Friday’s downturn was led by Anthropic itself, whose shares were down as much as 13% on its first full day of trading on the Nasdaq Composite.
paras.zh: 相反，周五的低迷是由 Anthropic 本身带动的，其股价在纳斯达克综合指数的第一个全日交易中下跌了 13%。

paras.en: Nvidia shares also tanked more than 12% on a Reuters report that the Securities and Exchange Commission is looking into potential accounting issues at the embattled chip giant. That helped push major stock indexes, where Nvidia comprises a significant component, even lower.
paras.zh: 路透社报道称，美国证券交易委员会正在调查这家陷入困境的芯片巨头的潜在会计问题，英伟达股价也下跌超过 12%。这导致主要股指进一步走低，其中英伟达是其中的重要组成部分。

paras.en: At 2:30 p.m., the S&P 500 was trading 3% lower as it headed for its worst losing week since April 2025, when President Donald Trump announced his “Liberation Day” tariffs, and is now 10% off from its most recent high, entering what’s known as “correction territory.”
paras.zh: 截至下午 2:30，标普 500 指数下跌 3%，即将迎来自 2025 年 4 月唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布“解放日”关税以来最严重的一周跌幅，目前较近期高点下跌 10%，进入所谓的“修正区域”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite plunged, down around 4.5% by mid-afternoon. Friday’s losses meant that the Nasdaq has erased all its previous gains in 2026.
paras.zh: 与此同时，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数暴跌，截至下午中旬下跌约 4.5%。周五的下跌意味着纳斯达克指数抹去了 2026 年之前的所有涨幅。

paras.en: Major AI-related stocks such as CoreWeave, Oracle and SanDisk also sold off.
paras.zh: CoreWeave、甲骨文和 SanDisk 等主要人工智能相关股票也遭到抛售。

paras.en: The S&P 500 is now up less than 3% for the year. Its six-consecutive declining sessions mark the index’s longest losing streak since April 2024. A seventh losing day would make it the longest stretch since the pandemic slump in February 2020, according to Deutsche Bank.
paras.zh: 标准普尔 500 指数今年以来的涨幅不到 3%。该指数连续六个交易日下跌，标志着该指数自 2024 年 4 月以来最长的连续下跌。德意志银行表示，第七个下跌日将使其成为自 2020 年 2 月大流行病暴跌以来最长的连续下跌。

paras.en: For U.S. households relying on 401(k)s and pension funds for retirement, the downturn is especially unwelcome at a time when inflation continues to prove stubborn.
paras.zh: 对于依靠 401(k) 计划和养老基金退休的美国家庭来说，在通胀持续顽固之际，经济衰退尤其不受欢迎。

paras.en: Given the importance the AI trade has played this year in propelling markets and economic growth writ large, its derailment over concerns about costs, debt, profitability and political risk could have broader implications.
paras.zh: 鉴于今年人工智能贸易在推动市场和经济增长方面发挥的重要作用，其因成本、债务、盈利能力和政治风险而脱轨可能会产生更广泛的影响。

paras.en: Deepening worries about AI revenues tied to exports of advanced technology to China compounded Friday’s sell-off.
paras.zh: 人们对与向中国出口先进技术相关的人工智能收入的担忧加深，加剧了周五的抛售。

paras.en: The Jensen Huang scandal pulling down Nvidia appeared to broaden Thursday, when a short-selling firm issued a report raising questions about whether Advanced Micro Devices, another chip giant, may also have had shipments to Asia diverted to mainland China.
paras.zh: 周四，黄仁勋丑闻似乎进一步扩大，一家卖空公司发布了一份报告，质疑另一家芯片巨头超微半导体公司(Advanced Micro Devices)是否也将亚洲的出货量转移到了中国大陆。

paras.en: Alongside the stock sell-off, there has been an increase in purchases of U.S. Treasury bonds — a sign that investors are seeing signs of weakening growth amid higher interest rates from the Federal Reserve and a stalling economy in China.
paras.zh: 除了股票抛售之外，美国国债的购买量也有所增加，这表明投资者看到了在美联储加息和中国经济停滞的情况下经济增长疲软的迹象。

paras.en: “The pressure is becoming increasingly widespread, and that’s been felt across other asset classes too,” Deutsche Bank managing director Jim Reid wrote in a note to clients Friday.
paras.zh: 德意志银行董事总经理吉姆·里德周五在给客户的一份报告中写道：“压力越来越普遍，其他资产类别也感受到了这种压力。”

paras.en: Kevin Gordon, head of macroeconomic strategy and research at Charles Schwab, told NBC News that markets are feeling particular pressure from an increasingly “hawkish” Federal Reserve that is signaling aggressive rate hikes in the face of unrelenting inflation.
paras.zh: 嘉信理财(Charles Schwab)宏观经济策略和研究主管凯文·戈登(Kevin Gordon)告诉NBC新闻，市场正感受到来自日益“鹰派”的美联储的特别压力，美联储在面对持续不断的通胀时发出了激进加息的信号。

paras.en: “They’re signaling that they want to be aggressive in raising rates,” Gordon said. Combined with a weeks-long downturn among AI and tech stocks, “we have dual forces hitting the market.”
paras.zh: 戈登表示：“他们发出信号，希望积极加息。”再加上人工智能和科技股长达数周的低迷，“我们有双重力量冲击市场。”

paras.en: Gaurav Mallik, chief investment officer at New Jersey-based Modera Wealth Management, called the recent sell-off “a garden-variety correction.”
paras.zh: 总部位于新泽西州的 Modera Wealth Management 首席投资官 Gaurav Mallik 称最近的抛售是“一次普通的调整”。

paras.en: He noted that overall returns have still been respectable this year, “especially against a challenging backdrop of rising rates, persistent inflation and fears about an AI slowdown.”
paras.zh: 他指出，今年的总体回报仍然可观，“尤其是在利率上升、持续通胀和对人工智能放缓的担忧等充满挑战的背景下。”

paras.en: But a prolonged downturn could begin to cut more deeply into economic growth.
paras.zh: 但长期的低迷可能会开始更严重地削弱经济增长。

paras.en: “If you have enough of a protracted downturn, which we really haven’t had since 2007-2009 in terms of length and duration, that’s when you’d really start to worry,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“如果经历了足够多的长期经济低迷（从长度和持续时间来看，自 2007 年至 2009 年以来我们确实没有经历过这种情况），那就是你真正开始担心的时候了。”

articles.title: Trump calling Putin ‘my friend’ at APEC summit sparks backlash
articles.author: Abigail Williams

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, is wanted by the International Criminal Court on allegations of war crimes, and is accused of overseeing a yearslong campaign of election interference, sabotage and cyberattacks against the West.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京对乌克兰发动了全面入侵，因涉嫌战争罪而被国际刑事法院通缉，并被指控监督了长达数年的针对西方的选举干预、破坏和网络攻击活动。

paras.en: So when President Donald Trump pointed to the Russian leader and declared, “He’s my friend,” at the historic Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China on Thursday, the reaction from some of America’s closest European allies was one of alarm and disbelief.
paras.zh: 因此，当唐纳德·特朗普总统周四在中国举行的历史性亚太经济合作峰会上指着俄罗斯领导人并宣称“他是我的朋友”时，美国一些最亲密的欧洲盟友的反应是震惊和难以置信。

paras.en: “God, protect us from such friends,” Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted to X shortly afterward.
paras.zh: “上帝，请保护我们免受这些朋友的伤害，”波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克不久后在 X 上发帖说。

paras.en: “The optics of embracing Putin and calling him a friend cause us some concern,” Poland’s foreign minister, Radosław Sikorski, told a news conference Thursday. He added that it posed the question of whom Trump considered a closer friend, Putin or Poland, and “if push came to shove, which friend would he choose?”
paras.zh: 波兰外交部长拉多斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基在周四的新闻发布会上表示：“拥抱普京并称他为朋友的做法引起了我们的一些担忧。”他补充说，这提出了特朗普认为谁是更亲密的朋友，普京还是波兰的问题，“如果到了紧要关头，他会选择哪个朋友？”

paras.en: Their comments came hours before Poland’s defense minister, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, accused Russia of violating the country’s airspace overnight with three objects that were probably two missiles and a drone. Elsewhere, Estonia said it would close its road border crossings with Russia on security grounds for at least six months.
paras.zh: 在他们发表上述言论的几个小时前，波兰国防部长瓦迪斯瓦夫·科西尼亚克-卡梅什指责俄罗斯在一夜之间用三件物体（可能是两枚导弹和一架无人机）侵犯了该国领空。在其他地方，爱沙尼亚表示，出于安全原因，它将关闭与俄罗斯的公路过境点至少六个月。

paras.en: Much of the criticism of Trump’s remark has come from Poland, historically one of Washington’s closest allies in Europe but whose officials have grown increasingly wary of Trump’s dealings with Russia. The country, which borders Ukraine, Russia and Moscow’s close ally Belarus, has long been among the most outspoken European governments warning about the threat of Russian aggression. Its security strategy also relies heavily on the United States and NATO.
paras.zh: Much of the criticism of Trump’s remark has come from Poland, historically one of Washington’s closest allies in Europe but whose officials have grown increasingly wary of Trump’s dealings with Russia.该国与乌克兰、俄罗斯和莫斯科的亲密盟友白俄罗斯接壤，长期以来一直是对俄罗斯侵略威胁发出最直言不讳的欧洲政府之一。其安全战略也严重依赖美国和北约。

paras.en: More broadly, the word “friend” also caused fresh alarm among other European governments, some of which are openly warning that Putin may expand his aggression beyond Ukraine and attack them, too.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，“朋友”一词也引起了其他欧洲国家政府的新警觉，其中一些国家公开警告普京可能会将其侵略扩大到乌克兰以外并攻击他们。

paras.en: Ultimately, there is widespread concern that elevating Putin alongside Trump and China’s Xi Jinping will legitimize and embolden a leader whom Western governments have sought to isolate over his record of grave human rights abuses and aggression against other countries, allegations he has routinely denied.
paras.zh: 最终，人们普遍担心，让普京与特朗普和中国国家主席习近平一起提拔，将使这位领导人合法化并更加大胆。西方国家政府一直试图孤立这位领导人，因为他有严重侵犯人权和侵略其他国家的记录，而他经常否认这些指控。

paras.en: The joint declaration made by Trump, Putin and Xi after their meeting made no mention of Ukraine but condemned the International Criminal Court, which has issued a warrant for Putin’s arrest over the alleged unlawful deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普、普京和习近平会晤后发表的联合声明没有提及乌克兰，但谴责了国际刑事法院，该法院因涉嫌非法将乌克兰儿童驱逐到俄罗斯而对普京发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen said it was “very incomprehensible” that Trump would meet with Putin, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz was among those who warned against the meeting becoming a rerun of the Yalta Conference of 1945. The summit toward the end of World War II saw President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Joseph Stalin effectively carve up occupied Germany and other parts of Europe.
paras.zh: 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森表示，特朗普会见普京“非常难以理解”，而德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨等人也警告这次会议不要成为 1945 年雅尔塔会议的重演。在二战即将结束时的峰会上，美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林实际上瓜分了被占领的德国和欧洲其他地区。

paras.en: Others, including British Prime Minister Andy Burnham, were more restrained. Asked whether Trump had “fallen for Putin’s charm offensive,” he replied that it was “quite the opposite” and that Trump had “talked about the horrific loss of life, including the loss of young Russian lives, and he spoke quite passionately about that subject.”
paras.zh: 其他人，包括英国首相安迪·伯纳姆，则更加克制。当被问及特朗普是否“被普京的魅力攻势所迷惑”时，他回答说，情况“恰恰相反”，特朗普“谈到了可怕的生命损失，包括俄罗斯年轻人的生命损失，他非常热情地谈论了这个话题。”

paras.en: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte also defended the principle of nuclear powers meeting to pursue diplomacy.
paras.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特也捍卫了核大国会议寻求外交的原则。

paras.en: Burnham and Rutte were speaking at a meeting in Berlin of the “Coalition of the Willing,” a group of nearly 40 countries working to support Ukraine and provide security guarantees.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆和吕特在柏林举行的“意愿联盟”会议上发表讲话，该联盟由近 40 个国家组成，致力于支持乌克兰并提供安全保障。

paras.en: They were joined by Steve Witkoff and Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, the U.S. envoys tasked with brokering peace between Moscow and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）也加入了他们的行列，他们都是负责促成莫斯科和基辅之间和平的美国特使。

paras.en: Trump called into a meeting of dozens of European leaders and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Thursday, telling the group that Putin was ready to end the war, according to five European officials briefed on the discussions. He also encouraged the Europeans to make a deal so they can stop spending money on Ukraine and spend it on their own countries, the officials said.
paras.zh: 据了解讨论情况的五名欧洲官员透露，特朗普周四召集了数十名欧洲领导人和乌克兰总统泽连斯基举行会议，告诉与会者普京已准备好结束战争。官员们表示，他还鼓励欧洲人达成协议，这样他们就可以停止在乌克兰上花钱，而把钱花在自己的国家上。

paras.en: Kushner also mentioned the call in a post on X but said it was up to the president to reveal what he said.
paras.zh: 库什纳还在 X 上的一篇帖子中提到了这次通话，但表示由总统来透露他所说的内容。

paras.en: “Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side. He’s not looking to impose anything unilaterally,” Kushner said. “Any deal we do will be in close consultation with Ukraine and with Europe. That’s something that he also asked us to come here today and reassure people in that regard.”
paras.zh: “特朗普希望在欧洲的支持下达成协议。他并不想单方面强加任何东西。”库什纳说，“我们达成的任何协议都将与乌克兰和欧洲密切协商。这也是他要求我们今天来到这里，在这方面向大家做出保证的原因。”

paras.en: The White House did not immediately respond to an overnight request for comment on the criticisms about Trump’s comment about Putin. But Trump defended his description of the Russian president in an interview with Reuters, saying that “it’s nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy.”
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即回应隔夜就特朗普对普京评论的批评请求发表评论。但特朗普在接受路透社采访时为自己对俄罗斯总统的描述进行了辩护，称“与拥有 4000 枚核武器的人成为朋友而不是敌人真是太好了。”

paras.en: This is far from the first time Trump has spoken warmly about Putin, joking in 2013 about becoming his “new best friend.” Once in office, Trump said in 2018 that the pair “got on very well,” and in 2022, he described Putin’s initial moves against Ukraine as “genius” and “savvy.” In 2023 and again in 2024, Trump recounted telling Putin, “We’re friends.”
paras.zh: 这远非特朗普第一次热情谈论普京，2013 年他还开玩笑说要成为他的“新最好的朋友”。特朗普在 2018 年上任后表示，两人“相处得很好”，2022 年，他将普京针对乌克兰的最初举措描述为“天才”和“精明”。特朗普在 2023 年和 2024 年两次对普京说：“我们是朋友。”

paras.en: However, this week was the first time Trump made the declaration to Putin’s face, in front of television cameras at one of the most hotly anticipated meetings of recent years.
paras.zh: 然而，本周是特朗普首次在电视摄像机前当着普京的面做出这一声明，这是近年来最受期待的会议之一。

paras.en: “It’s one thing to say in an interview, ‘We get on,’ as Trump has in the past; it’s quite another to see him crossing a room in the hotel in China with an effusive smile on his face and gushing about ‘my friend,’” said Jonathan Eyal, international director of the Royal United Services Institute, a London-based think tank. “It all felt very natural and very real.”
paras.zh: 伦敦智库皇家联合三军研究所国际主任乔纳森·埃亚尔表示：“像特朗普过去那样，在接受采访时说‘我们相处融洽’是一回事；而看到他满脸热情地微笑着穿过中国酒店的一个房间，滔滔不绝地谈论‘我的朋友’，那就完全是另一回事了。” “这一切感觉非常自然、非常真实。”

paras.en: The condemnation was not confined to one side of the Atlantic.
paras.zh: 谴责并不局限于大西洋的一侧。

paras.en: In the United States, Democrats were openly scathing. Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer of New York called Trump’s words “embarrassing, despicable, and quite frankly pathetic,” while Sen. Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire, the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, described Trump’s “friend” as a “murderous war criminal.”
paras.zh: 在美国，民主党人公开严厉批评。纽约州参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默称特朗普的言论“令人尴尬、卑鄙，而且坦率地说是可悲的”，而参议院外交关系委员会民主党领袖、新罕布什尔州参议员珍妮·沙欣则将特朗普的“朋友”描述为“凶残的战犯”。

paras.en: Sen. Mark Kelly of Arizona said: “Putin is not my friend. He’s not your friend. He’s not a friend of this country, and when the president of the United States refers to him in that way, it emboldens him.”
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州参议员马克·凯利说：“普京不是我的朋友。他不是你的朋友。他不是这个国家的朋友，当美国总统这样提到他时，这让他更加大胆。”

paras.en: Republicans were more circumspect. Sen. Rick Scott of Florida called Putin a “thug” but acknowledged that Trump needed to work with him.
paras.zh: 共和党人则更加谨慎。佛罗里达州参议员里克·斯科特称普京为“暴徒”，但承认特朗普需要与他合作。

paras.en: Bill Browder, a British American financier who spearheaded the international campaign for Russian sanctions and has become one of Putin’s most prominent critics, also described his “revulsion and disgust” at hearing Trump’s words.
paras.zh: 英裔美国金融家比尔·布劳德(Bill Browder)是国际社会制裁俄罗斯运动的带头人，也是普京最著名的批评者之一，他也描述了他听到特朗普言论后的“反感和厌恶”。

paras.en: “He’s a guy who’s a geopolitical menace, and he should not get any kind of respect, let alone from the American head of state,” Browder told NBC News in a telephone interview. “To be elevated to the top table with genuine superpowers is an unbelievable symbolic position to sit in.”
paras.zh: 布劳德在接受 NBC 新闻电话采访时表示：“他是一个地缘政治威胁，他不应该得到任何形式的尊重，更不用说来自美国国家元首的尊重了。” “凭借真正的超能力登上最高席位是一个令人难以置信的象征性地位。”

paras.en: When asked about Trump’s comment at the end of the news conference following the “Coalition of the Willing” meeting in the German capital, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy only shrugged and walked offstage.
paras.zh: 在德国首都“意愿联盟”会议结束后的新闻发布会上，当被问及特朗普的评论时，乌克兰总统泽连斯基只是耸耸肩，走下台。

articles.title: Blackout prompts questions over ElectraNet's recent $300m network upgrade
articles.author: Thomas Kelsall

paras.en: Electricity transmission service provider ElectraNet is facing uncomfortable questions over Thursday's blackout on the Eyre Peninsula.
paras.zh: 电力传输服务提供商 ElectraNet 因周四艾尔半岛停电而面临令人不安的问题。

paras.en: The company spent $300 million on a network upgrade which it said would provide more reliable power.
paras.zh: 该公司斥资 3 亿美元进行网络升级，据称这将提供更可靠的电力。

paras.en: ElectraNet says the transmission towers will be standing again "in a few months' time".
paras.zh: ElectraNet 表示，输电塔将在“几个月后”重新矗立起来。

paras.en: The owner of South Australia's high-voltage transmission network is facing uncomfortable questions over Thursday's blackout on the Eyre Peninsula, after pledging a $300 million network upgrade would provide more reliable power.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚高压输电网络的所有者在承诺耗资 3 亿美元的网络升级将提供更可靠的电力后，因周四艾尔半岛停电而面临令人不安的问题。

paras.en: ElectraNet, the state's monopoly provider of electricity transmission services, has attributed the blackout to a "very unique, very rare" weather event that, at around 2.30pm on Thursday, damaged three transmission towers on the Eyre Peninsula.
paras.zh: 该州输电服务垄断提供商 ElectraNet 将这次停电归因于一场“非常独特、非常罕见”的天气事件，周四下午 2 点 30 分左右，该天气事件损坏了艾尔半岛的三座输电塔。

paras.en: The downed towers were located at Wharminda, a small rural locality that sits along a 270-kilometre transmission line between Port Lincoln and Cultana.
paras.zh: 被击落的铁塔位于沃明达 (Wharminda)，这是一个小型农村地区，位于林肯港和卡尔塔纳之间 270 公里长的输电线路沿线。

paras.en: ElectraNet spent $300 million on the high-voltage line, constructing 500 new transmission towers and upgrading five substations.
paras.zh: ElectraNet 在高压线上花费了 3 亿美元，建造了 500 个新的输电塔并升级了 5 个变电站。

paras.en: The project, named Eyre Peninsula Link, was completed in March 2023.
paras.zh: 该项目名为艾尔半岛连接线，于 2023 年 3 月竣工。

paras.en: In a media release heralding its opening, ElectraNet CEO Simon Emms said it would give "residential and business electricity users a more secure and reliable power supply".
paras.zh: ElectraNet 首席执行官西蒙·埃姆斯 (Simon Emms) 在宣布其开业的媒体新闻稿中表示，它将为“住宅和商业电力用户提供更安全、更可靠的电力供应”。

paras.en: But the blackout that unfolded over Thursday afternoon and into Friday left ElectraNet fielding uncomfortable questions from residents, cabinet ministers and the media about how an outage of this scale could still happen.
paras.zh: 但从周四下午一直持续到周五的停电事件让 ElectraNet 面临居民、内阁部长和媒体提出的令人不安的问题，即为何还会发生如此规模的停电。

paras.en: ElectraNet executive Alex Trento was peppered with questions at a state government press conference on Friday morning.
paras.zh: ElectraNet 高管亚历克斯·特伦托 (Alex Trento) 在周五上午的州政府新闻发布会上受到了各种提问。

paras.en: But when asked whether he would be having a conversation with the premier about more funding, Premier Peter Malinauskas stepped in.
paras.zh: 但当被问及是否会与州长就更多资金进行对话时，州长彼得·马利瑙斯卡斯介入了。

paras.en: "This is a private company and a private operator that runs a healthy profit for their shareholders,"
paras.zh: “这是一家私营公司和私营运营商，为股东带来可观的利润，”

paras.en: "This is not a question for us. That's a question for them."
paras.zh: “这不是我们的问题。这是他们的问题。”

paras.en: Earlier in the day, Energy Minister Tom Koutsantonis struck a similar tone.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，能源部长汤姆·库桑托尼斯(Tom Koutsantonis)也发表了类似的言论。

paras.en: "There'll be a lot of questions after this is all over about how these over $300 million worth of upgrades on the Eyre Peninsula just three years ago — that we've all paid for in our power bills — have failed, and what was the weather event that caused them," he told 891 ABC Adelaide.
paras.zh: 他告诉 891 ABC Adelaide 频道：“这一切结束后，人们会提出很多问题，关于三年前在艾尔半岛上价值超过 3 亿澳元的升级改造——我们都用电费支付了费用——是如何失败的，以及是什么天气事件导致了这些失败。”

paras.en: ElectraNet confident in transmission tower strength
paras.zh: ElectraNet 对输电塔强度充满信心

paras.en: ElectraNet is of the "strong belief" that the wind that hit the transmission towers was more than 172km/h.
paras.zh: ElectraNet“坚信”击中输电塔的风速超过 172 公里/小时。

paras.en: That would be above the winds they were built to withstand under Australian engineering specifications.
paras.zh: 这将高于澳大利亚工程规范规定的风力。

paras.en: Those specifications, Mr Trento said, were strengthened in 2016 following South Australia's statewide blackout.
paras.zh: 特伦托先生表示，2016 年南澳大利亚全州停电后，这些规范得到了加强。

paras.en: While a structural fault could not be ruled out, Mr Trento said: "At this point in time, seeing the localisation of the event, we do think that the towers have been designed and constructed effectively".
paras.zh: 虽然不能排除结构故障，但特伦托先生表示：“目前，鉴于事件的本地化，我们确实认为这些塔楼的设计和建造是有效的”。

paras.en: As to whether the engineering standards would need to be strengthened again, he said he had to wait for all the facts to be available.
paras.zh: 至于是否需要再次加强工程标准，他表示还需要等待所有事实的掌握。

paras.en: "We could have been looking at a 215km/h hour wind event, we just don't know," Mr Trento said.
paras.zh: 特伦托先生说：“我们本来可以观察到每小时 215 公里的风速，但我们只是不知道。”

paras.en: "So, until we have all that information, I really can't answer that question on whether the standards need to be updated."
paras.zh: “因此，在我们掌握所有信息之前，我真的无法回答标准是否需要更新的问题。”

paras.en: The transmission towers will be standing again "in a few months' time", Mr Trento added.
paras.zh: 特伦托先生补充说，“几个月后”，输电塔将再次矗立。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, you can never guarantee that the transmission network will not be subject to these extreme weather events."
paras.zh: “不幸的是，你永远无法保证传输网络不会受到这些极端天气事件的影响。”

paras.en: The blackout has also put renewed attention on the relationship between ElectraNet and the Australian Energy Regulator (AER).
paras.zh: 此次停电也让 ElectraNet 与澳大利亚能源监管机构 (AER) 之间的关系重新受到关注。

paras.en: The regulator has the final say on what transmission companies can spend on big infrastructure upgrades, balancing this with what they will need to raise from higher energy bills.
paras.zh: 监管机构对输电公司在大型基础设施升级上的支出拥有最终决定权，并在这与他们需要从更高的能源账单中筹集资金之间进行平衡。

paras.en: In September 2020, it gave ElectraNet approval to spend $280 million on Eyre Peninsula Link.
paras.zh: 2020 年 9 月，ElectraNet 批准斥资 2.8 亿美元建设艾尔半岛连线。

paras.en: Mr Trento said a "secondary circuit" — which could have provided a redundancy to Thursday's blackout — was explored when ElectraNet was putting forward Eyre Peninsula Link.
paras.zh: 特伦托先生表示，当 ElectraNet 提出艾尔半岛连接线时，就探索了一条“二级电路”——这可能为周四的停电提供冗余。

paras.en: "But that would have been double the cost, and that cost eventually ends up with the mums and dads of South Australia," he said.
paras.zh: “但这将是双倍的成本，而这笔成本最终将由南澳大利亚的妈妈和爸爸承担，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Trento conceded that the yet-known cost of repairing the damaged infrastructure would also have to come through consumer energy bills.
paras.zh: 特伦托承认，修复受损基础设施的已知费用也必须通过消费者能源账单来支付。

paras.en: But he said that was "nowhere near the cost of adding a second line", which he estimated at $600 million.
paras.zh: 但他表示，这“远低于增加第二条生产线的成本”，他估计该成本为 6 亿美元。

paras.en: "We can make things as big as we want to, and it will be like a Colosseum, and it will stand 2,000 years.
paras.zh: “我们可以把东西做得尽可能大，它会像罗马斗兽场一样，并且能够屹立 2000 年。

paras.en: "But that's not efficient or prudent spending and will never get approved by the AER."
paras.zh: “但这不是高效或审慎的支出，永远不会得到 AER 的批准。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, residents on the Eyre Peninsula are doing their own cost counting.
paras.zh: 与此同时，艾尔半岛的居民正在自行计算成本。

paras.en: Port Lincoln business owner Jan Regan had to close her hearing care provider on Thursday afternoon, after losing all computer access and capacity to do hearing aid repairs.
paras.zh: 林肯港企业主简·里根（Jan Regan）在失去所有计算机访问权限和助听器维修能力后，不得不于周四下午关闭她的听力保健提供商。

paras.en: She questioned how a $300 million transmission line could fail within years of its construction.
paras.zh: 她质疑一条耗资 3 亿美元的输电线路为何会在建成后数年内出现故障。

paras.en: "Was it money well spent? Probably not, if you spend that much and it fails," she said.
paras.zh: “这笔钱花得值吗？如果你花了那么多钱却失败了，那可能就不值钱了，”她说。

paras.en: "We're not a third-world country. I don't quite know what's happening, but it needs to be looked at."
paras.zh: “我们不是第三世界国家。我不太清楚发生了什么，但需要加以关注。”

articles.title: Trump vows 'tremendous tax' on companies building data centres abroad
articles.author: Kamin Gock

paras.en: Donald Trump vows to tax US companies building data centres overseas
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普誓言对在海外建设数据中心的美国公司征税

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has vowed to tax American companies that build data centres abroad.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普誓言要对在海外建设数据中心的美国公司征税。

paras.en: US tech giants have recently committed billions of dollars to build data centres in Australia.
paras.zh: 美国科技巨头最近投入数十亿美元在澳大利亚建设数据中心。

paras.en: The president says the move is intended to help the US artificial intelligence sector compete with China.
paras.zh: 总统表示，此举旨在帮助美国人工智能领域与中国竞争。

articles.title: How a dodgy visa scheme put the premier's secret partner behind bars
articles.author: Jessica Clifford and Tim Fernandez

paras.en: Daryl Maguire became a household name when his secret relationship with then-New South Wales premier Gladys Berejiklian was exposed at a corruption inquiry in 2020.
paras.zh: 达里尔·马奎尔 (Daryl Maguire) 与时任新南威尔士州州长格拉迪斯·贝雷吉克利安 (Gladys Berejiklian) 的秘密关系在 2020 年的一次腐败调查中曝光，从此成为家喻户晓的人物。

paras.en: But it was his part in a fraudulent visa scheme years earlier that has landed him in prison.
paras.zh: 但正是他多年前参与的欺诈性签证计划导致他入狱。

paras.en: Yesterday, the former Wagga Wagga MP was sentenced to three years' jail, with a non-parole period of one year, for conspiring to create false visa applications for Chinese nationals between 2013 and 2015 while he was in parliament.
paras.zh: 昨天，这位前瓦加瓦加议员因在2013年至2015年担任议会议员期间密谋为中国公民制作虚假签证申请而被判处三年监禁，一年内不得假释。

paras.en: It is not the first time he has been led from court in handcuffs.
paras.zh: 这并不是他第一次被戴上手铐带出法庭。

paras.en: Last year, he was sentenced to 10 months for misleading the Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC), but released on bail within the hour, with that conviction later overturned on appeal.
paras.zh: 去年，他因误导廉政公署 (ICAC) 被判处 10 个月监禁，但一小时内获得保释，后来上诉推翻了原判。

paras.en: Here is how the politician who once had a private line to the state's most powerful person ended up behind bars.
paras.zh: 以下是一位曾经与该州最有权势的人有私人线路的政治家最终入狱的故事。

paras.en: Maguire entered NSW parliament in 1999 after winning Wagga Wagga, extending the Liberal Party's hold on a seat it had held since 1957.
paras.zh: Maguire在1999年赢得沃加沃加选区后进入新南威尔士州议会，延续了自由党自1957年以来对该席位的掌控。

paras.en: He became Opposition whip in 2003 and Government whip after the Coalition won the 2011 election.
paras.zh: 他于2003年成为反对党党鞭，并在联盟党赢得2011年大选后成为政府党鞭。

paras.en: Behind the scenes, he had a business interest he never declared.
paras.zh: 在幕后，他有着从未公开宣称的商业利益。

paras.en: In October 2012, a company called G8wayInternational was set up, with Maguire closely involved from the start.
paras.zh: 2012年10月，一家名为G8wayInternational的公司成立，马奎尔从一开始就密切参与。

paras.en: It was pitched as a business network linking China and Australia across a range of industries.
paras.zh: 它被宣传为连接中国和澳大利亚各行业的商业网络。

paras.en: Among its services was immigration assistance, which a later ICAC investigation would find facilitated the visa scheme.
paras.zh: 它的服务之一是移民援助，后来廉政公署的调查发现，移民援助为签证计划提供了便利。

paras.en: That inquiry found that, while Maguire was never formally a director, he was "in substance a director" and had agreed to share in its profits.
paras.zh: 该调查发现，虽然马奎尔从未正式担任董事，但他“实质上是董事”，并同意分享其利润。

paras.en: ICAC found he kept his role off the books so he would not have to declare it to parliament, and turned his parliamentary office at least partly into an office for the company.
paras.zh: ICAC发现他没有将自己的角色列入账簿，这样他就不必向议会申报，并将他的议会办公室至少部分变成了公司的办公室。

paras.en: Between January 2013 and August 2015, Maguire was part of what prosecutors called a cash-for-visa scheme, recruiting businesses, mostly from his own electorate.
paras.zh: 2013年1月至2015年8月期间，马奎尔参与了检察官所谓的现金换签证计划，招募企业，其中大部分来自他自己的选民。

paras.en: The jury heard the businesses were paid cash to sponsor Chinese nationals as workers, but many of those workers never turned up.
paras.zh: 陪审团获悉，这些企业获得了现金来赞助中国公民作为工人，但其中许多工人从未出现。

paras.en: One business owner told the trial he received $30,000 in cash in an envelope but never met the visa applicant he had agreed to employ.
paras.zh: 一位企业主在庭审中表示，他在一个信封中收到了 3 万美元现金，但从未见过他同意雇用的签证申请人。

paras.en: This was one of several witnesses who gave similar evidence throughout the trial.
paras.zh: 这是在整个审判过程中提供类似证据的几名证人之一。

paras.en: It was always a similar story: a mysterious phone call, meetings arranged behind the scenes, and cash for a worker who never arrived.
paras.zh: 故事总是相似的：一个神秘的电话，幕后安排的会议，以及为从未到达的工人提供的现金。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the visa applications were being handled by his associate, Maggie Wang.
paras.zh: 与此同时，签证申请正由他的同事 Maggie Wang 处理。

paras.en: She was also sentenced to two years and 10 months' imprisonment, to be served in the community, and 240 hours of community service for her role in the scheme.
paras.zh: 她还因参与该计划而被判处两年零十个月监禁、社区服务和 240 小时社区服务。

paras.en: What first brought Maguire undone was an ICAC inquiry into Canterbury City Council in Sydney, known as Operation Dasha.
paras.zh: 首先导致马奎尔失败的是廉政公署对悉尼坎特伯雷市议会的一项调查，即“达莎行动”。

paras.en: Investigators had tapped the phones of Canterbury councillors.
paras.zh: 调查人员窃听了坎特伯雷议员的电话。

paras.en: On those calls, Maguire was talking with then-councillor Michael Hawatt about a potential $48 million property development in Campsie and possible commissions from developers.
paras.zh: 在这些电话中，马奎尔正在与时任市议员迈克尔·哈瓦特 (Michael Hawatt) 讨论在 Campsie 进行价值 4800 万美元的房地产开发项目以及可能向开发商收取的佣金。

paras.en: Called to give evidence in July 2018, Maguire then quit the Liberal Party.
paras.zh: 2018 年 7 月，马奎尔被传唤出庭作证，随后退出自由党。

paras.en: The following month, he resigned from parliament.
paras.zh: 次月，他辞去议会职务。

paras.en: Independent Joe McGirr won the by-election, ending the Liberals' 61-year hold on Wagga.
paras.zh: 独立党人 Joe McGirr 在补选中获胜，结束了自由党对瓦加长达 61 年的控制。

paras.en: The 2018 ICAC inquiry made no corrupt conduct findings against Maguire, but it asked prosecutors to consider whether he had misled it.
paras.zh: 2018年廉政公署的调查没有发现马奎尔有腐败行为，但要求检察官考虑他是否误导了调查。

paras.en: In 2020, ICAC began public hearings in that second inquiry, Operation Keppel, this time into Maguire himself.
paras.zh: 2020 年，廉政公署开始就第二次调查“吉宝行动”举行公开听证会，这次调查对象是马奎尔本人。

paras.en: On October 12, 2020, Ms Berejiklian revealed she had been in a "close personal relationship" with him.
paras.zh: 2020 年 10 月 12 日，贝姬莲透露她与他一直保持着“密切的私人关系”。

paras.en: She told ICAC it began around the 2015 election, though the commission found messages from at least mid-2014 showed a relationship of "considerable intensity".
paras.zh: 她告诉廉政公署，这种关系始于 2015 年大选前后，尽管该委员会发现至少从 2014 年中期开始的信息显示出这种关系“相当密切”。

paras.en: There is no suggestion Ms Berejiklian had any involvement in the visa scheme.
paras.zh: 没有迹象表明贝姬莲女士参与了该签证计划。

paras.en: Maguire admitted at the inquiry he had used his position as an MP to try to make money for himself and his associates.
paras.zh: 马奎尔在调查中承认，他曾利用国会议员的职位试图为自己和同事赚钱。

paras.en: A year later, Ms Berejiklian resigned as premier after ICAC said it was examining whether the relationship had exposed her to conflicts of interest.
paras.zh: 一年后，在廉政公署表示正在调查这种关系是否使她面临利益冲突后，贝姬莲辞去了总理职务。

paras.en: ICAC passed information to law enforcement agencies, and in November 2022 the Australian Border Force charged Maguire over the visa scheme.
paras.zh: ICAC 将信息传递给执法机构，澳大利亚边境部队于 2022 年 11 月就签证计划对马奎尔提出指控。

paras.en: In June 2023, ICAC found both had engaged in serious corrupt conduct.
paras.zh: 2023年6月，廉政公署发现两人均存在严重腐败行为。

paras.en: Maguire by monetising his office, and Ms Berejiklian by breaching public trust over grants to projects he championed.
paras.zh: 马奎尔将他的办公室货币化，而贝姬莲则破坏了公众对他所支持的项目拨款的信任。

paras.en: Her challenge to the findings failed in the Court of Appeal in 2024.
paras.zh: 她对调查结果的质疑于 2024 年在上诉法院失败。

paras.en: Off the back of the first ICAC inquiry, Maguire was charged with giving misleading evidence to the NSW corruption watchdog.
paras.zh: 在廉政公署第一次调查后，马奎尔被指控向新南威尔士州腐败监管机构提供误导性证据。

paras.en: During the 2018 hearings, he initially denied ever doing business with then-councillor Hawatt or seeking payment for brokering a deal with a Chinese property developer.
paras.zh: 在 2018 年的听证会上，他最初否认曾与时任市议员哈瓦特有过业务往来，也否认曾因与一家中国房地产开发商达成交易而寻求报酬。

paras.en: In June 2025, after a Local Court hearing, Magistrate Clare Farnan found his initial claim that there was nothing in the deal for him was "clearly misleading".
paras.zh: 2025 年 6 月，地方法院听证会后，地方法官克莱尔·法南 (Clare Farnan) 发现他最初声称该交易中没有任何内容“明显具有误导性”。

paras.en: He was initially sentenced to 10 months in prison in 2025, but this conviction was ultimately overturned in March this year and the charge dismissed.
paras.zh: 他最初于 2025 年被判处 10 个月监禁，但这一定罪最终于今年 3 月被推翻，指控被驳回。

paras.en: In sentencing Maguire yesterday, Judge Ian Bourke said he was satisfied Maguire "performed an important and pivotal role in the conspiracy".
paras.zh: 在昨天对马奎尔的量刑中，法官伊恩·布尔克表示，他对马奎尔“在阴谋中发挥了重要且关键的作用”感到满意。

paras.en: He said Maguire "was an active participant in the planning and execution of the scheme".
paras.zh: 他说马奎尔“积极参与了该计划的规划和执行”。

paras.en: Maguire's legal team immediately indicated he would be lodging an appeal, his barrister telling the court the jury's verdict was unreasonable.
paras.zh: 马奎尔的法律团队立即表示他将提出上诉，他的律师告诉法庭陪审团的裁决不合理。

paras.en: He made an immediate application for appeal bail, which would have seen Maguire walk free until the appeal is heard; however, this was denied.
paras.zh: 他立即申请上诉保释，这样马奎尔就可以无罪释放，直到上诉得到审理为止。然而，这一说法遭到否认。

paras.en: Instead, the politician turned prisoner calmly leaned towards his lawyer, and handed over his valuables.
paras.zh: 相反，这位政治家变成了囚犯，平静地靠向他的律师，并交出了他的贵重物品。

paras.en: He will be eligible for parole in November 2027.
paras.zh: 他将于 2027 年 11 月获得假释资格。

articles.title: Relax, it’s probably not a cyber attack

paras.en: Over the past week, a whole bunch of major tech outages have happened — affecting Microsoft, Apple, major banks, the U.S. National Security Administration, and temporarily grounding all flights across the United States.
paras.zh: 过去一周，发生了一系列重大技术故障——影响了微软、苹果、各大银行、美国国家安全局，并暂时停飞了美国各地的所有航班。

paras.en: While officials and companies have repeatedly insisted that these were not cyber attacks, and certainly not coordinated, the incidents have caused a lot of panic.
paras.zh: 尽管官员和公司一再坚称这些不是网络攻击，而且肯定不是协调一致的，但这些事件引起了很大的恐慌。

paras.en: We’re going to break down what’s really happening (hint: it’s not a cyber apocalypse), and what it says about our fast-changing tech landscape, with Andrew Couts, WIRED’s director of Security and Investigations.
paras.zh: 我们将与《连线》安全与调查总监安德鲁·库茨 (Andrew Couts) 一起分析到底发生了什么（提示：这不是网络灾难），以及它对我们快速变化的技术格局的影响。

paras.en: For transcripts of Front Burner, please visit: https://www.cbc.ca/radio/frontburner/transcripts
paras.zh: 如需《Front Burner》的文字记录，请访问：https://www.cbc.ca/radio/frontburner/transcripts

articles.title: What an international court's historic genocide ruling could mean for future cases
articles.author: Nahlah Ayed

paras.en: What an international court's historic genocide ruling could mean for future cases
paras.zh: 国际法院历史性的种族灭绝裁决对未来案件意味着什么

paras.en: Court's finding that Myanmar committed genocide provides little change for Rohingya victims
paras.zh: 法院裁定缅甸犯下种族灭绝罪，这对罗兴亚受害者来说几乎没有什么改变

paras.en: In the days after the world's top court was asked to weigh in on accusations of genocide against Myanmar, legal experts, activists and victims alike hoped the case might, for the first time in decades, open a new pathway for delivering justice on the international stage.
paras.zh: 在世界最高法院被要求对针对缅甸的种族灭绝指控进行权衡后的几天里，法律专家、活动人士和受害者都希望该案能够在数十年来首次为国际舞台上伸张正义开辟一条新途径。

paras.en: That was back in 2019. The International Court of Justice's finding seven years later that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority was indeed celebrated as recognition of the decades-long suffering of the Rohingya people. But it came at a high price.
paras.zh: 那是在 2019 年。七年后，国际法院裁定缅甸对其罗兴亚穆斯林少数民族实施种族灭绝，这确实值得庆祝，因为这是对罗兴亚人民数十年苦难的承认。但它的代价很高。

paras.en: "For the first time the world has heard the Rohingya," said John Jonaid, a survivor of the genocide who is now an Ottawa-based Rohingya journalist and human rights advocate.
paras.zh: “世界第一次听到罗兴亚人的声音，”种族灭绝幸存者约翰·乔奈德说，他现在是渥太华的罗兴亚人记者和人权倡导者。

paras.en: "But at the same time, it's too late, I would say, for us to get any justice for our suffering."
paras.zh: “但与此同时，我想说，现在已经太晚了，我们无法为自己的痛苦伸张正义。”

paras.en: The Myanmar military conducted "clearance operations" in Rakhine state in 2017, systematically destroying Rohingya villages, perpetrating brutal sexual violence and killing thousands of people.
paras.zh: 缅甸军方2017年在若开邦进行“清剿行动”，系统性摧毁罗兴亚村庄，实施残酷的性暴力，造成数千人死亡。

paras.en: Most Rohingya now live in the world's largest refugee camp in Bangladesh and beyond, with little prospect of return.
paras.zh: 大多数罗兴亚人现在生活在孟加拉国及其他地区世界上最大的难民营中，返回的希望渺茫。

paras.en: In its judgment, the ICJ demanded that Myanmar provide reparations and allow Rohingya to return to their villages — but most of those villages have been erased, and the country's leadership has long disregarded international scrutiny, rejecting allegations of genocide.
paras.zh: 国际法院在判决中要求缅甸提供赔偿并允许罗兴亚人返回自己的村庄，但大多数村庄已被夷为平地，而该国领导人长期以来无视国际监督，否认种族灭绝指控。

paras.en: The tension between a legal victory in the case against Myanmar, launched by the Muslim-majority African nation of Gambia, and the reality for Rohingya victims of genocide was inevitable from the start: while the court has the power to hear and rule on cases filed by states against other states, it has no real means with which to implement its rulings.
paras.zh: 穆斯林占多数的非洲国家冈比亚发起的针对缅甸的诉讼取得法律胜利，与种族灭绝的罗兴亚受害者的现实之间的紧张关系从一开始就不可避免：虽然法院有权审理和裁决国家针对其他国家提起的案件，但它没有真正的手段来执行其裁决。

paras.en: Gambia's Justice Minister and Attorney General Dawda Jallow, right, with lawyer Arsalan Suleman, speaks to the media after International Court of Justice ruling in The Hague, Netherlands, on Thursday. Gambia launched the proceedings at the court in 2019. (Patrick Post/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，国际法院在荷兰海牙作出裁决后，冈比亚司法部长兼总检察长达乌达·贾洛（右）与律师阿尔萨兰·苏莱曼向媒体发表讲话。冈比亚于 2019 年向法院提起诉讼。（Patrick Post/美联社）

paras.en: And yet even before the Thursday ruling, the case still had a profound legal impact.
paras.zh: 然而，即使在周四的裁决之前，该案仍然产生了深远的法律影响。

paras.en: Five new cases involving genocide were subsequently filed at the ICJ, each with its own unique circumstances. They include the highly anticipated case brought forward by South Africa against Israel, accusing it of genocide against Palestinians in Gaza following Hamas's attacks on Oct. 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 随后向国际法院提起了五起涉及种族灭绝的新案件，每起案件都有其独特的情况。其中包括南非对以色列提出的备受期待的案件，指控以色列在 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击后对加沙巴勒斯坦人进行种族灭绝。

paras.en: - South Africa accuses Israel of 'genocidal' acts in Gaza; Israel rejects filing to top UN court 'with disgust'
paras.zh: - 南非指责以色列在加沙实施“种族灭绝”行为；以色列“厌恶地”拒绝向联合国最高法院提起诉讼

paras.en: - As UN court prepares to hear genocide claim against Israel, Canada still hasn't taken a position
paras.zh: - 当联合国法院准备审理针对以色列的种族灭绝指控时，加拿大仍未采取立场

paras.en: And now, legal experts say, the court's first ever finding of genocide committed by a state may also help shape how that case and others like it are decided in the future.
paras.zh: 法律专家表示，现在，法院首次发现一个国家犯有种族灭绝罪，这也可能有助于决定该案和其他类似案件未来的判决方式。

paras.en: At minimum, Thursday's ruling — the first of its kind at the ICJ — has brought the 1948 UN convention on genocide "back to life," said Canadian human rights lawyer Payam Akhavan, one of the attorneys who served as counsel for Gambia in the case.
paras.zh: 担任该案冈比亚律师的加拿大人权律师帕亚姆·阿卡万 (Payam Akhavan) 表示，至少，周四的裁决——国际法院的此类裁决尚属首次——让 1948 年联合国关于种族灭绝的公约“复活”。

paras.en: "This is a landmark judgment of the ICJ, and it comes at a crucial point in the evolution of international law, including unprecedented attacks against both the international criminal court and the ICJ," he said in an interview with CBC.
paras.zh: 他在接受加拿大广播公司采访时表示：“这是国际法院具有里程碑意义的判决，它出现在国际法演变的关键时刻，包括对国际刑事法院和国际法院的前所未有的攻击。”

paras.en: While Akhavan says the ruling is "grossly inadequate" in addressing the immediate plight of the victims of Myanmar's genocide, he notes that how the court has interpreted the law in this case could still play a role in shaping the outcome of future ones.
paras.zh: 虽然阿卡万表示，这一裁决“严重不足以”解决缅甸种族灭绝受害者的直接困境，但他指出，法院如何解释本案中的法律仍然可能在塑造未来案件的结果方面发挥作用。

paras.en: Canadian human rights lawyer Payam Akhavan, centre, sits at Gambia's counsel table for the January 2020 reading of the first International Court of Justice judgment on urgent measures concerning Myanmar. (Payam Akhavan/ICJ)
paras.zh: Canadian human rights lawyer Payam Akhavan, centre, sits at Gambia's counsel table for the January 2020 reading of the first International Court of Justice judgment on urgent measures concerning Myanmar. （帕亚姆·阿卡万/国际法院）

paras.en: Ruling underlines sexual violence is a genocidal act
paras.zh: 裁决强调性暴力是种族灭绝行为

paras.en: Significantly, the majority of the judges in the Myanmar case rejected the country's argument that the "clearance operations" it conducted against the Rohingya in 2017 were defensive military operations aimed at neutralizing a threat and therefore precluded genocide.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，缅甸案件的大多数法官都驳回了该国的论点，即2017年对罗辛亚人进行的“清除行动”是旨在消除威胁并因此避免种族灭绝的防御性军事行动。

paras.en: Priya Pillai, a lawyer and international law specialist, told CBC News the court ruled that "the fact that you have a conflict doesn't preclude the fact that you might have genocidal intent as well."
paras.zh: 律师兼国际法专家 Priya Pillai 告诉 CBC 新闻，法院裁定“你们发生冲突的事实并不排除你们也可能有种族灭绝意图”。

paras.en: "The two things can exist at the same time."
paras.zh: “这两种东西可以同时存在。”

paras.en: Other strands of the ruling, says Akhavan, demonstrated an expansive approach to the genocide convention, which was adopted in the wake of the Holocaust and the murder of millions of Jews during the Second World War.
paras.zh: 阿卡万说，该裁决的其他部分展示了对种族灭绝公约的广泛态度，该公约是在第二次世界大战期间大屠杀和数百万犹太人被谋杀之后通过的。

paras.en: Crucially, the ICJ judges strongly affirmed that genocidal acts were not limited to murder or displacement, but could also include crimes of sexual violence and attacks on reproductive capability to prevent procreation.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，国际法院法官强烈确认种族灭绝行为不仅限于谋杀或流离失所，还可能包括性暴力犯罪和为阻止生育而攻击生殖能力的犯罪。

paras.en: Countless Rohingya women reported a campaign of mutilation and brutal sexual violence at the hands of Myanmar's military forces.
paras.zh: 无数罗兴亚妇女报告称，缅甸军队实施了残害和残酷的性暴力行为。

paras.en: Marianne Vitug, legal advisor for the Global Justice Center, said at a news conference in The Hague Thursday that the court looked at how sexual violence was directed at women and girls of reproductive age and sometimes pregnant women, and how young and unmarried women were targeted with extreme and brutal violence.
paras.zh: 全球司法中心法律顾问玛丽安·维图格周四在海牙举行的新闻发布会上表示，法院研究了性暴力是如何针对育龄妇女和女孩（有时是孕妇）的，以及年轻和未婚妇女如何成为极端和残酷暴力的目标。

paras.en: "The targeting of reproductive capacity is now very clearly a genocidal act, so that is a significant finding in this case."
paras.zh: “现在，以生殖能力为目标显然是一种种族灭绝行为，因此这是本案的一个重大发现。”

paras.en: Vitug says the court's reliance on evidence gathered by NGOs and fact-finding missions is also "very significant in relation to upcoming cases that will rely on similar findings."
paras.zh: 维图格表示，法院对非政府组织和实况调查团收集的证据的依赖“对于即将依赖类似调查结果的案件也非常重要”。

paras.en: Unlike in other cases, NGOs cannot intervene directly in cases before the ICJ. Only member states can do so, and in Gambia's case, that included Canada, jointly with France, the Netherlands, Denmark, Germany and the U.K., supporting Gambia's effort to end Myanmar's impunity.
paras.zh: 与其他案件不同，非政府组织不能直接干预国际法院审理的案件。只有成员国才能这样做，就冈比亚而言，加拿大与法国、荷兰、丹麦、德国和英国一起支持冈比亚结束缅甸有罪不罚现象的努力。

paras.en: Their intervention focused on how the court should interpret the genocide convention, including the role of sexual violence.
paras.zh: 他们的干预重点是法院应如何解释种族灭绝公约，包括性暴力的作用。

paras.en: In 2018, Parliament voted unanimously to recognize that Myanmar's military actions against Rohingya people constituted genocide.
paras.zh: 2018年，议会一致投票承认缅甸针对罗兴亚人的军事行动构成种族灭绝。

paras.en: John Jonaid, a survivor of the genocide who is now an Ottawa-based Rohingya journalist and human rights advocate. (Nicole Williams/CBC)
paras.zh: 约翰·乔奈德（John Jonaid）是种族灭绝的幸存者，现在是渥太华的罗兴亚人记者和人权倡导者。 （妮可·威廉姆斯/CBC）

paras.en: Rohingya activists are skeptical that pressure by the international community will do anything to persuade Myanmar's current president, Min Aung Hlaing, who led the military during its operations in Rakhine State, to accept them back.
paras.zh: 罗兴亚活动人士怀疑国际社会的压力是否能说服缅甸现任总统敏昂莱接受他们回来。敏昂莱曾在若开邦的行动中领导军队。

paras.en: There is also the question of what they would be returning to.
paras.zh: 还有一个问题是他们将返回什么地方。

paras.en: "Their entire villages have been burned and their history has been erased from Myanmar, as if they never existed [there]," said Jonaid.
paras.zh: “他们的整个村庄都被烧毁了，他们的历史也从缅甸被抹去了，就好像他们从未存在过一样，”乔奈德说。

paras.en: While they await the right conditions for return, Jonaid says countries like Canada that have taken an interest in the plight of Rohingya must do whatever possible to ensure they thrive — including providing opportunities for education and employment wherever they currently live.
paras.zh: 乔奈德表示，在他们等待合适的返回条件时，像加拿大这样关心罗兴亚人困境的国家必须尽一切可能确保他们繁荣发展，包括为他们目前居住的地方提供教育和就业机会。

paras.en: Akhavan suspects meaningful change in the international justice system will take time.
paras.zh: 阿卡万怀疑国际司法体系的有意义的改变需要时间。

paras.en: "We have to understand that the fight for universal human rights is a painfully long historical process."
paras.zh: “我们必须明白，争取普遍人权是一个痛苦而漫长的历史过程。”

articles.title: 2 U.S. veterans, who both survived Pearl Harbor attack, die on same day

paras.en: 2 U.S. veterans, who both survived Pearl Harbor attack, die on same day
paras.zh: 珍珠港袭击事件中幸存的两名美国退伍军人同一天去世

paras.en: Gebhard Galle was 105. Freeman Johnson, the oldest known survivor, was 106
paras.zh: 格布哈德·加勒 (Gebhard Galle) 享年 105 岁。已知最年长的幸存者弗里曼·约翰逊 (Freeman Johnson) 享年 106 岁

paras.en: Two former U.S service members who were stationed at Pearl Harbor in Hawaii when Japan attacked in 1941 died on the same day last week, it has been learned.
paras.zh: 据了解，1941 年日本袭击时驻扎在夏威夷珍珠港的两名前美国军人于上周同一天死亡。

paras.en: Gebhard (Geb) Galle, died on Saturday at his home in Moses Lake, Wash., according to his daughter, Lynda Palmer. He was 105.
paras.zh: 格布哈德·加勒 (Gebhard Galle) 的女儿琳达·帕尔默 (Lynda Palmer) 表示，他于周六在华盛顿州摩西湖的家中去世。他105岁了。

paras.en: Galle died the same day as the oldest known Pearl Harbor survivor, Freeman Johnson, of Centerville, Mass., who was 106.
paras.zh: 加勒与已知年龄最大的珍珠港幸存者、来自马萨诸塞州森特维尔的弗里曼·约翰逊（Freeman Johnson）于同一天去世，享年 106 岁。

paras.en: Galle and Johnson were among the estimated 87,000 military personnel on Oahu on Dec. 7, 1941, when Japan attacked — killing just over 2,400 Americans and drawing the U.S. into the Second World War.
paras.zh: 1941 年 12 月 7 日，日本发动袭击，瓦胡岛约有 87,000 名军事人员，加勒和约翰逊就是其中之一，造成 2,400 多名美国人死亡，并将美国拖入第二次世界大战。

paras.en: The list of surviving veterans from the attack had stood at about a dozen names since the December 2025 death of Ira (Ike) Schab, who was 105.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 12 月 105 岁的艾拉 (艾克) 沙布 (Ira (Ike) Schab) 去世以来，在袭击中幸存的退伍军人名单上约有十几个人。

paras.en: The American Legion commended Galle and Johnson as "two members of a generation whose courage and sacrifice will forever be part of our nation's history," in a post on X.
paras.zh: 美国退伍军人协会在 X 上的一篇帖子中称赞加勒和约翰逊是“一代人的两位成员，他们的勇气和牺牲将永远成为我们国家历史的一部分”。

paras.en: Galle was serving aboard the battleship USS Nevada, while Freeman was with the cruiser USS St. Louis at the time of the attack, the veterans' organization noted.
paras.zh: 退伍军人组织指出，袭击发生时加勒正在内华达号战列舰上服役，而弗里曼则在圣路易斯号巡洋舰上服役。

paras.en: Freeman Johnson looks down at his navy cap during an interview at his home in Centerville, Mass., on May 6. (Charles Krupa/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 5 月 6 日，弗里曼·约翰逊在马萨诸塞州森特维尔的家中接受采访时低头看着他的海军帽。（查尔斯·克鲁帕/美联社）

paras.en: Galle was born in Germany. He came to North Dakota with his family as a child and joined the U.S. navy in 1939 at age 18.
paras.zh: 加勒出生于德国。他小时候随家人来到北达科他州，并于 1939 年 18 岁时加入美国海军。

paras.en: He was a machinist's mate aboard the Nevada, and was waiting below deck to be taken ashore for church services on Dec. 7, 1941. He looked out of a porthole and saw planes approaching.
paras.zh: 1941 年 12 月 7 日，他是内华达号上的一名机械师副手，正在甲板下等待上岸参加教堂礼拜。他从舷窗往外看，看到飞机正在接近。

paras.en: A torpedo struck the ship, allowing water to enter, but officers were able to get it moving, the navy said. The ship was attacked again, causing more leaks in the hull and fires. The Nevada ran aground.
paras.zh: 海军表示，一枚鱼雷击中了这艘船，导致水进入，但军官们设法让它移动。该船再次遭到袭击，导致船体出现更多泄漏并起火。内华达号搁浅了。

paras.en: "Of course, we felt a couple jolts, and that's when we got hit with the torpedo, and we had a few bomb hits," he told the Columbia Basin Herald, a newspaper based in Moses Lake, in 2020.
paras.zh: 2020 年，他对位于摩西湖的报纸《哥伦比亚盆地先驱报》表示：“当然，我们感到了一些震动，就在那时我们被鱼雷击中，还有几起炸弹袭击。”

paras.en: "After we were beached and everything, and we got up to topside, then we saw all the mess that took place," including the capsized USS Oklahoma and the partially submerged USS Arizona, he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“当我们搁浅后，我们爬到了上部，然后我们看到了发生的所有混乱，”包括倾覆的俄克拉荷马号航空母舰和部分淹没的亚利桑那号航空母舰。

paras.en: Galle was reassigned to the USS Northampton. That ship came under fire on Nov. 30, 1942, by Japanese torpedoes during the Battle of Tassafaronga.
paras.zh: 加勒号被重新分配到北安普顿号航空母舰。 1942 年 11 月 30 日，该船在塔萨法龙加战役期间遭到日本鱼雷的攻击。

paras.en: Galle told the Basin Herald he was ordered to leave a hatch closed behind four sailors who would've been trapped when the ship was sinking. The officer left, but Galle defied the order, opening the hatch. He closed and secured it after the sailors escaped.
paras.zh: 加勒告诉《盆地先驱报》，他被命令关闭四名水手身后的舱口，当船沉没时，他们可能会被困。这名军官离开了，但加勒违反了命令，打开了舱门。水手们逃走后，他关闭并固定住了门。

paras.en: "He heard those guys pounding on the roof of the hatch," Palmer said. "He went to open it up, and the senior officer walked by and said, 'No, leave it closed, because we don't want water to get in there because the ship might go down.'"
paras.zh: “他听到那些家伙敲打舱门顶部的声音，”帕尔默说。 “他去打开它，高级官员走过来说，‘不，把它关上，因为我们不想让水进入那里，因为船可能会沉没。’”

paras.en: The Northampton sank, and Galle and other sailors spent more than a day adrift in life rafts before they were rescued.
paras.zh: 北安普顿号沉没，加勒和其他水手在救生筏上漂流了一天多才获救。

paras.en: His "courage under fire" in that incident, as well as his having fought in 19 of 20 Pacific naval engagements, was noted in a 2025 letter from then-acting Chief of Naval Operations Adm. James Kilby, marking Galle's 104th birthday.
paras.zh: 时任代理海军作战部长詹姆斯·基尔比上将在 2025 年纪念加勒 104 岁生日的信中指出，他在那次事件中表现出“在火力下的勇气”，并参加了 20 场太平洋海军交战中的 19 场。

paras.en: "Your humility, quick thinking and selfless actions remain a shining example of Navy valour," Kilby wrote.
paras.zh: 基尔比写道：“你的谦逊、敏捷的思维和无私的行动仍然是海军英勇的光辉典范。”

paras.en: In December 2016, Galle attended a 75th anniversary service at Pearl Harbor to honour and commemorate the USS Nevada and those who served on it. A total of 76 sailors and marines lost their lives as a result of that attack, the navy said.
paras.zh: 2016 年 12 月，加勒参加了珍珠港 75 周年纪念活动，以表彰和纪念内华达号航空母舰及其服役人员。海军称，此次袭击共有 76 名水手和海军陆战队员丧生。

paras.en: After the war, Galle got married and opened a refrigeration and air-conditioning business in Grafton, N.D. He then served as a civil engineer with the air force and then later worked for the Army Corps of Engineers. He retired in the 1980s.
paras.zh: 战后，加勒结婚了，并在北达科他州格拉夫顿开了一家制冷和空调公司。随后，他在空军担任土木工程师，后来在陆军工程兵团工作。他于 20 世纪 80 年代退休。

paras.en: Johnson's death was confirmed by one of his daughters, Diane Johnson.
paras.zh: 约翰逊的女儿黛安·约翰逊证实了他的死讯。

paras.en: An explosion erupts at the Naval Air Station on Ford Island, as the USS Shaw explodes in the centre background during the 1941 attack on Pearl Harbor. The USS Nevada is also visible in the middle background, with its bow headed toward the left. (Fox Photos/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 1941 年珍珠港袭击期间，福特岛海军航空站发生爆炸，中央背景中的肖尔号航空母舰爆炸。中间背景中还可以看到内华达号航空母舰，其船头朝向左侧。 （福克斯照片/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Johnson was working on a boiler of the USS St. Louis when the Japanese surprise attack occurred. In a May 2026 interview with The Associated Press, Johnson said he didn't hear or see the attack. He never heard his shipmates firing anti-aircraft guns at the attacking planes.
paras.zh: 日本突然袭击发生时，约翰逊正在圣路易斯号航空母舰的锅炉上工作。约翰逊在 2026 年 5 月接受美联社采访时表示，他没有听到或看到袭击事件。他从未听到他的战友用高射炮向攻击机开火。

paras.en: "While all the rigamarole was going on topside, I was inside a steam drum. Couldn't see anything, absolutely nothing," said Johnson.
paras.zh: “当所有的通心粉都在顶部进行时，我却在蒸汽鼓内。看不到任何东西，绝对什么都没有，”约翰逊说。

paras.en: - Descendants say reviving Japanese Canadian veterans' Legion rights historical wrong
paras.zh: - 后代表示，恢复日裔加拿大退伍军人的军团权利历史错误

paras.en: - Video Trump to Japan's PM: 'Why didn’t you tell me about Pearl Harbor?'
paras.zh: - 视频特朗普对日本首相：“你为什么不告诉我珍珠港事件？”

paras.en: While Johnson didn't see the Pearl Harbor attack, he was witness to other historic moments during the war.
paras.zh: 虽然约翰逊没有亲眼目睹珍珠港袭击事件，但他目睹了战争期间的其他历史时刻。

paras.en: He helped commission the USS Iowa and recalled the battleship's preparations in November 1943 ahead of transporting President Franklin D. Roosevelt to the Tehran Conference with British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Josef Stalin.
paras.zh: 他帮助爱荷华号战舰投入使用，并回顾了 1943 年 11 月在运送富兰克林·罗斯福总统与英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林一起参加德黑兰会议之前这艘战舰的准备工作。

paras.en: He also witnessed the war's end while aboard the Iowa. He was on its mast on Sept. 2, 1945, watching the surrender ceremonies about a mile away on the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay.
paras.zh: 他还在爱荷华号上目睹了战争的结束。 1945 年 9 月 2 日，他站在桅杆上，观看一英里外东京湾密苏里号航空母舰上的投降仪式。

paras.en: "I could see the boats coming up with the marines escorting the Japanese onto the ship and sitting around a table," he said. "It was all over."
paras.zh: “我可以看到载有海军陆战队的船只出现，护送日本人上船，并坐在桌子周围，”他说。 “一切都结束了。”

paras.en: For all the attention to Pearl Harbor, the gruff Johnson, who was known for his cackling laugh and mischievous smile, didn't see it as one of the defining moments in his life.
paras.zh: 尽管珍珠港事件备受关注，但以咯咯笑和顽皮微笑而闻名的粗暴约翰逊并不认为这是他一生中的决定性时刻之一。

paras.en: Those would have been getting married after the war to his late wife and having three daughters. He worked for years in a machinist shop, then in a convenience store and, finally, delivering meals to seniors. He finally retired from all work at age 90.
paras.zh: 战后他与已故的妻子结婚并生了三个女儿。他在一家机械店工作了多年，然后在一家便利店工作，最后为老年人送餐。他终于在90岁时退休了。

articles.title: Turkey takes control of opposition broadcaster Sozcu TV

paras.en: Another important opposition media outlet in Turkey has been placed under state control. On Tuesday morning, authorities raided the offices of the television broadcaster Sozcu TV and the news portal Sozcu.com.tr, and arrested several executives.
paras.zh: 土耳其另一家重要的反对派媒体已置于国家控制之下。周二上午，当局突袭了电视广播公司 Sozcu TV 和新闻门户网站 Sozcu.com.tr 的办公室，并逮捕了几名高管。

paras.en: A trustee has also been appointed: The state deposit protection fund, TMSF, which usually administers the assets of insolvent companies, has been put in charge. Sozcu was one of the last big media companies in Turkey to regularly report critically on the government of President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
paras.zh: 还任命了一名受托人：通常管理破产公司资产的国家存款保护基金TMSF已被任命为负责人。 Sozcu 是土耳其最后一批定期批评雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总统政府的大型媒体公司之一。

paras.en: A large police contingent raided the broadcaster's headquarters in Istanbul, with counterterrorism officers searching the offices. According to Sozcu, its chairwoman, Funda Tuncer Sidali, and Asim Akgul, the former chief executive of the Sozcu group, were among those arrested.
paras.zh: 一支大型​​警察特遣队突袭了该广播公司位于伊斯坦布尔的总部，反恐官员搜查了办公室。据 Sozcu 称，被捕者包括其董事长 Funda Tuncer Sidali 和 Sozcu 集团前首席执行官阿西姆·阿克古尔 (Asim Akgul)。

paras.en: The broadcaster did not initially announce the appointment of the trustee on its digital channels. It did call on its audience to follow it under a new account. The leader of the main opposition party, Ozgur Ozel, declared on X: "You will never be able to prevent this nation's voice from rising, its rebellion from being heard, its cry from echoing."
paras.zh: 该广播公司最初并未在其数字频道上宣布受托人的任命。它确实呼吁观众在新帐户下关注它。主要反对党领导人奥兹古尔·奥泽尔 (Ozgur Ozel) 在 X 上宣称：“你永远无法阻止这个国家的声音上升，它的叛逆被听到，它的呼声回响。”

paras.en: The Istanbul public prosecutor's office has confirmed the arrangements. It justified the investigation with claims of a suspected connection between the owner of Sozcu, Burak Akhay, and the Gülen movement. The Turkish government blames this movement, which was once allied to Erdogan, for the attempted coup in 2016, and has designated it a terrorist organization.
paras.zh: 伊斯坦布尔检察官办公室已经确认了这一安排。它声称 Sozcu 的所有者 Burak Akhay 与葛兰运动之间存在可疑联系，从而证明了调查的合理性。土耳其政府将2016年的未遂政变归咎于这个曾经与埃尔多安结盟的运动，并将其列为恐怖组织。

paras.en: According to the investigators, Akbay is said to have used foreign bank accounts to finance two companies involved in media activities on behalf of the Gülen movement. They claim there is strong suspicion that he was able, in this way, to hold a leadership position in the organization.
paras.zh: 据调查人员称，阿克拜据称利用外国银行账户为两家代表葛兰运动参与媒体活动的公司提供资金。他们声称，人们强烈怀疑他能够通过这种方式在该组织中担任领导职务。

paras.en: It is not new for the Turkish state to take over media organizations by appointing trustees. Many media companies accused of being close to the Gülen movement were brought under state control in this way after the attempted coup in 2016. What is new is that for about a year now this is also happening to media seen as pro-opposition.
paras.zh: 对于土耳其政府来说，通过任命受托人来接管媒体机构并不是什么新鲜事。 2016年政变未遂后，许多被指控与葛兰运动关系密切的媒体公司都以这种方式受到国家控制。新的情况是，大约一年来，这种情况也发生在被视为亲反对派的媒体身上。

paras.en: Sozcu is not the first opposition broadcaster to be targeted by the authorities. The TELEI TV channel was searched on October 24, 2025. Its editor-in-chief, Merdan Yanardag, was arrested on charges of espionage and remains in custody. The offices of Halk TV were raided on October 14 this year. There, too, a trustee was put in charge.
paras.zh: Sozcu并不是第一家成为当局打击目标的反对派广播公司。 TELEI 电视频道于 2025 年 10 月 24 日遭到搜查。其主编 Merdan Yanardag 因间谍罪被捕，目前仍被拘留。今年10月14日，Halk TV的办公室遭到突击搜查。那里也任命了一名受托人负责。

paras.en: In the space of just over a year, three of the most important opposition television channels have been brought under state control. Observers see this as another step toward an increasingly authoritarian and politically isolated system.
paras.zh: 在短短一年多的时间里，三个最重要的反对派电视频道已被置于国家控制之下。观察人士认为，这是朝着日益独裁和政治孤立的体系迈出的又一步。

paras.en: Berk Esen, a political scientist with Sabanci University in Istanbul, sees these measures as a significant weakening of the opposition in the public domain.
paras.zh: 伊斯坦布尔萨班吉大学政治学家伯克·埃森认为，这些措施大大削弱了公共领域的反对派。

paras.en: Esen told DW that the government may first have acted behind the scenes and tried to bring Sozcu to heel politically. When this didn't succeed, it invoked the judiciary. Esen says Turkey is increasingly moving toward an authoritarian system. The attempt to prevent opposition organizations and media from gaining strength and influence is part of this.
paras.zh: 埃森告诉德国之声，政府可能首先在幕后采取行动，试图在政治上让索兹库就范。当这没有成功时，它诉诸了司法部门。埃森表示，土耳其正日益走向独裁制度。试图阻止反对派组织和媒体获得力量和影响力就是其中的一部分。

paras.en: Esen describes the opposition's success in local government elections in March 2024 as a political turning point. Since then, he says, the government has seen its chances of winning political competitions at the ballot box receding. "It's become harder for the AKP to win elections," says Esen. "That's why it's attacking the opposition and the free media both at once."
paras.zh: 埃森将反对派在 2024 年 3 月地方政府选举中的成功描述为一个政治转折点。他说，从那时起，政府发现在选举中赢得政治竞争的机会越来越小。 “正义与发展党赢得选举变得越来越困难，”埃森说。 “这就是为什么它同时攻击反对派和自由媒体。”

paras.en: Several opposition mayors have also been arrested in recent months and replaced by trustees. They include the mayor of Istanbul and presidential candidate Ekrem Imamoglu, who has been in detention since his arrest in March last year. He is regarded as one of Erdogan's most promising challengers.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，几位反对派市长也被捕，并由受托人取代。其中包括伊斯坦布尔市长和总统候选人埃克雷姆·伊玛莫格鲁（Ekrem Imamoglu），后者自去年 3 月被捕以来一直被拘留。他被认为是埃尔多安最有前途的挑战者之一。

paras.en: The Turkish Journalists' Association (TGC) spoke of a "black winter for press freedom," and announced its solidarity with all those affected. It described the recent developments as a serious attack on press freedom. The fact that a trustee had been appointed, first at Halk TV and now at Sozcu, showed how the media climate in Turkey has deteriorated, it said.
paras.zh: 土耳其记者协会（TGC）谈到“新闻自由的黑色冬天”，并宣布与所有受影响的人站在一起。它将最近的事态发展描述为对新闻自由的严重攻击。据称，先是在 Halk TV 任命了一名受托人，现在又在 Sozcu 任命了一名受托人，这一事实表明土耳其的媒体氛围已经恶化。

paras.en: "These days, too, shall pass," the TGC declared. "When that day comes, those journalists who seek the truth today will be remembered, as will the decisions that prevent the public from hearing that truth."
paras.zh: “这些日子也会过去，”TGC 宣称。 “当那一天到来时，那些今天寻求真相的记者将被记住，阻止公众听到真相的决定也将被记住。”

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: EU and UK strike 'landmark deal' to strengthen ties after Brexit

paras.en: European Union top officials and UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced deals on trade and youth mobility at Friday's Brussels summit.
paras.zh: 欧盟高级官员和英国首相安迪·伯纳姆在周五的布鲁塞尔峰会上宣布了有关贸易和青年流动的协议。

paras.en: This might be the first step to rebuild ties, a decade after Britain voted to leave the EU.
paras.zh: 这可能是英国公投脱欧十年后重建关系的第一步。

paras.en: During the delegations' meeting, Burnham said the deal was a "landmark agreement," while European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called it a "turning point" in relations.
paras.zh: 在代表团会议上，伯纳姆表示该协议是一项“具有里程碑意义的协议”，而欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩则称其为关系的“转折点”。

paras.en: 'A good day for Britain' and 'A good day for Europe'
paras.zh: “英国美好的一天”和“欧洲美好的一天”

paras.en: "This is a good day for Britain. This is a good day for Europe," Burnham said.
paras.zh: “这对英国来说是美好的一天。这对欧洲来说也是美好的一天，”伯纳姆说。

paras.en: Speaking at the joint press conference, European Council President Antonio Costa said the bloc respected the British decision to leave the EU and would respect its choice to strengthen ties in the post-Brexit era.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔在联合新闻发布会上表示，欧盟尊重英国脱欧决定，并将尊重英国在后脱欧时代加强关系的选择。

paras.en: He said jokingly that the EU and UK "may drive on the opposite sides of the road, but what matters is they are heading for the same direction."
paras.zh: 他开玩笑说，欧盟和英国“可能在路的两侧行驶，但重要的是他们正朝着同一个方向行驶”。

paras.en: Burnham said that the deals were made with young people in mind, adding: "This deal is for you. This deal really is about lifting your life chances."
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示，这些交易是为了年轻人而制定的，并补充道：“这笔交易是为你而做的。这笔交易确实是为了提高你的生活机会。”

paras.en: 'Brexit took opportunities from young people'
paras.zh: “英国脱欧夺走了年轻人的机会”

paras.en: He went further and said "Brexit took opportunities from young people," and that they have to "open up new opportunities" for young people.
paras.zh: 他进一步表示，“英国脱欧夺走了年轻人的机会”，他们必须为年轻人“开辟新的机会”。

paras.en: Von der Leyen said the youth experience project would "open horizons and create friendships that will last a lifetime."
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩表示，青年体验项目将“开拓视野，建立终生的友谊”。

paras.en: She said the trade agreement is a "two way street" and it means "more choice for the customers."
paras.zh: 她表示，贸易协议是一条“双向路”，意味着“为客户提供更多选择”。

paras.en: Von der Leyen also mentioned the agreement on the carbon market, saying that it would cut emissions and generate investments in cleaner industries.
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩还提到了碳市场协议，称这将减少排放并为清洁行业带来投资。

paras.en: She also said Britain will rejoin the Erasmus+ program, adding, "We miss them so much."
paras.zh: 她还表示，英国将重新加入伊拉斯谟+计划，并补充道，“我们非常想念他们。”
