paras.zh: 联合国国际移民组织加沙项目负责人卡尔·贝克周二表示：“如果没有适当的住所，没有关键的救援物品，就会发生体温过低导致的死亡。”他补充说，儿童特别容易受到伤害，因为他们失去体温的速度更快。

paras.en: He said the supply of aid has been hindered by lengthy Israeli security checks and crossing closures.
paras.zh: 他说，以色列漫长的安全检查和过境点关闭阻碍了援助的供应。

paras.en: "Gaza is turning into one large IDP camp [internally displaced persons]. It ranks as one of the worst I've walked through," he said.
paras.zh: “加沙正在变成一个大型国内流离失所者营地。这是我经历过的最糟糕的营地之一，”他说。

paras.en: - Woman, 3 children killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents
paras.zh: - 加沙沙堤塌陷压倒帐篷后，妇女和 3 名儿童丧生

paras.en: - Video Tents housing thousands of displaced families flooded in Gaza
paras.zh: - 视频 加沙数千名流离失所家庭的帐篷被洪水淹没

paras.en: Back at the Kuwaiti Hospital, Arqiq carried his son to the hospital's courtyard, where a funeral prayer was held. The little shrouded body lay on a coat on the ground in front of rows of family, friends and passersby lined up to pray before the body was carried to its grave.
paras.zh: 回到科威特医院后，阿尔奇克抱着儿子来到医院的庭院，在那里举行了葬礼祈祷。这具裹着裹尸布的小尸体躺在地上的一件外套上，在尸体被运往坟墓之前，一排排的家人、朋友和路人排队祈祷。

paras.en: “He was like a flower,” Arqiq said, tears rolling down his cheeks.
paras.zh: “他就像一朵花，”阿尔奇克说，泪水从他的脸颊上滚落。

paras.en: With files from CBC's Mohamed El Saife and Reuters
paras.zh: 来自 CBC 的 Mohamed El Saife 和路透社的文件

articles.title: 'Humanitarian mission' for Kostiantynivka: Is it a trap?

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed a humanitarian mission in the city of Kostiantynivka similar to a recent operation in Oleshky. According to Putin, Russia has control of the city in the Donbas; the remaining civilian population, he says, could be evacuated. It would take five days to clear the access roads. The Russian leader has suggested that human rights organizations from Ukraine and Russia and delegates from the foreign press be incorporated into the mission.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京提议在科斯蒂亚特尼夫卡市执行人道主义任务，类似于最近在奥列什基执行的行动。据普京称，俄罗斯控制着顿巴斯城市；他说，剩余的平民可以被疏散。清理通道需要五天时间。俄罗斯领导人建议将乌克兰和俄罗斯的人权组织以及外国媒体的代表纳入代表团。

paras.en: Putin's proposal comes after discussions between the Russian government and US representatives, who have been negotiating to try to bring an end to Russia's war against Ukraine. Experts say that while Russia is indicating a readiness to make agreements, at the same time it is propagating its own depiction of the situation on the front line.
paras.zh: 普京的提议是在俄罗斯政府和美国代表进行讨论之后提出的，俄罗斯政府和美国代表一直在进行谈判，试图结束俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争。专家表示，俄罗斯在表示愿意达成协议的同时，也在宣传自己对前线局势的描述。

paras.en: In July, Russia announced that it had taken Kostiantynivka but did not provide any proof. Ukraine says the fighting there is still ongoing. Experts from the Ukrainian open-source interactive map of military operations project DeepState say that the city is still controlled by the Ukrainian army, but that the situation there is "extremely difficult."
paras.zh: 7月，俄罗斯宣布占领科斯蒂亚特尼夫卡，但没有提供任何证据。乌克兰表示，那里的战斗仍在继续。乌克兰军事行动开源互动地图项目 DeepState 的专家表示，该城市仍由乌克兰军队控制，但那里的局势“极其困难”。

paras.en: Responding to the proposal, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told journalists: "Putin simply wants us to leave Kostiantynivka so that they can move in and occupy the entire city." He emphasized that Ukraine had always given the civilian population in Kostiantynivka opportunities to leave, and said that Russia had used the temporary ceasefire in Oleshky to bring military equipment and weapons into the city.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基在回应这一提议时对记者表示：“普京只是希望我们离开科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡，以便他们能够搬进来并占领整个城市。”他强调，乌克兰一直给予科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡平民离开的机会，并表示俄罗斯利用奥列什基的临时停火将军事装备和武器带入该市。

paras.en: Kostiantynivka is the southernmost city in the so-called Donetsk "fortress belt," which also includes Druzhkivka, Kramatorsk and Sloviansk. Taking Kostiantynivka would open the way for Russian troops to advance to Druzhkivka, and on to the conurbation of Sloviansk and Kramatorsk.
paras.zh: 科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡是所谓顿涅茨克“要塞带”最南端的城市，该地区还包括德鲁日基夫卡、克拉马托尔斯克和斯洛维安斯克。占领科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡将为俄罗斯军队向德鲁日基夫卡以及斯洛维斯克和克拉马托尔斯克大都市进军开辟道路。

paras.en: Oleksandr Kovalenko, a military expert at the Dmytro Tymchuk Center for Security Studies, a Ukrainian think tank, said Kostiantynivka's role is similar to that of Bakhmut, Avdiivka or Chasiv Yar — towns whose defensive installations were able to hold back Russian enemy forces for years.
paras.zh: 乌克兰智库德米特罗·蒂姆丘克安全研究中心的军事专家奥列克桑德·科瓦连科表示，科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡的作用与巴赫穆特、阿夫季夫卡或恰西夫亚尔的作用类似，这些城镇的防御设施能够多年来阻挡俄罗斯敌军。

paras.en: Local authorities say the humanitarian situation in the city, whose population before the start of Russia's full-scale invasion was around 70,000, is catastrophic and that some 340 civilians remain. They add thatKostiantynivkahas no central water, electricity or gas supplies, there is no public transport, and since the spring of 2026 people have only been able to evacuate on foot.
paras.zh: 地方当局表示，该市的人道主义状况是灾难性的，在俄罗斯全面入侵之前，该市人口约为 7 万，目前仍有约 340 名平民。他们补充说，科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡没有中央水、电或燃气供应，没有公共交通，自 2026 年春季以来，人们只能步行撤离。

paras.en: "Those who stayed in Kostiantynivka need to be evacuated, they need a chance of a better life," military analyst Denys Popovych told DW. However, he added that an evacuation was virtually impossible without a ceasefire, as Russian troops had occupied the road between the town and Druzhkivka and drones were being deployed throughout the region. Ukraine, therefore, could not carry out such an operation unilaterally. "It still takes two to tango — to evacuate the people, that is," he said.
paras.zh: 军事分析家丹尼斯·波波维奇告诉德国之声：“那些留在科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡的人需要撤离，他们需要有机会过上更好的生活。”不过，他补充说，如果没有停火，撤离几乎是不可能的，因为俄罗斯军队已经占领了该镇和德鲁日基夫卡之间的道路，并且无人机正在整个地区部署。因此，乌克兰不能单方面实施这样的行动。 “仍然需要两个人来探戈——也就是说，疏散人员，”他说。

paras.en: Kovalenko believes that Moscow is simply using the humanitarian issue for purposes of manipulation and to strengthen its negotiating position. The Russian army, he said, wants to gain time in order to reinforce units fighting in the vicinity.
paras.zh: 科瓦连科认为，莫斯科只是利用人道主义问题来进行操纵，以加强其谈判地位。他说，俄罗斯军队希望赢得时间来增援在附近作战的部队。

paras.en: Yevhen Zakharov, the director of the Kharkiv Human Rights Protection Group, has similar concerns. "I'm afraid that this proposal by the Russians has very different objectives to those they claim to pursue," he told DW. He described Putin's initiative as suspect, and said the Ukrainian side should treat it with the utmost caution.
paras.zh: 哈尔科夫人权保护组织主任叶夫亨·扎哈罗夫也有类似的担忧。他告诉德国之声：“恐怕俄罗斯人提出的这一提议与他们声称追求的目标有很大不同。”他称普京的举措值得怀疑，并表示乌克兰方面应极其谨慎地对待这一举措。

paras.en: Kyiv is in a difficult position, as the idea of a mission for Kostiantynivka is also being pushed by US intermediaries. "If we reject it, they'll say to us: 'You're rejecting peace proposals, you're not taking care of your own citizens, why should we keep talking to you, Zelenskyy wants to continue the war.' This is precisely the calculation behind it all," said Popovych.
paras.zh: 基辅的处境很困难，因为美国中间人也在推动派出科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡任务的想法。 “如果我们拒绝，他们会对我们说：‘你们拒绝和平建议，你们没有照顾自己的公民，我们为什么要继续和你们谈话，泽连斯基想继续战争。’”这正是这一切背后的计算。”波波维奇说道。

paras.en: After the end of the ceasefire in Oleshky, which was in place from October 27 to November 1, the Ukrainian General Staff announced that, in that time, the Russians had rotated their troops, entrenched their positions, reinforced measures to repel drones and brought in ammunition.
paras.zh: 10月27日至11月1日在奥列什基停火结束后，乌克兰总参谋部宣布，俄罗斯人在此期间轮换了部队，巩固了阵地，加强了击退无人机的措施并运来了弹药。

paras.en: Kovalenko is convinced that the reason Russia is proposing a ceasefire is because its army is gradually losing ground in Kostiantynivka. From Moscow's perspective, the Russian troops that are meant to be storming the city are in urgent need of reinforcements, which they can't get because of the fighting on the ground.
paras.zh: 科瓦连科确信，俄罗斯之所以提出停火，是因为其军队在科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡逐渐失势。从莫斯科方面来看，本应攻入该城的俄军急需增援，但由于地面战斗而无法获得增援。

paras.en: "If a so-called humanitarian mission were to take place in Kostiantynivka, it would be a disaster for Kyiv, because Russia would use that time to consolidate forces that would enable it to take the city," he warned.
paras.zh: 他警告说：“如果在科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡执行所谓的人道主义任务，这对基辅来说将是一场灾难，因为俄罗斯将利用这段时间巩固部队，使其能够占领这座城市。”

paras.en: How should Kyiv respond to Moscow's proposal?
paras.zh: 基辅应如何回应莫斯科的提议？

paras.en: Popovych, however, does not think Ukraine should reject the Russian proposal. In his view, Kyiv should base its tactics on experiences with previous ceasefires and insist on very clear conditions in advance. "If there is a ceasefire, soldiers currently at their posts should stay there and not move," he suggested.
paras.zh: 然而，波波维奇并不认为乌克兰应该拒绝俄罗斯的提议。他认为，基辅的策略应该以以往停火的经验为基础，并事先坚持非常明确的条件。他建议：“如果停火，目前坚守岗位的士兵应该留在原地，不要移动。”

paras.en: Oleksandr Pavlichenko from the Ukrainian Helsinki Human Rights Union believes Ukraine should submit a counter-proposal, which envisages the withdrawal of Russian troops from the Ukrainian city and the unimpeded departure of the civilian population.
paras.zh: 乌克兰赫尔辛基人权联盟的亚历山大·帕夫利琴科认为，乌克兰应该提交一份反提案，设想俄罗斯军队从乌克兰城市撤军，并让平民不受阻碍地离开。

paras.en: The human rights activist said that, for a genuine humanitarian mission to be put in place, a strong, neutral third party should be brought in to supervise and ensure safe passage. In his view, the only party with such a mandate is the International Committee of the Red Cross. "If a proposal comes from only one side, and from a side such as Russia, it doesn't inspire confidence," he said.
paras.zh: 这位人权活动人士表示，为了落实真正的人道主义使命，应该聘请一个强大、中立的第三方来监督和确保安全通行。他认为，唯一拥有这一授权的机构是红十字国际委员会。 “如果一项提案仅来自一方，而且来自俄罗斯等一方，它就不会激发信心，”他说。

paras.en: This article was originally written in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用乌克兰语写的。

articles.title: White House replaces cyber security chief after tech outages

paras.en: Sean Cairncross is exiting his post as White House national cyber director after a series of technology-related outages in the United States over the week led to disruptions in air travel, banking and national security networks.
paras.zh: 肖恩·凯恩克罗斯 (Sean Cairncross) 即将辞去白宫国家网络总监一职，此前一周美国发生了一系列与技术相关的故障，导致航空旅行、银行和国家安全网络中断。

paras.en: Shortly after Axios and other US news outlets first reported Cairncross' departure on Friday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the Pentagon's Chief Information Officer, Kirsten Davies, as the new cyber director, congratulating her on X.
paras.zh: 在 Axios 和其他美国新闻媒体周五首次报道凯恩克罗斯离职后不久，国务卿马可·鲁比奥宣布五角大楼首席信息官克尔斯滕·戴维斯担任新任网络主管，并祝贺她获得 X.

paras.en: "Look forward to working together to strengthen America's cybersecurity," Rubio said.
paras.zh: “期待共同努力加强美国的网络安全，”卢比奥说。

paras.en: Davies will assume the position in an acting capacity, media outlets reported citing White House officials.
paras.zh: 媒体援引白宫官员的话说，戴维斯将以代理身份担任这一职务。

paras.en: "Our nation stands in the crossroad of analog, digital, and quantum technologies, our American way of living increasingly interconnected," Davies wrote on X late Thursday night, as she thanked US President Donald Trump and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller for their "faith and steady confidence" in her.
paras.zh: “我们的国家正处于模拟、数字和量子技术的十字路口，我们美国的生活方式日益相互联系，”戴维斯周四晚间在 X 上写道，她感谢美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和白宫幕僚长斯蒂芬·米勒对她的“信任和坚定的信心”。

paras.en: "Our opportunity is to dominate the cyber landscape for generations to come …but only if we modernize and drive resilience into the foundations our great nation runs on, as well as build cyber talent for our future."
paras.zh: “我们的机会是主宰子孙后代的网络格局……但前提是我们实现现代化，将弹性融入我们伟大国家赖以生存的基础，并为我们的未来培养网络人才。”

paras.en: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth referred to Davies' tenure at the Pentagon as one in which "she has proven herself to be a dedicated patriot and professional."
paras.zh: 美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯称戴维斯在五角大楼的任期“证明了自己是一位忠诚的爱国者和专业人士”。

paras.en: "We are confident she will advance President Trump's America First agenda across the cybersecurity landscape," the Pentagon chief said.
paras.zh: 五角大楼负责人表示：“我们相信她将在网络安全领域推进特朗普总统的美国优先议程。”

paras.en: The Trump administration came under scrutiny in recent days after the US witnessed a major tech meltdown as service outages affected not just travel, communications, and e-commerce, but also the National Security Agency.
paras.zh: 最近几天，在美国目睹了一场重大科技崩溃后，特朗普政府受到了密切关注，因为服务中断不仅影响了旅行、通信和电子商务，还影响了国家安全局。

paras.en: Top US officials have since sought to assure people in the country that there was no evidence of a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 此后，美国高级官员一直试图向国内民众保证，没有证据表明存在网络攻击。

paras.en: In 2025, Trump nominated Cairncross to serve as his top adviser on cybersecurity and data protection policy. He was subsequently confirmed to the post by the Senate.
paras.zh: 2025年，特朗普提名凯恩克罗斯担任网络安全和数据保护政策的高级顾问。随后，他得到参议院的确认。

paras.en: During Trump's first stint in the Oval Office, Cairncross took on various roles as a White House insider. He was also an executive at the Republican National Committee before becoming the cybersecurity chief.
paras.zh: 在特朗普首次入主椭圆形办公室期间，凯恩克罗斯作为白宫内部人士担任过各种角色。在成为网络安全主管之前，他还曾担任共和党全国委员会的高管。

articles.title: China's Xi praises 'turnaround' in relationship with Australia

paras.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and Chinese President Xi Jinping held talks on Friday, following which Xi hailed a "comprehensive turnaround" in the ties between two nations and Albanese said his country was engaging "constructively" with Beijing.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞和中国国家主席习近平周五举行会谈，随后习近平称赞两国关系出现“全面转变”，阿尔巴内塞表示澳大利亚正在与北京进行“建设性”接触。

paras.en: The leaders met on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Forum (APEC) summit in China's Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 两国领导人在中国深圳举行的亚太经济论坛（APEC）峰会期间举行了会晤。

paras.en: Xi pointed out to Albanese that they had met four times since the latter became Australia's Prime Minister in 2022.
paras.zh: 习近平向阿尔巴内斯指出，自阿尔巴内斯2022年就任澳大利亚总理以来，双方已举行四次会晤。

paras.en: "I think it is fair to say that together we have brought about a comprehensive turnaround in China-Australia relations," the Chinese President said.
paras.zh: “我认为，可以公平地说，我们共同推动了中澳关系的全面转圜，”中国国家主席说。

paras.en: Xi also called for enhancing cooperation in agriculture, energy, the green economy and artificial intelligence, Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported.
paras.zh: 据中国官方通讯社新华社报道，习近平还呼吁加强农业、能源、绿色经济和人工智能领域的合作。

paras.en: China is Australia's top trading partner.
paras.zh: 中国是澳大利亚最大的贸易伙伴。

paras.en: The relations between the two countries hit rock bottom under Canberra's former centre-right coalition government, which had called for an independent inquiry into the origins of the coronavirus.
paras.zh: 在堪培拉前中右翼联合政府的领导下，两国关系跌至谷底，该政府曾呼吁对冠状病毒的起源进行独立调查。

paras.en: An angry China retaliated by imposing import curbs worth $13 billion (€12.2 billion) on Australian timber, coal, barley, lobsters and wine.
paras.zh: 愤怒的中国进行报复，对澳大利亚木材、煤炭、大麦、龙虾和葡萄酒实施价值 130 亿美元（122 亿欧元）的进口限制。

paras.en: Since Albanese's centre-left Labor party came to power, China has lifted most of its blocks on Australian exports.
paras.zh: 自阿尔巴内斯的中左翼工党上台以来，中国解除了对澳大利亚出口的大部分限制。

paras.en: But friction in ties has surfaced occasionally on issues such as China conducting a missile test in the South Pacific and Australia tightening a foreign investment screening in the critical minerals sector.
paras.zh: 但在中国在南太平洋进行导弹试验以及澳大利亚收紧​​关键矿产行业的外国投资审查等问题上，两国关系偶尔会出现摩擦。

paras.en: "It is important that Australia continue to engage in a constructive way with China, manage our differences, but not be defined by them," Albanese told the media on Friday.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯周五对媒体表示：“重要的是，澳大利亚继续以建设性方式与中国接触，管理我们的分歧，但不要被分歧所定义。”

paras.en: "What happens in China does matter for Australia," he added.
paras.zh: “中国发生的事情对澳大利亚来说很重要，”他补充道。

paras.en: Albanese is expected to travel to Beijing and meet China's Premier Li Qiang later on Friday.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯预计将于周五晚些时候前往北京并会见中国总理李强。

paras.en: On Monday, Australia, which is the world's biggest producer of iron ore, called out China's "manipulation" of trade in the commodity over Beijing's formation of a central buying body to purchase ore on behalf of its steelmakers.
paras.zh: 周一，全球最大的铁矿石生产国澳大利亚指责中国“操纵”大宗商品贸易，因为北京成立了一个代表其钢铁制造商购买矿石的中央采购机构。

paras.en: A single buyer has increased bargaining power in negotiations with sellers.
paras.zh: 单一买家在与卖家的谈判中增加了议价能力。

paras.en: Albanese and Li will attend a business roundtable comprising of senior executives from Australian mining giants Rio Tinto and BHP and Chinese company executives.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯和李将参加由澳大利亚矿业巨头力拓和必和必拓的高管以及中国公司高管组成的商业圆桌会议。

articles.title: Sandpapergate: Australian gov’t demands CA to ensure transparency in forum

paras.en: Cricket Australia (CA) should ensure its forum into Sandpapergate is handled as independently and openly as possible, a government spokesperson said on Friday, as former players slammed the governing body’s attempts to defuse an escalating controversy surrounding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal.
paras.zh: 政府发言人周五表示，澳大利亚板球协会 (CA) 应确保其有关 Sandpapergate 的论坛尽可能独立和公开地处理，因为前球员们抨击了管理机构试图平息围绕 2018 年球篡改丑闻的不断升级的争议。

paras.en: CA bosses said on Wednesday that an independent forum would be set up to allow players to give their accounts of the incident, but the results would not necessarily be made public and no sanctions would follow.
paras.zh: CA老板周三表示，将设立一个独立论坛，让球员对这一事件进行陈述，但结果不一定会公开，也不会采取任何制裁措施。

paras.en: The move has been ridiculed by past players and pundits, including former captain Michael Clarke, who said the Australian public had been lied to about who was party to the cheating during the 2018 South Africa Test series.
paras.zh: 此举遭到了过去球员和专家的嘲笑，其中包括前队长迈克尔·克拉克(Michael Clarke)，他表示澳大利亚公众在2018年南非测试系列赛期间作弊的一方被欺骗了。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Sport Minister Anika Wells said integrity mattered to “every kid with a bat or a ball”.
paras.zh: 体育部长阿尼卡·威尔斯的发言人表示，诚信对于“每个拥有球棒或球的孩子”都很重要。

paras.en: “This is Cricket Australia’s process to run and it is a matter for them to work through. Australians will expect this to be run independently and as openly as possible,” the spokesperson said in a statement.
paras.zh: “这是澳大利亚板球协会的运作流程，是他们需要解决的问题。澳大利亚人希望这一切能够独立且尽可能公开地运作，”发言人在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: “We have a summer of cricket to look forward to and I’m sure all of Australia will get behind our team.”
paras.zh: “我们将迎来一个充满板球比赛的夏天，我相信整个澳大利亚都会支持我们的球队。”

paras.en: CA did not provide immediate comment when asked by the Reuters news agency on Friday for more details about its forum.
paras.zh: 当路透社周五询问有关其论坛的更多细节时，CA 没有立即发表评论。

paras.en: The eight-year-old Sandpapergate scandal has reignited this month following allegations by former Australia batter Usman Khawaja that other players and staff knew of the ball-tampering – not just the three who were found culpable and sanctioned after a rapid investigation by CA’s integrity unit during the South Africa tour.
paras.zh: 长达八年之久的“沙纸门”丑闻本月重新燃起，前澳大利亚击球手乌斯曼·哈瓦贾（Usman Khawaja）指控其他球员和工作人员知道球篡改事件，而不仅仅是在南非巡回赛期间经过CA诚信部门迅速调查后发现有罪并受到制裁的三人。

paras.en: CA banned then-captain Steve Smith and David Warner for 12 months, and Cameron Bancroft for nine.
paras.zh: CA对当时的队长史蒂夫·史密斯和大卫·沃纳禁赛12个月，对卡梅伦·班克罗夫特禁赛9个月。

paras.en: Test captain Pat Cummins and fellow pace bowler Mitchell Starc have since rejected Khawaja’s allegations, saying they had no prior knowledge of ball tampering.
paras.zh: 测试队长帕特·康明斯（Pat Cummins）和同伴投球手米切尔·斯塔克（Mitchell Starc）此后否认了卡瓦贾的指控，称他们事先并不了解球篡改的情况。

paras.en: But three other players involved in the 2018 tour came forward to back up Khawaja’s account, including Warner and Bancroft, who said “the whole team” knew, including coaching staff and a media manager.
paras.zh: 但参与 2018 年巡回赛的其他三名球员站出来支持卡瓦贾的说法，其中包括华纳和班克罗夫特，他们表示“整个球队”都知道，包括教练组和一名媒体经理。

paras.en: Bancroft claimed the idea to rough up the ball with sandpaper to make it swing was Warner’s, but that the conversation had taken place “within a wider team environment”. He added that he had lied about the extent of the plot to protect CA’s investigation into the incident.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特声称用砂纸打磨球以使其摆动的想法是华纳的，但谈话是在“更广泛的团队环境内”进行的。他补充说，他对阴谋的严重程度撒了谎，以保护 CA 对该事件的调查。

paras.en: Clarke, who captained Australia from 2011 to 2015, said Bancroft’s explosive 4,000-word statement shared with the media on Wednesday had made CA’s forum redundant.
paras.zh: 克拉克曾于 2011 年至 2015 年担任澳大利亚队队长，他表示班克罗夫特周三与媒体分享的 4000 字爆炸性声明使 CA 论坛变得多余。

paras.en: “The public don’t want any more bullshit,” he said on his podcast, Beyond23.
paras.zh: “公众不想再听到任何废话了，”他在播客 Beyond23 上说道。

paras.en: “The public want the complete truth to allow us to move on.”
paras.zh: “公众希望了解完整的真相，以便我们继续前进。”

paras.en: The scandal has heaped pressure on Cummins, one of the game’s most devastating pace bowlers, who boasts a strong portfolio of corporate sponsors.
paras.zh: 这一丑闻给康明斯带来了巨大的压力，康明斯是这项运动中最具破坏性的速度保龄球手之一，拥有强大的企业赞助商组合。

paras.en: Cummins called Khawaja’s allegations “complete and utter nonsense” in an hour-long news conference last week, and criticised his former teammate for being “casual” with others’ lives and reputations.
paras.zh: 康明斯在上周长达一小时的新闻发布会上称卡瓦贾的指控“完全是无稽之谈”，并批评他的前队友对他人的生活和声誉“漫不经心”。

paras.en: He declined to comment to a large media scrum camped outside his Sydney home on Thursday and at training, but his manager said Cummins’s position remained steadfast and he had no need to respond to Bancroft’s statement.
paras.zh: 周四，他拒绝对在悉尼家外扎营的大型媒体报道和训练发表评论，但他的经理表示康明斯的立场仍然坚定，他没有必要对班克罗夫特的声明做出回应。

paras.en: A poll of 13,000 readers of Melbourne’s Herald Sun newspaper had 82 percent saying they believed Khawaja’s, Warner’s and Bancroft’s accounts of Sandpapergate, versus 18 percent for Cummins and Australia’s bowlers who denied prior knowledge.
paras.zh: 对墨尔本先驱太阳报 13,000 名读者进行的一项民意调查显示，82% 的读者表示他们相信 Khawaja、Warner 和 Bancroft 对 Sandpapergate 的描述，而康明斯和澳大利亚投球手的这一比例为 18%，他们否认事先知情。

paras.en: A majority of 6,000 readers in a poll in the Sydney Morning Herald said they did not expect Cummins to remain as captain for the first Test of the home summer against New Zealand, which starts December 9.
paras.zh: 《悉尼先驱晨报》的一项民意调查显示，6000 名读者中的大多数表示，他们预计康明斯不会在 12 月 9 日开始的主场夏季对阵新西兰的首次测试中继续担任队长。

paras.en: Former Australia bowler Mitchell Johnson said the public pressure on Cummins to stand down as captain would be too much.
paras.zh: 前澳大利亚保龄球手米切尔·约翰逊表示，公众要求康明斯辞去队长职务的压力太大了。

paras.en: “I just can’t see how his captaincy and personal brand survives this,” Johnson wrote in a column for The West Australian newspaper.
paras.zh: “我就是不明白他的队长身份和个人品牌如何能够幸存下来，”约翰逊在《西澳大利亚报》的专栏中写道。

articles.title: EU and Britain to agree steps towards relations reset

paras.en: British and European Union leaders are set to meet at a summit billed as a chance to reset relations a decade after the Brexit vote.
paras.zh: 英国和欧盟领导人将在峰会上会面，这被认为是英国脱欧公投十年后重置关系的机会。

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will meet with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and Antonio Costa, who heads the European Council, on Friday in Brussels. In the second such meeting since Britain formally left the bloc in 2020, deals on food, emissions and youth mobility are expected to be sealed.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆将于周五在布鲁塞尔会见欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔。这是自2020年英国正式脱欧以来的第二次此类会议，预计将达成有关食品、排放和青年流动性的协议。

paras.en: The previous summit in 2025 was billed as a “stable foundation” upon which to rebuild the relationship between London and Brussels. Friday’s meeting is being sold as a chance to start on a reset of relations.
paras.zh: 上一次 2025 年峰会被称为重建伦敦和布鲁塞尔关系的“稳定基础”。周五的会议被视为开始重新调整关系的机会。

paras.en: Burnham said earlier in the week that it was an “obvious truth” that Britain had lost more than it had gained from Brexit, which followed a non-binding referendum in 2016 in which 52 percent of the British public voted to leave the EU. He has signalled that a reformed relationship with Brussels is on his agenda.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆本周早些时候表示，英国在脱欧中得不偿失，这是一个“明显的事实”。2016 年举行了一次不具约束力的公投，52% 的英国公众投票决定离开欧盟。他已表示改革与布鲁塞尔的关系已列入他的议程。

paras.en: The most valuable agreement on the table concerns the cross-border exchange of animals, plants and related products. Britain has estimated that the removal of the current controls could be worth 5.1 billion pounds ($6.7bn) annually.
paras.zh: 目前最有价值的协议涉及动植物及相关产品的跨境交换。英国估计，取消现行管制每年可带来 51 亿英镑（67 亿美元）的价值。

paras.en: A potential deal on emissions trading systems could see London and Brussels mutually exempt each other from carbon border levies on goods like steel.
paras.zh: 关于排放交易体系的潜在协议可能会让伦敦和布鲁塞尔相互免除钢铁等商品的碳边境税。

paras.en: An agreement on youth mobility, which would allow 100,000 people from the EU to live and work for up to three years in the UK, and vice versa, is also reportedly set to be signed. The UK had originally wanted half that number.
paras.zh: 据报道，一项关于青年流动性的协议也即将签署，该协议将允许 10 万名欧盟人在英国生活和工作长达三年，反之亦然。英国最初想要这个数字的一​​半。

paras.en: The EU is also pushing for students to qualify for “home fees” at British universities – often one third of the international price. London, however, has only agreed to apply “significantly reduced” fees.
paras.zh: 欧盟还推动学生有资格获得英国大学的“家庭费用”——通常是国际价格的三分之一。然而，伦敦只同意“大幅降低”费用。

paras.en: The UK also wants to be part of the EU’s “Made in Europe” rules. Brussels has said it may be open to this, but it would require the UK to accept its policies. That could prove tricky for Burnham, given that the UK still hosts a significant Eurosceptic population.
paras.zh: 英国也希望成为欧盟“欧洲制造”规则的一部分。布鲁塞尔表示可能对此持开放态度，但要求英国接受其政策。鉴于英国仍然拥有大量欧洲怀疑论者，这对伯纳姆来说可能很棘手。

articles.title: The Gambia stood up for the Rohingya, now the world must act

paras.en: There are moments in history when a nation is defined not by its size, wealth, military strength or political influence, but by the courage of its conscience.
paras.zh: 在历史上的某些时刻，一个国家的定义不是由其规模、财富、军事实力或政治影响力，而是由其良心的勇气来定义。

paras.en: On Thursday, the International Court of Justice found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in northern Rakhine State, in breach of its obligations under the Genocide Convention. For the Rohingya, it is a long-overdue recognition. For The Gambia, it concludes a case our country brought to the Court seven years ago.
paras.zh: 周四，国际法院裁定缅甸对若开邦北部的罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝，违反了《种族灭绝公约》规定的义务。对于罗兴亚人来说，这是一个迟来的认可。对于冈比亚来说，它结束了我国七年前向法院提起的案件。

paras.en: The Rohingya have lived in Myanmar’s Rakhine State for generations. Their basic human rights have been systematically denied over time, leaving them stateless and subject to dehumanising rhetoric, hate speech and legal persecution. Following the Myanmar military’s “clearance operations” in 2016 and 2017, over 700,000 Rohingya fled to Bangladesh. The military killed an estimated 10,000 civilians, raped and sexually assaulted women and girls, and burned villages to the ground. There are currently 1.2 million Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh, the majority in the camps of Cox’s Bazar, and 520,000 remain in Myanmar.
paras.zh: 罗兴亚人世世代代生活在缅甸若开邦。随着时间的推移，他们的基本人权被系统性地剥夺，使他们成为无国籍人，并遭受非人性言论、仇恨言论和法律迫害。缅甸军方2016年和2017年的“清剿行动”后，超过70万罗兴亚人逃往孟加拉国。军队杀害了大约 10,000 名平民，强奸和性侵犯了妇女和女孩，并将村庄夷为平地。目前孟加拉国有 120 万罗辛亚难民，其中大部分居住在科克斯巴扎尔难民营，还有 52 万罗兴亚难民留在缅甸。

paras.en: When confronted with reports of unimaginable suffering, persecution, displacement and the destruction of communities, The Gambia chose to act. In 2018, our then Minister of Justice, Abubacarr Tambadou, visited the camps in Bangladesh as part of an Organisation of Islamic Cooperation delegation. As a former prosecutor at the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, he recognised the signs of genocide in the accounts of the survivors.
paras.zh: 当面对难以想象的苦难、迫害、流离失所和社区遭到破坏的报道时，冈比亚选择采取行动。 2018年，时任司法部长阿布巴卡尔·坦巴杜作为伊斯兰合作组织代表团的一部分访问了孟加拉国的难民营。作为卢旺达问题国际刑事法庭的前检察官，他在幸存者的叙述中认识到了种族灭绝的迹象。

paras.en: With the support of the OIC’s 57 member States, The Gambia brought the case to the International Court of Justice in November 2019. It was the first time in the court’s history that a state with no direct connection to the alleged crimes had filed a case under the 1948 Genocide Convention, which obliges all state parties to prevent and punish genocide wherever it may occur.
paras.zh: 在伊斯兰会议组织 57 个成员国的支持下，冈比亚于 2019 年 11 月将此案提交国际法院。这是该法院历史上首次由一个与所指控的罪行没有直接关系的国家根据 1948 年《灭绝种族罪公约》提起诉讼，该公约要求所有缔约国有义务防止和惩罚任何可能发生的种族灭绝行为。

paras.en: Yet, The Gambia’s action before the Court was never only about legal obligations or diplomatic considerations. We asked ourselves one fundamental question: if we remain silent in the face of such suffering, what does our silence make us?
paras.zh: 然而，冈比亚向法院提起的诉讼绝不仅仅是出于法律义务或外交考虑。我们问自己一个基本问题：如果我们面对这样的苦难保持沉默，我们的沉默会给我们带来什么？

paras.en: As Gambians, we know the value of dignity. We understand what it means to yearn for justice. We know the pain that comes when our rights are denied, and voices are silenced. Our own history of political struggle taught us that freedom, accountability and human rights are lived realities that shape the lives of us all.
paras.zh: 作为冈比亚人，我们知道尊严的价值。我们明白渴望正义意味着什么。我们知道当我们的权利被剥夺、声音被压制时会带来痛苦。我们自己的政治斗争历史告诉我们，自由、责任和人权是塑造我们所有人生活的现实。

paras.en: Perhaps that is why this case has resonated deeply with many Gambians: it speaks to our common humanity. In January, Rohingya survivors of the violence testified before the court about what they had lived through. We recognise that the fear of being driven from one’s home knows no nationality, and compassion does not stop at national boundaries.
paras.zh: 也许这就是为什么这个案例引起了许多冈比亚人的深刻共鸣：它讲述了我们共同的人性。一月份，暴力事件的罗辛亚幸存者在法庭上作证，讲述他们的经历。我们认识到，被赶出家园的恐惧不分国籍，同情心也不分国界。

paras.en: The years since the case was filed have required patience and perseverance. International justice can often move frustratingly slowly. However, the court’s order in January 2020, the rejection of Myanmar’s objections in 2022, and the interventions from 11 states (Canada, Denmark, France, Germany, the Netherlands, the UK, the Maldives, Slovenia, the DRC, Belgium, and Ireland) on how the Convention should be interpreted have reaffirmed our shared commitment.
paras.zh: 自立案以来的这些年里，需要耐心和毅力。国际正义往往进展缓慢得令人沮丧。然而，法院2020年1月的命令、2022年驳回缅甸反对意见，以及11个国家（加拿大、丹麦、法国、德国、荷兰、英国、马尔代夫、斯洛文尼亚、刚果民主共和国、比利时和爱尔兰）对《公约》应如何解释的干预，重申了我们的共同承诺。

paras.en: The judgement by the world’s highest court today is a reminder that the obligation to prevent genocide applies to every state, large or small, near or far. This is the first time in the history of the court that a state has been found responsible for committing genocide. The court concluded that the widespread rape and sexual violence committed by Myanmar’s security forces were part of the genocide, and that Myanmar failed to prevent genocide and to punish those responsible.
paras.zh: 今天世界最高法院的判决提醒我们，防止种族灭绝的义务适用于每个国家，无论大小、远近。这是该法院历史上首次认定一个国家对种族灭绝负有责任。法院的结论是，缅甸安全部队广泛实施的强奸和性暴力是种族灭绝的一部分，缅甸未能阻止种族灭绝并惩罚责任人。

paras.en: Myanmar is now under a clear obligation to comply fully with the judgement. It is required to investigate and prosecute those responsible, to facilitate the safe, voluntary and dignified return of displaced Rohingya and to protect them from discrimination and persecution. Justice for the Rohingya will also require the restoration of their citizenship and the recognition of their right to be called Rohingya.
paras.zh: 缅甸现在有明确的义务完全遵守该判决。必须调查并起诉责任人，以促进流离失所的罗兴亚人安全、自愿和有尊严地返回，并保护他们免受歧视和迫害。罗兴亚人的正义还需要恢复他们的公民身份并承认他们被称为罗兴亚人的权利。

paras.en: Parliamentarians also have a role to play. As the court made clear today, punishing genocide requires laws that explicitly criminalise it. The court has held Myanmar to that standard, and we must hold ourselves to it, too. We must ensure that genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes are fully incorporated into our domestic laws, and that our courts can try them wherever they are committed.
paras.zh: 议员也可以发挥作用。正如法院今天明确表示的那样，惩罚种族灭绝需要明确将其定为犯罪的法律。法院已让缅甸遵守这一标准，我们也必须遵守这一标准。我们必须确保将种族灭绝罪、危害人类罪和战争罪充分纳入我们的国内法，并确保我们的法院能够在任何地点对这些罪行进行审判。

paras.en: In our National Assembly, we will ask our government about the next steps, monitor Myanmar’s compliance, and ensure that The Gambia continues to press for that compliance at the United Nations and within the OIC. Other states must now step in by ensuring that Myanmar complies, supporting Rohingya refugees and ensuring they will not be sent back into danger.
paras.zh: 在我们的国民议会中，我们将询问我国政府下一步的行动，监督缅甸的遵守情况，并确保冈比亚继续在联合国和伊斯兰会议组织内敦促其遵守规定。其他国家现在必须介入，确保缅甸遵守规定，支持罗辛亚难民并确保他们不会再次陷入危险。

paras.en: As Gambians, we have chosen empathy over indifference, principle over convenience, and action over silence. The Rohingya have shown extraordinary courage and determination in their search for justice, and today international law has finally answered them. Our collective responsibility now is to call for compliance and prevent any future acts of genocide.
paras.zh: 作为冈比亚人，我们选择了同情而不是冷漠，选择了原则而不是便利，选择了行动而不是沉默。罗兴亚人在寻求正义的过程中表现出了非凡的勇气和决心，今天国际法终于给了他们答案。我们现在的集体责任是呼吁遵守并防止未来任何种族灭绝行为。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
articles.author: Charles Maynes

paras.en: Trump, Xi and Putin meet as global alliances hang in the balance
paras.zh: 特朗普、习近平和普京会面，全球联盟岌岌可危

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China, and MOSCOW, Russia — President Trump joined Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin for a trilateral summit in Shenzhen, China on Thursday. Their meeting capped two days of talks characterized by high-minded tributes to the role of great powers in maintaining peace, even though some of those powers had a role in starting some of the most intractable conflicts around the globe.
paras.zh: 中国深圳和俄罗斯莫斯科——周四，特朗普总统与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京在中国深圳举行三边峰会。他们的会议结束了为期两天的会谈，其特点是对大国在维护和平方面的作用表示崇高敬意，尽管其中一些大国在引发全球一些最棘手的冲突方面发挥了作用。

paras.en: "History tells us when great powers are at peace, the world is secure," Xi said in opening remarks before cameras. "When great powers clash, the world is in chaos."
paras.zh: “历史告诉我们，大国和平，世界就安全，”习近平在镜头前致开幕词时说道。 “当大国发生冲突时，世界就会陷入混乱。”

paras.en: Putin noted their nations could make a "significant contribution to strengthening security and stability in the world."
paras.zh: 普京指出，他们的国家可以“为加强世界安全与稳定做出重大贡献”。

paras.en: "In that sense and I think in lots of other ways, we are making history," said Trump, who called it a "special responsibility" for the three countries to work together.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“从这个意义上说，我认为从很多其他方面来说，我们正在创造历史。”他称这三个国家的合作是一项“特殊责任”。

paras.en: Yet, they offered few solutions toward peace, with the leaders laying out divergent agendas going in:
paras.zh: 然而，他们没有提出什么和平解决方案，领导人提出了不同的议程：

paras.en: Trump wanted to talk about reducing nuclear weapons and his mission to keep Iran from obtaining them; Putin was looking to push for an end to the war in Ukraine on terms favorable to Moscow; Xi was signaling he hoped to avoid wading too deep into either topic — preferring to showcase China's growing global clout with more general statements promoting peace and economic stability.
paras.zh: 特朗普想谈论削减核武器以及他阻止伊朗获得核武器的使命；普京希望以有利于莫斯科的条件推动结束乌克兰战争。习近平表示，他希望避免太深入地讨论这两个话题，而是更愿意通过促进和平与经济稳定的更笼统的声明来展示中国日益增长的全球影响力。

paras.en: There were also topics to avoid: Trump refused to engage with journalists' questions over China's alleged role in an espionage plot to smuggle in high-end Nvidia chips.
paras.zh: 还有一些话题需要回避：特朗普拒绝回答记者关于中国涉嫌参与走私高端英伟达芯片间谍活动的问题。

paras.en: In the end, the summit's key deliverable was arguably the image itself: the president of the United States gathering with authoritarian leaders from China and Russia for the first time in American history.
paras.zh: 最终，峰会的关键成果可以说是形象本身：美国总统在美国历史上首次与中国和俄罗斯的独裁领导人会面。

paras.en: Despite being billed as a summit of "groundbreaking significance" by the Chinese hosts, sit-down talks between Trump, Xi and Putin were relatively brief — with some of that time taken up by interpreters delivering simultaneous translation.
paras.zh: 尽管中国东道主将峰会宣传为具有“开创性意义”的峰会，但特朗普、习近平和普京之间的坐下来会谈相对简短——其中一些时间是由口译员进行同声传译。

paras.en: Trump's meeting with Putin lasted 42 minutes. His talks with Xi went about an hour. The trilateral group session went on for an hour and a half.
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京的会面持续了42分钟。他与习近平的会谈持续了大约一个小时。三边小组会议持续了一个半小时。

paras.en: Still, it was enough time for familiar Trump bonhomie to emerge.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这段时间已经足够让特朗普熟悉的友善态度显现出来了。

paras.en: "Who's he? He's my friend," said a smiling Trump upon seeing Putin ahead of their bilateral meeting.
paras.zh: “他是谁？他是我的朋友，”特朗普在双边会晤前见到普京时微笑着说道。

paras.en: "We've known each other for a long time," Trump added after he and the Russian leader warmly shook hands. "And I think a lot of wonderful things can come of this. Or at least start."
paras.zh: “我们认识很久了，”特朗普在与俄罗斯领导人热情握手后补充道。 “我认为这会带来很多美好的事情。或者至少开始。”

paras.en: Similarly, Trump told Xi "as long as you and I are in charge of things, we're never going to have a problem."
paras.zh: 同样，特朗普告诉习近平“只要你和我负责事情，我们就永远不会有问题。”

paras.en: Both statements were tacit admissions the clock is ticking on Trump's remaining two years in office — with change coming even sooner to Washington when Democrats take control of Congress come January.
paras.zh: 这两项声明都是默认的，特朗普的任期只剩下最后两年了——当民主党明年一月控制国会时，华盛顿的变化甚至会更快。

paras.en: The China gathering was first proposed by Putin during an October phone call with Trump — an offer to meet together with President Xi when China hosted the Asian Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) conference in China that November.
paras.zh: 这次中国聚会是普京在 10 月份与特朗普通话时首次提出的，并提议在中国于 11 月份主办亚太经合组织 (APEC) 会议时与习主席会面。

paras.en: For Putin in particular, the meeting was always going to be a coup: the latest sign that — with Trump and Xi's help — he has effectively chipped away at Western attempts to isolate him politically over his invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特别是对普京来说，这次会面总是一场政变：最新迹象表明，在特朗普和习近平的帮助下，他有效地削弱了西方因入侵乌克兰而在政治上孤立他的企图。

paras.en: Back in Moscow, state media showed footage of the three leaders huddled together seemingly on loop — proof that Russia had regained what the Kremlin sees as its rightful place among global superpowers.
paras.zh: 回到莫斯科，官方媒体播放了三位领导人似乎在循环中挤在一起的镜头——证明俄罗斯已经重新获得了克里姆林宫认为的全球超级大国中应有的地位。

paras.en: Ignored by Kremlin-friendly media were hints at more subtle power dynamics at play.
paras.zh: 对克里姆林宫友好的媒体忽视了更微妙的权力动态在发挥作用的暗示。

paras.en: Xi greeted Trump on the tarmac personally — returning a gesture Trump had given the Chinese leader during his recent visit in Washington — while Putin received a more scaled down delegation upon arrival to Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 习近平亲自在停机坪上迎接特朗普——回应了特朗普在最近访问华盛顿期间向这位中国领导人做出的姿态——而普京在抵达深圳后接待了一个规模更小的代表团。

paras.en: Similarly, Trump was offered the top spot next to Xi during the APEC group photo and sat next to Xi during the APEC dinner reception — with Putin positioned at a separate table.
paras.zh: 同样，特朗普在 APEC 合影时坐在习近平旁边，在 APEC 晚宴招待会上坐在习近平旁边，而普京则坐在单独的桌子上。

paras.en: Was it a slight to Putin? A calculated attempt to flatter Trump? A reflection of Russia's vastly weaker economy? Whatever the answer, Xi wasn't ignoring his Russian guest entirely.
paras.zh: 这是对普京的轻视吗？是精心策划的奉承特朗普吗？俄罗斯经济大幅疲软的反映？无论答案如何，习近平并没有完全忽视他的俄罗斯客人。

paras.en: The two gathered privately for two hours on Wednesday — a sit-down China-Russia watchers estimated to be their 50th meeting all told.
paras.zh: 周三，两人私下会面了两个小时——中俄观察人士静坐，估计这将是他们第 50 次会面。

paras.en: Xi and Putin also echoed each other in their public speeches — both touching on familiar themes of the dawn of a new "multipolar world" and criticizing the use of sanctions as a sign of Western influence on the wane.
paras.zh: 习近平和普京在公开讲话中也互相呼应——都谈到了新“多极世界”黎明的熟悉主题，并批评使用制裁作为西方影响力衰落的标志。

paras.en: From the outset, critics of the summit voiced concern that Trump, Xi and Putin would seek to carve the world into each country's perceived sphere of influence.
paras.zh: 从一开始，峰会的批评者就担心特朗普、习近平和普京会寻求将世界划分为各自国家的势力范围。

paras.en: In Russia, the event was billed as a potential "new Yalta" — a reference to a moment in 1945 when the leaders of the U.S., Soviet Union, and United Kingdom hastily agreed to a post-World War II order for Europe.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯，这一事件被宣传为潜在的“新雅尔塔”——指的是 1945 年美国、苏联和英国领导人仓促同意二战后欧洲秩序的时刻。

paras.en: Instead, the Shenzhen summit reflected the far more fragmented priorities of its participants.
paras.zh: 相反，深圳峰会反映出与会者的优先事项更加分散。

paras.en: Trump made no secret he hoped to include China in arms control talks — what Trump calls "denuclearization" — at a moment when key landmark nuclear treaties between Russia and the U.S. have all expired.
paras.zh: 特朗普毫不掩饰他希望将中国纳入军备控制谈判（特朗普称之为“无核化”），而此时俄罗斯和美国之间具有里程碑意义的重要核条约均已到期。

paras.en: The catch: His Chinese hosts had little interest in the issue.
paras.zh: 问题是：他的中国东道主对这个问题兴趣不大。

paras.en: Beijing has repeatedly rebuffed U.S. attempts to include it in negotiations with Russia — noting that its arsenal remains far below those of Cold War-era rivals Moscow and Washington.
paras.zh: 北京一再拒绝美国将其纳入与俄罗斯谈判的尝试，并指出其核武库仍远低于冷战时期的竞争对手莫斯科和华盛顿。

paras.en: A joint declaration released after the talks on Thursday did state that the three leaders "reaffirmed that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought." It said their governments would "conduct a dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons," but did not provide a time frame.
paras.zh: 周四会谈后发布的联合声明确实指出，三位领导人“重申核战争不可能获胜，也绝不能打”。声明称，两国政府将“就减少核风险和防止核武器扩散进行对话”，但没有提供时间表。

paras.en: Differences also extended to the war in Ukraine, where Putin had hoped to press for U.S. and Chinese support for a settlement tilted in Moscow's favor — including a redrawn security map for Europe that would amount to a rollback of NATO from Eastern Europe.
paras.zh: 分歧还延伸到了乌克兰战争，普京曾希望敦促美国和中国支持达成有利于莫斯科的解决方案，包括重新绘制欧洲安全地图，这相当于将北约从东欧撤出。

paras.en: Xi has insisted Europe have a seat at the table in any negotiated settlement. Trump has largely relied on his trusted envoys — real estate developer Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner — to hash out the complexities of any peace deal.
paras.zh: 习近平坚称欧洲在任何谈判解决方案中都拥有一席之地。特朗普在很大程度上依赖他信任的特使——房地产开发商史蒂夫·威特科夫和女婿贾里德·库什纳——来解决任何和平协议的复杂性。

paras.en: Following Trump's meeting with Putin, a Kremlin aide would only say that Ukraine had been the focus of the discussions — adding the Kremlin leader had left "in an excellent mood."
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京会面后，克里姆林宫的一名助手只表示乌克兰一直是讨论的焦点，并补充说克里姆林宫领导人离开时“心情很好”。

paras.en: Just hours earlier, Ukraine carried out a missile strike on the lone bridge linking mainland Russia to the annexed Crimean Peninsula for the third time this week — effectively disabling the structure for months to come.
paras.zh: 就在几个小时前，乌克兰对连接俄罗斯大陆和所吞并的克里米亚半岛的这座孤桥进行了本周第三次导弹袭击——实际上使该结构在未来几个月内瘫痪。

paras.en: The bridge is widely considered the Russian leader's pet project — a symbol of Russia's claim to territory illegally seized from Ukraine in 2014 rendered in steel.
paras.zh: 这座桥被广泛认为是俄罗斯领导人最喜欢的项目——象征着俄罗斯对 2014 年从乌克兰非法夺取的领土拥有主权，并用钢铁建造。

articles.title: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
articles.author: A Martínez

paras.en: Top House Democrat questions what Trump accomplished in Xi-Putin summit
paras.zh: 众议院民主党高层质疑特朗普在习普京峰会上取得的成就

paras.en: Rep. Gregory Meeks, the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, questioned Thursday what President Trump accomplished in his summit with the leaders of China and Russia, warning that the meeting could undermine U.S. alliances.
paras.zh: 众议院外交事务委员会民主党领袖、众议员格雷戈里·米克斯周四质疑特朗普总统在与中国和俄罗斯领导人的峰会上取得了什么成果，并警告称这次会议可能会破坏美国的联盟。

paras.en: "I wish he had a plan and a strategy if he was going to meet with them and goals. Apparently, he does not," Meeks told Morning Edition.
paras.zh: “如果他要实现这些目标和目标，我希望他有一个计划和策略。显然，他没有，”米克斯告诉早间版。

paras.en: His comments followed Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China, which ended with few signs of progress on nuclear arms control or the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之前，特朗普在中国深圳会见了中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，会议结束时，在核军备控制或乌克兰战争方面几乎没有取得进展的迹象。

paras.en: Meeks said he feared the leaders were discussing dividing the world into spheres of influence, potentially sidelining U.S. allies. He also questioned the lack of meaningful agreements on nuclear weapons and artificial intelligence safety.
paras.zh: 米克斯表示，他担心领导人正在讨论将世界划分为势力范围，这可能会导致美国盟友被边缘化。他还质疑在核武器和人工智能安全方面缺乏有意义的协议。

paras.en: Asked about the Nvidia scandal, Meeks said he would confront Xi over Chinese espionage and intellectual property theft and warn of possible retaliation.
paras.zh: 当被问及英伟达丑闻时，米克斯表示，他将就中国间谍活动和知识产权盗窃问题与习近平对质，并警告可能会遭到报复。

paras.en: "When it comes to our national security, that's where we draw a red line," he said.
paras.zh: “当涉及到我们的国家安全时，这就是我们划定的红线，”他说。

paras.en: Meeks argued that U.S. diplomats should have raised concerns about Chinese espionage and intellectual property theft before the summit to establish clear goals for the talks. In his conversation with NPR's A Martínez, Meeks also called for reducing tariffs on U.S. allies while pressing China to end its support for Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 米克斯认为，美国外交官应该在峰会前提出对中国间谍活动和知识产权盗窃的担忧，以便为会谈制定明确的目标。米克斯在与美国国家公共广播电台的马丁内斯的谈话中还呼吁降低对美国盟友的关税，同时敦促中国停止支持俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮收听完整采访。

paras.en: The radio interview was edited by HJ Mai and Olivia Hampton. The web version was edited by Treye Green.
paras.zh: 该电台采访由 HJ Mai 和 Olivia Hampton 编辑。网络版本由 Treye Green 编辑。
