articles.title: Texans finally get first win at home in 2026 season, dismantling lowly Colts to keep playoff dreams alive

paras.en: Houston Texans fans can finally cheer for their team winning a home game at Reliant Stadium this season — even if it was a layup.
paras.zh: 休斯顿德州人队的球迷终于可以为他们的球队在本赛季在信实体育场赢得主场比赛而欢呼——即使那是一个上篮。

paras.en: The Texans were 12.5-point favorites entering "Thursday Night Football" against the Indianapolis Colts, their AFC South foe who they lost to earlier this season, and they showed why with a thrashing to improve to 4-6 on the year with a 26-3 win.
paras.zh: 德州人队在“周四橄榄球之夜”中以 12.5 分的优势对阵印第安纳波利斯小马队，这是他们在本赛季早些时候输给他们的亚冠南区对手，他们以 26-3 的胜利将今年的战绩提高到 4-6，证明了原因。

paras.en: There was hope the Colts would come out with some fight against a division opponent and play competitively despite the fire sale before the NFL trade deadline, during which four key starters were sent to contenders.
paras.zh: 尽管在 NFL 交易截止日期之前进行了减价出售，其中四名关键先发球员被送到了竞争者手中，但小马队还是希望能与分区对手展开一些战斗，并打出有竞争力的比赛。

paras.en: Indianapolis did pick up a win at home against the Miami Dolphins last week, but against an actual competitive squad like the Texans, they were no match.
paras.zh: 印第安纳波利斯上周确实在主场战胜了迈阿密海豚队，但面对像德州人这样真正有竞争力的球队，他们不是对手。

paras.en: And if this game was any indication of how the Colts will play the remainder of the season amid their clear rebuild, well, we’re going to feel for players like running back Jonathan Taylor through it.
paras.zh: 如果这场比赛能说明小马队在本赛季剩余比赛中的重建过程中将如何发挥，那么我们将会对像跑卫乔纳森·泰勒这样的球员有感触。

paras.en: Texans fans don’t care what the situation is for the Colts, though, as they were loud and proud on Thursday night with a 17-3 halftime lead thanks to clean quarterback play by C.J. Stroud, and some highlight-reel grabs by his receivers.
paras.zh: 不过，德州球迷并不关心小马队的情况如何，因为周四晚上，由于 C.J. 斯特劳德干净利落的四分卫表现和接球手的一些精彩抢断，小马队在上半场以 17-3 领先，他们大声而自豪。

paras.en: The first touchdown of the game was a 42-yard strike to top dog Nico Collins, who battled a defender and made the grab in the end zone for a 7-3 lead after the extra point.
paras.zh: 本场比赛的第一个达阵是头号球员尼科·柯林斯 (Nico Collins) 的 42 码击球，他在加分后与防守队员奋力拼抢，在达阵区抢断，以 7-3 领先。

paras.en: Then, Kayshon Boutte climbed the ladder on his own Colts defender, hauling in a 24-yard pass from Stroud for the second-quarter score.
paras.zh: 然后，凯尚·布特（Kayshon Boutte）爬上自己的小马队后卫的梯子，接住斯特劳德 24 码的传球，为第二节得分。

paras.en: Houston’s drives were methodical, while its strong defense overpowered Daniel Jones to the point where the game was lost despite getting the first points on the board with a Spencer Shrader field goal.
paras.zh: 休斯顿队的进攻很有条理，而其强大的防守压倒了丹尼尔·琼斯，尽管斯宾塞·施雷德（Spencer Shrader）射门得分，但最终还是输掉了比赛。

paras.en: Colts fans were already calling for head coach Shane Steichen to bench Jones after a dismal performance despite the win over the Dolphins last week. They got their wish in the fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 尽管上周战胜了海豚队，但在表现不佳后，小马队球迷已经呼吁主教练肖恩·史泰钦让琼斯坐在替补席上。他们在第四节如愿以偿。

paras.en: With rookie tight end Marlin Klein scoring the first touchdown of his career in the third quarter, and Will Anderson Jr. sacking Jones in the end zone for a safety, the score was out of reach enough that Steichen called for Anthony Richardson Jr., the fourth overall pick in the 2023 NFL Draft who didn’t pan out in his time starting for Indy, to take some reps.
paras.zh: 新秀近端锋马林·克莱恩在第三节取得了他职业生涯的第一次达阵，小威尔·安德森在达阵区将琼斯解围以保安全，比分太高，以至于史泰肯要求 2023 年 NFL 选秀第四顺位新秀安东尼·理查森来做一些代表，他在印地首发时表现不佳。

paras.en: Also noteworthy: David Montgomery, in his first game back with the Texans since suffering his groin injury in Week 5, looked strong with 26 carries for 107 yards, while making three receptions for 17 yards as well.
paras.zh: 另外值得注意的是：大卫·蒙哥马利在第五周腹股沟受伤后回归德州队的第一场比赛中，他看起来很强大，他完成了 26 次冲球推进 107 码，同时还完成了 3 次接球推进 17 码。

paras.en: It wasn’t the least bit competitive, but Texans fans are sure happy they got a win at home when they were supposed to considering they were 0-4 prior, and had some rough losses in Houston.
paras.zh: 这场比赛的竞争并不激烈，但德州球迷肯定很高兴他们在主场取得了胜利，而他们本应考虑到之前他们的战绩是0胜4负，并且在休斯敦遭遇了一些惨败。

paras.en: More importantly, if the Texans have any hope at making a run to the playoffs, it was a necessary victory to keep that dream alive.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，如果德州人有希望进入季后赛，那么这场胜利是实现这一梦想所必需的。

articles.title: Pro-life group says Trump admin didn't give key abortion drug commitments before Overton FDA nomination pulled

paras.en: A leading pro-life group said it opposed advancing Heidi Overton's nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration without commitments from the Trump administration on abortion drug policy. The White House withdrew her nomination this week amid questions about her support in the Senate.
paras.zh: 一个主要的反堕胎组织表示，如果特朗普政府没有就堕胎药物政策做出承诺，它反对推进海蒂·奥弗顿领导食品和药物管理局的提名。由于对她在参议院的支持存在质疑，白宫本周撤回了她的提名。

paras.en: In an interview with Fox News Digital, Erik Baptist, senior vice president of legal strategy at Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America, said his group asked the Senate to hold up Overton’s confirmation until it received "firm commitments" from the administration on two fronts regarding abortion drug policy.
paras.zh: 苏珊·安东尼·美国反堕胎组织负责法律战略的高级副总裁埃里克·巴普蒂斯特在接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时表示，他的组织要求参议院推迟对奥弗顿的确认，直到收到政府在堕胎药物政策两个方面的“坚定承诺”。

paras.en: Baptist said the group wants the next FDA nominee to commit to ending mail-order access to abortion drugs authorized under the Biden administration and changing how the agency studies the safety of those pills.
paras.zh: 巴普蒂斯特表示，该组织希望下一位 FDA 提名人承诺终止通过邮购获得拜登政府授权的堕胎药物，并改变该机构研究这些药物安全性的方式。

paras.en: "Right now, we’re seeing more abortions in this country than before the Supreme Court’s decision overturning Roe v. Wade," Baptist said. "That’s precisely because of what the Biden FDA did to authorize mail-order abortion drugs. We’re seeing upwards of 15,000 abortion drugs and abortions occurring in pro-life states. Those states can’t meaningfully enforce their laws while this nationwide policy is in place."
paras.zh: “目前，我们看到这个国家的堕胎数量比最高法院推翻罗伊诉韦德案的裁决之前还要多，”巴普蒂斯特说。 “这正是因为拜登 FDA 授权邮购堕胎药物的做法。我们看到超过 15,000 种堕胎药物和堕胎发生在反堕胎州。在这项全国性政策实施的情况下，这些州无法有效执行他们的法律。”

paras.en: "Under the Biden-era policy, anybody can obtain these drugs online and receive them through the mail," he continued. "When I say anybody, we’ve seen news story after news story every week about men and other predators obtaining these drugs to coerce or poison women into taking them against their will. Until that policy changes, no pregnant woman is safe from these drugs. My question to this administration is: How many more women have to be poisoned or coerced with abortion drugs before you take action on this drug?"
paras.zh: “根据拜登时代的政策，任何人都可以在线获取这些药物并通过邮件接收，”他继续说道。 “当我说任何人时，我们每周都会看到一个接一个的新闻报道，关于男人和其他掠夺者获得这些药物来强迫或毒害妇女违背她们的意愿服用这些药物。在政策改变之前，没有孕妇可以免受这些药物的影响。我对本届政府的问题是：在对这种药物采取行动之前，还有多少妇女必须被毒害或强迫堕胎药物？”

paras.en: Under the Biden administration, the FDA eliminated the in-person dispensing requirement for mifepristone, allowing it to be prescribed without an in-person visit by certified prescribers and dispensed by certified pharmacies through the mail.
paras.zh: 在拜登政府领导下，FDA取消了米非司酮的亲自配药要求，允许经过认证的处方医生无需亲自就诊即可开处方，并由经过认证的药房通过邮件进行配药。

paras.en: On the group's second point of concern, Baptist said the FDA needs to conduct a new study to show the safety — or lack thereof — of mifepristone.
paras.zh: 关于该组织的第二个担忧点，巴普蒂斯特表示，FDA 需要进行一项新的研究来证明米非司酮的安全性（或缺乏安全性）。

paras.en: "The problem is that the study is significantly flawed," he said. "It’s almost designed to fail and not lead to future changes to the drug regimen. We have asked for more robust data because significant information is currently lacking, including transparency into the agency’s methodology and an invitation for outside experts who have studied this drug over the last few decades."
paras.zh: “问题在于这项研究存在重大缺陷，”他说。 “它的设计几乎是为了失败，并且不会导致未来药物治疗方案的改变。我们要求提供更可靠的数据，因为目前缺乏重要信息，包括该机构方法的透明度以及对过去几十年研究这种药物的外部专家的邀请。”

paras.en: "This is something that should be bipartisan. Everybody should support better data, more transparency and outside experts who can inform an agency that has never conducted such a study before," he added.
paras.zh: “这应该是两党合作的事情。每个人都应该支持更好的数据、更高的透明度和外部专家，他们可以为以前从未进行过此类研究的机构提供信息，”他补充道。

paras.en: Several pro-life groups and Republican lawmakers have urged the Trump administration to complete the FDA’s safety review of mifepristone and consider reinstating safeguards, while some have called for removing the drug from the market.
paras.zh: 一些反堕胎组织和共和党议员敦促特朗普政府完成 FDA 对米非司酮的安全审查，并考虑恢复保障措施，而一些人则呼吁将该药物从市场上撤下。

paras.en: The FDA said the review is ongoing, with study results expected in December 2026 and a final report expected by March 2027.
paras.zh: FDA 表示，审查正在进行中，预计将于 2026 年 12 月得出研究结果，并预计于 2027 年 3 月得出最终报告。

paras.en: The White House pulled Overton’s nomination to lead the FDA earlier this week, one day before a Senate committee vote. President Donald Trump picked Overton, a physician and White House advisor, in August to succeed Marty Makary, who resigned from the position in May.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，即参议院委员会投票前一天，白宫撤回了奥弗顿领导 FDA 的提名。唐纳德·特朗普总统于 8 月任命医生兼白宫顾问奥弗顿接替马蒂·马卡里，马蒂·马卡里于 5 月辞职。

paras.en: Kyle Diamantas has led the agency in an acting capacity since Makary’s departure.
paras.zh: 自马卡里离职后，凯尔·迪亚曼塔斯（Kyle Diamantas）以代理身份领导该机构。

paras.en: Overton also previously served as vice chair and chief policy officer at the America First Policy Institute, a conservative think tank, where she criticized expanded access to abortion pills in a 2023 policy brief.
paras.zh: 奥弗顿此前还曾担任保守派智库美国第一政策研究所的副主席兼首席政策官，她在 2023 年的政策简报中批评了扩大堕胎药的获取范围。

paras.en: The White House said Overton lacked the votes on Capitol Hill and pulled her nomination, although Sen. Bill Cassidy, chair of the Senate health committee, contended that he believed she could have been confirmed.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，奥弗顿在国会山缺乏票数，并撤回了她的提名，尽管参议院卫生委员会主席参议员比尔·卡西迪声称，他相信她本可以得到确认。

paras.en: "The White House abandoned a viable confirmation path for Dr. Overton. The WH said that this was because she did not have the votes to pass. This was odd as I was having productive conversations with members," Cassidy, R-La., wrote on X. "I believe she would have had the votes to pass out of committee and pass the full Senate."
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州共和党人卡西迪在 X 上写道：“白宫放弃了奥弗顿博士的可行确认途径。白宫表示，这是因为她没有获得通过的票数。这很奇怪，因为我正在与议员们进行富有成效的对话。我相信她本可以获得在委员会中通过的票数，并在参议院全体会议上获得通过。”

paras.en: Baptist said he did not know whether the White House was concerned about pro-life votes or other constituencies but thinks Cassidy "was making progress with the administration to secure the commitments we were seeking and asking the Senate to hold the administration accountable for."
paras.zh: 巴普蒂斯特表示，他不知道白宫是否担心反堕胎投票或其他选区，但认为卡西迪“正在与政府取得进展，以确保我们寻求的承诺，并要求参议院让政府承担责任。”

paras.en: Cassidy had criticized Overton for supporting Trump’s decision to recommend changes to the childhood vaccine schedule, but the senator said he had been convinced she was right for the job after she committed to "follow the science." She had appeared alongside Trump in the Oval Office as the president signed an executive order calling for changes to childhood vaccine recommendations, including a recommendation to administer measles, mumps and rubella vaccines separately once individual shots become available domestically.
paras.zh: 卡西迪曾批评奥弗顿支持特朗普建议改变儿童疫苗接种时间表的决定，但这位参议员表示，在她承诺“遵循科学”后，他确信她适合这份工作。当总统签署一项行政命令，呼吁修改儿童疫苗建议时，她与特朗普一起出现在椭圆形办公室，其中包括建议一旦国内可以单独注射麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗，就分别接种。

paras.en: Cassidy said at a September hearing that there was no scientific evidence for Trump’s suggestion that the combined shot could be "quite lethal" and warned the remark could discourage vaccination.
paras.zh: 卡西迪在 9 月份的一次听证会上表示，没有科学证据支持特朗普关于联合注射可能“相当致命”的说法，并警告说，这一言论可能会阻碍疫苗接种。

paras.en: "Yes, senator, the MMR vaccine is safe and effective," Overton told Cassidy.
paras.zh: “是的，参议员，MMR 疫苗是安全有效的，”奥弗顿告诉卡西迪。

paras.en: Pressed on what she would do if Trump asked her to disregard the FDA’s safety standards, Overton said she would give the president her best advice and follow the legal requirements for reviewing individual products.
paras.zh: 当被问及如果特朗普要求她无视 FDA 的安全标准她会怎么做时，奥弗顿表示，她将为总统提供最好的建议，并遵循审查个别产品的法律要求。

paras.en: Sen. Maggie Hassan, D-N.H., asked Overton directly whether Trump was wrong. Overton reiterated that the vaccine was safe and effective and called it the best tool available during the measles outbreak. Sen. Ed Markey, D-Mass., questioned why she had not corrected Trump in the Oval Office.
paras.zh: 新罕布什尔州民主党参议员玛吉·哈桑直接询问奥弗顿，特朗普是否错了。奥弗顿重申该疫苗安全有效，并称其是麻疹爆发期间可用的最佳工具。马萨诸塞州民主党参议员埃德·马基质疑她为何没有在椭圆形办公室纠正特朗普的错误。

paras.en: "Why should we expect you to stand up to the president as FDA commissioner?" Markey asked.
paras.zh: “我们为什么要期望你作为 FDA 专员与总统对抗？”马基问道。

paras.en: Baptist said he wants the next FDA commissioner to be somebody who "understands science" and has experience managing an agency.
paras.zh: 巴普蒂斯特说，他希望下一任 FDA 专员是“了解科学”并具有管理机构经验的人。

paras.en: "The FDA is a very large bureaucracy with multiple constituencies, so understanding how science is conducted and how drugs are approved will be essential to any successful candidate or nominee for the position," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“FDA 是一个非常庞大的官僚机构，拥有多个选区，因此了解科学是如何进行的以及药物是如何批准的，对于该职位的任何成功候选人或被提名人都至关重要。”

paras.en: But, Baptist said, the administration does not have to wait for an FDA nominee to take the position before it can take the action on abortion pill policy that his group desires.
paras.zh: 但是，巴普蒂斯特说，政府不必等待 FDA 提名人就职，就可以按照他的团队所希望的那样对堕胎药政策采取行动。

paras.en: "The good news is that it doesn’t have to be the nominee who makes these commitments. The administration can do it because it has admitted that it can take these actions immediately using its own authority," he argued. "That power is within the administration’s possession. It’s a matter of political will, not legal ability."
paras.zh: “好消息是，不一定是被提名人做出这些承诺。政府可以做到这一点，因为它承认可以利用自己的权力立即采取这些行动，”他辩称。 “这种权力属于政府。这是政治意愿的问题，而不是法律能力的问题。”

paras.en: "With regard to fixing the study, I think they can make those changes now," Baptist continued. "They don’t need to wait for a confirmation, especially when they’re saying they’re going to finish the study in December of this year. We might not have an FDA commissioner at that point, or even a nominee. So they need to fix it immediately and course-correct the study before it’s fatally flawed and completed next year."
paras.zh: “关于修复研究，我认为他们现在可以做出这些改变，”巴普蒂斯特继续说道。 “他们不需要等待确认，特别是当他们说他们将在今年 12 月完成这项研究时。那时我们可能没有 FDA 专员，甚至没有提名人。所以他们需要立即修复它，并在研究出现致命缺陷并于明年完成之前对研究进行路线修正。”

paras.en: Fox News' Stepheny Price contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的斯蒂芬尼·普莱斯对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Texas inmate's execution takes over an hour as prison staff struggle to find suitable veins

paras.en: A Texas inmate's execution lasted more than an hour Thursday as prison staff struggled to find suitable veins for a lethal injection, with the condemned man repeatedly complaining of severe pain before being pronounced dead.
paras.zh: 周四，一名德克萨斯州囚犯的处决持续了一个多小时，监狱工作人员努力寻找合适的静脉进行注射死刑，这名囚犯在被宣布死亡之前多次抱怨剧烈疼痛。

paras.en: Reinaldo Dennes, who was convicted of capital murder in the 1996 killing of Houston diamond dealer Janos Szucs, repeatedly cried out during the procedure at the state penitentiary in Huntsville, according to The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，雷纳尔多·丹尼斯 (Reinaldo Dennes) 在 1996 年杀害休斯敦钻石经销商贾诺斯·苏克斯 (Janos Szucs) 时被判犯有死刑，他在亨茨维尔州立监狱的诉讼过程中多次哭泣。

paras.en: Dennes was pronounced dead at 7:08 p.m., one minute after the procedure was completed.
paras.zh: 晚上 7 点 08 分，即手术完成一分钟后，丹尼斯被宣布死亡。

paras.en: The procedure lasted 63 minutes from the time Dennes was strapped to the gurney until its completion, as prison staff struggled to find suitable veins for the intravenous needles used to administer pentobarbital.
paras.zh: 从丹尼斯被绑在轮床上到手术完成，整个过程持续了 63 分钟，监狱工作人员努力寻找合适的静脉来放置用于注射戊巴比妥的静脉注射针。

paras.en: The execution comes amid renewed scrutiny of lethal injection procedures following a failed execution attempt in Tennessee in September involving death row inmate Christa Pike, who survived two doses of pentobarbital that her attorneys said did not properly enter her bloodstream, causing serious injuries.
paras.zh: 此次处决正值田纳西州9月对死囚克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)执行死刑失败后，对注射死刑程序进行了重新审查。克里斯塔·派克注射了两剂戊巴比妥，她的律师称，戊巴比妥没有正确进入她的血液，造成了严重伤害。

paras.en: Dennes repeatedly complained of pain after Thursday's procedure began, groaning and calling out to God, according to witnesses cited by The AP.
paras.zh: 据美联社援引目击者称，周四手术开始后，丹尼斯不断抱怨疼痛，不断呻吟并呼求上帝。

paras.en: "My right leg is killing me!" he later shouted, describing the sensation as a cramp.
paras.zh: “我的右腿快要死了！”他后来喊道，将这种感觉描述为痉挛。

paras.en: "I don't think this is normal. Take me, father. Don't let me suffer like this. C'mon," he added.
paras.zh: “我认为这不正常。带我走吧，父亲。不要让我这样受苦。来吧，”他补充道。

paras.en: Texas Department of Criminal Justice spokesperson Amanda Hernandez said all procedures were followed appropriately but acknowledged that staff made multiple unsuccessful attempts to establish IV access before placing needles in Dennes' left foot and the left side of his neck.
paras.zh: 得克萨斯州刑事司法部发言人阿曼达·埃尔南德斯表示，所有程序均得到适当遵循，但他承认，工作人员在将针插入丹尼斯的左脚和颈部左侧之前，曾多次尝试建立静脉通路，但均未成功。

paras.en: Hernandez said she did not know how many attempts were unsuccessful but maintained that the locations ultimately used complied with the state's execution procedures.
paras.zh: 埃尔南德斯表示，她不知道有多少次尝试没有成功，但坚称最终使用的地点符合该州的执行程序。

paras.en: She also suggested that Dennes may have exaggerated his discomfort, noting that he complained of pain before the drugs began flowing and in areas where no IV had been placed.
paras.zh: 她还暗示丹尼斯可能夸大了他的不适，并指出他在药物开始流动之前以及没有放置静脉注射的区域抱怨疼痛。

paras.en: According to The AP, when asked whether Dennes was faking his pain, she replied, "I think, yeah, there were allegations. ... There was nothing abnormal on our part."
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，当被问及丹尼斯是否在假装痛苦时，她回答说：“我认为，是的，有指控……我们方面没有任何异常。”

paras.en: "This isn't the first time we had to insert IVs into other locations. It's also not the first time we've had an inmate make allegations of pain immediately," Hernandez said.
paras.zh: “这不是我们第一次不得不将静脉注射到其他地方。这也不是我们第一次让囚犯立即声称感到疼痛，”埃尔南德斯说。

paras.en: Dennes was the second person executed in the United States on Thursday, following Florida's execution of Thomas Mitchell Overton, 71, who was convicted of killing a pregnant woman and her husband during a home invasion.
paras.zh: 丹尼斯是继佛罗里达州处决 71 岁的托马斯·米切尔·奥弗顿 (Thomas Mitchell Overton) 后，周四在美国被处决的第二人。奥弗顿因入室盗窃杀害一名孕妇及其丈夫而被定罪。

paras.en: Overton's execution marked Florida's 20th of the year, a state record, according to the AP.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，奥弗顿的处决标志着佛罗里达州今年第 20 次被处决，创下了州记录。

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to the Texas Department of Criminal Justice for additional comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道已联系德克萨斯州刑事司法部征求更多评论。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Kellie Sloane says she’s ‘pretty sure’ NSW Liberals exodus is over after Mark Speakman resigns
articles.author: Penry Buckley NSW state reporter

paras.en: The New South Wales opposition leader, Kellie Sloane, says she is “pretty sure” the exodus of Liberals before the March state election has finished, after Mark Speakman became the eighth MP to decide not to recontest their lower house seats.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州反对党领袖凯莉·斯隆 (Kellie Sloane) 表示，在马克·斯皮克曼 (Mark Speakman) 成为第八位决定不重新竞选下议院席位的议员后，她“非常确定”自由党在三月份州选举之前的退出已经结束。

paras.en: In a late-night speech on Thursday, the final sitting day of NSW’s legislative assembly before the vote, Speakman said he would not run again in his south Sydney seat of Cronulla, which he has held since 2011.
paras.zh: 周四，新南威尔士州立法议会投票前的最后一个会议日，斯皮克曼在深夜发表讲话时表示，他不会再次竞选他自 2011 年以来一直担任的南悉尼选区克罗纳拉 (Cronulla)。

paras.en: A third of the 24 current Liberal MPs have announced they will not recontest their seat in March, including Jordan Lane, Mark Coure, Tanya Davies, Ray Williams, James Griffin, Alister Henskens and Mark Taylor.
paras.zh: 24 名现任自由党议员中的三分之一已宣布，他们不会在 3 月份重新竞选席位，其中包括乔丹·莱恩 (Jordan Lane)、马克·库尔 (Mark Coure)、坦尼娅·戴维斯 (Tanya Davies)、雷·威廉姆斯 (Ray Williams)、詹姆斯·格里芬 (James Griffin)、阿利斯特·亨斯肯斯 (Alister Henskens) 和马克·泰勒 (Mark Taylor)。

paras.en: In a press conference on Friday, Sloane insisted the departures were not an indictment of the party’s election prospects.
paras.zh: 在周五的新闻发布会上，斯隆坚称这些离职并不是对该党选举前景的控诉。

paras.en: “No, that’s not the truth. What we are seeing is an impressive cross section of abilities and talent and tenure in our party,” she told reporters in the same room where, exactly a year ago, Speakman announced he would resign as Liberal leader in her favour.
paras.zh: “不，这不是事实。我们看到的是我们党内能力、才华和任期令人印象深刻的横截面，”她在同一个房间里告诉记者，就在一年前，斯皮克曼宣布他将辞去自由党领袖的职务，以支持她。

paras.en: “We have people who have been in government before. We have people who have been in for a medium amount of time, and we’re going to have people with fresh ideas.”
paras.zh: “我们有一些人以前曾在政府工作过。我们有一些人在政府工作了中等时间，而且我们将有一些有新想法的人。”

paras.en: Sloane said she had tried to convince Speakman to stay and said many of the MPs leaving had been in parliament for more than 10 years, although Lane is a first-term MP.
paras.zh: 斯隆表示，她曾试图说服斯皮克曼留下来，并表示，尽管莱恩是第一任议员，但许多离开的议员已经在议会工作了 10 多年。

paras.en: Sloane said a significant number of Liberals had retired before the 2023 election, in which the Coalition lost government and the party dropped nine seats.
paras.zh: 斯隆表示，大量自由党人在 2023 年大选前退休，联盟党在这次大选中失去了政府，该党也失去了 9 个席位。

paras.en: Asked if she could guarantee that further MPs would not step down ahead of the March vote, Sloane said: “Look, I certainly hope not. I certainly hope not. I’m pretty sure that’s done. I’m pretty sure that’s done.”
paras.zh: 当被问及她是否可以保证更多议员不会在三月投票前下台时，斯隆说：“听着，我当然希望不会。我当然希望不会。我很确定那已经完成了。我很确定那已经完成了。”

paras.en: Warnings against becoming ‘One Nation lite’
paras.zh: 警告不要成为“精简一国”

paras.en: Since last year’s leadership spill, the Coalition has gone from commanding 28% of the primary vote in NSW to 23%, Sydney Morning Herald Resolve polling suggests.
paras.zh: 悉尼先驱晨报决心民意调查显示，自去年的领导权流失以来，联盟党在新南威尔士州的初选选票中所占的比例已从 28% 上升至 23%。

paras.en: Labor has gone from 37% to 30%, while One Nation, which Resolve did not start polling separately until March, is now at 26%.
paras.zh: 工党的支持率已从 37% 升至 30%，而一国党 (Resolve 直到 3 月份才开始单独进行民意调查) 目前的支持率为 26%。

paras.en: Last week, Sloane said her party would not form government with One Nation, but she did not rule out a confidence and supply arrangement. The Australian Financial Review has reported many of her MPs privately expect the Liberals to go into a coalition with One Nation.
paras.zh: 斯隆上周表示，她的政党不会与一国党组建政府，但她不排除达成信任和供应安排。据《澳大利亚金融评论报》报道，她的许多议员私下里希望自由党与一国党结成联盟。

paras.en: On Friday, Sloane rejected the claims from “anonymous names in a Financial Review article”, saying the Coalition only needed to flip six Labor seats to form minority government.
paras.zh: 周五，斯隆驳斥了“金融评论文章中匿名人士”的说法，称联盟党只需翻转六个工党席位即可组建少数派政府。

paras.en: In his speech in the dying minutes of the parliamentary term, Speakman, a member of the party’s moderate faction, said the Liberals were “said to face an existential threat” following a wipeout at the 2025 federal election and an “orange wave that seems to be coming across the country”.
paras.zh: 该党温和派成员斯皮克曼在议会任期最后几分钟的讲话中表示，自由党在 2025 年联邦选举中惨败以及“橙色浪潮似乎席卷全国”之后“据说面临着生存威胁”。

paras.en: He warned the Liberals against becoming “Labor lite” or “One Nation lite”, saying they should stick to the values of “Menzian Liberalism”.
paras.zh: 他警告自由党不要成为“精简工党”或“精简一国党”，并表示他们应该坚持“孟赞式自由主义”的价值观。

paras.en: Referencing Pauline Hanson’s notion of “monoculture”, Speakman said Australia was “the most successful multicultural society on the planet” and was “so much better for it”.
paras.zh: 斯皮克曼在引用宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）的“单一文化”概念时表示，澳大利亚是“地球上最成功的多元文化社会”，并且“因此变得更好”。

paras.en: “You know, we hear certain people say we want a monoculture, and that people who don’t support that monoculture somehow are enemies of Australia, hate Australia,” he said.
paras.zh: “你知道，我们听到某些人说我们想要单一文化，而那些不支持单一文化的人在某种程度上是澳大利亚的敌人，讨厌澳大利亚，”他说。

paras.en: “I love Australia for its multiculturalism. Diversity is our strength. It is our strength, and we should build on that.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢澳大利亚的多元文化。多元化是我们的优势。这是我们的优势，我们应该以此为基础。”

paras.en: Speakman, a barrister, served as environment minister between 2015 and 2017, and was attorney general between 2017 and the Perrottet government’s defeat in the 2023 election.
paras.zh: 斯皮克曼是一名律师，在 2015 年至 2017 年期间担任环境部长，并在 2017 年至佩罗特政府在 2023 年选举中失败期间担任总检察长。

paras.en: He was chosen as the Liberal and opposition leader after Dominic Perrottet’s resignation, a position he held until November last year.
paras.zh: 多米尼克·佩罗特 (Dominic Perrottet) 辞职后，他被选为自由党和反对党领袖，一直担任该职位直到去年 11 月。

paras.en: On Thursday, he said being opposition leader “is often said to be the toughest job in politics” and, while it had “ultimately unravelled” for him, he had mostly led an opposition “which was competitive with, or even ahead of, the government in the polls”.
paras.zh: 周四，他表示，作为反对派领导人“通常被认为是政治中最艰难的工作”，虽然这对他来说“最终失败了”，但他领导的反对派主要“在民意调查中与政府竞争，甚至领先”。

paras.en: He said his record as attorney general included legislating for NSW to be the first Australian jurisdiction to criminalise coercive control, introducing affirmative consent tests in criminal sexual assault trials and reforming criminal and civil child sexual abuse cases.
paras.zh: 他说，他作为总检察长的记录包括立法使新南威尔士州成为澳大利亚第一个将强制控制定为刑事犯罪的司法管辖区，在刑事性侵犯审判中引入肯定同意测试，以及改革刑事和民事儿童性虐待案件。

paras.en: Earlier on Thursday, the NSW premier, Chris Minns, announced the former Liberal councillor and parliamentary staffer Tanya Raffoul would contest the Liberal-held seat of Epping as a Labor candidate.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，新南威尔士州州长克里斯·明斯 (Chris Minns) 宣布，前自由党议员兼议会工作人员坦尼娅·拉福尔 (Tanya Raffoul) 将作为工党候选人竞选自由党控制的埃平 (Epping) 席位。

paras.en: On Friday, Sloane said Raffoul had been talking to her about Liberal party roles “only two months ago”.
paras.zh: 周五，斯隆表示，“就在两个月前”，拉福尔一直在与她谈论自由党的角色。

paras.en: “She’s decided to chase personal ambition. She’s a very ambitious person, but she’s changed sides, and that’s a decision Chris Minns has made.”
paras.zh: “她决定追逐个人野心。她是一个非常有野心的人，但她改变了立场，这是克里斯·明斯做出的决定。”

paras.en: Earlier, the NSW treasurer, Daniel Mookhey, rejected the idea that One Nation was pushing Labor to become “Liberal lite”, saying Raffoul’s candidacy reflected “a journey that I think many Liberal people are going through as well”.
paras.zh: 早些时候，新南威尔士州财长丹尼尔·穆克希(Daniel Mookhey)否认了“一国党”正在推动工党成为“精简自由党”的观点，称拉福尔的候选资格反映了“我认为许多自由党人士也正在经历的一段旅程”。

articles.title: Baby born with heart abnormalities ‘didn’t have a chance’ after non-medical free birth, NSW inquest hears
articles.author: Tory Shepherd

paras.en: Four babies who died in New South Wales – three after free births and one after a home birth – might have survived if they had had routine checks and follow-up , a coronial inquest has heard.
paras.zh: 验尸调查获悉，在新南威尔士州死亡的四名婴儿——其中三名是免费分娩，另一名是在家分娩——如果接受常规检查和随访，他们可能会存活下来。

paras.en: Baby DH, Baby D, Baby R, and Baby B died in the state’s northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024.
paras.zh: 2022 年至 2024 年间，婴儿 DH、婴儿 D、婴儿 R 和婴儿 B 在该州北部河流地区死亡。

paras.en: The inquest in Lismore has heard women chose free or home births for reasons including traumatic experiences, a lack of trust in clinicians, and a lack of services.
paras.zh: 利斯莫尔的调查了解到，妇女选择免费或在家分娩的原因包括创伤经历、对临床医生缺乏信任以及缺乏服务。

paras.en: Baby DH died about eight hours after he was born in a free birth – with a doula but no medical professionals present. The court earlier heard he turned purple, was struggling to breathe and had became floppy.
paras.zh: 婴儿 DH 在自由分娩中出生后约八小时死亡，当时有导乐师在场，但没有医疗专业人员在场。法庭早些时候获悉，他脸色发紫，呼吸困难，身体软弱无力。

paras.en: His parents gave evidence they were worried but the doula kept reassuring them their baby was OK, then left.
paras.zh: 他的父母表示他们很担心，但导乐师不断向他们保证孩子没事，然后就离开了。

paras.en: The doula denied many of their claims, and denied that she gave them any clinical advice.
paras.zh: 导乐否认了他们的许多说法，并否认她给了他们任何临床建议。

paras.en: Expert neonatologist and associate professor Nicholas Evans said on Friday that Baby DH’s complex heart abnormalities “would have been readily detectable” in a routine pregnancy scan after which he would have been referred to a paediatric cardiologist.
paras.zh: 新生儿专家兼副教授尼古拉斯·埃文斯 (Nicholas Evans) 周五表示，Baby DH 复杂的心脏异常在常规妊娠扫描中“很容易被发现”，之后他会被转介给儿科心脏病专家。

paras.en: It was a “missed opportunity”, he told the court.
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，这是一个“错失的机会”。

paras.en: Paediatric cardiologist Dr Paul Brooks said it was “highly likely” all the abnormalities would have been identified in a routine scan before birth.
paras.zh: 儿科心脏病专家保罗·布鲁克斯博士表示，所有异常情况“极有可能”在出生前的常规扫描中被发现。

paras.en: Even if the extent of the abnormalities wasn’t clear, he told the court, the scan would have shown the baby needed to be born at a major hospital with cardiac surgery capabilities.
paras.zh: 他告诉法庭，即使异常的程度尚不清楚，扫描也会显示婴儿需要在具有心脏手术能力的大医院出生。

paras.en: “The site of [Baby DH’s] birth meant that he didn’t have a chance.”
paras.zh: “[婴儿 DH] 出生的地点意味着他没有机会。”

paras.en: Baby D’s mother did not know she was having twins, and at first thought she’d delivered Baby D’s placenta, only to realise it was a stillborn second twin.
paras.zh: D宝宝的母亲并不知道她怀的是双胞胎，起初以为自己已经生下了D宝宝的胎盘，结果发现这是死产的第二对双胞胎。

paras.en: Experts at the inquest agreed it was impossible to know exactly why Baby D died. They discussed the possibility it was because self-described birth keeper Sita Tara Kali did not clamp the umbilical cord before cutting it, but Evans told the court that it was ultimately most likely from respiratory distress because of his compromised heart function.
paras.zh: 调查中的专家们一致认为，不可能确切知道 Baby D 的死亡原因。他们讨论了这种可能性，因为自称生育守护者西塔·塔拉·卡利(Sita Tara Kali)在剪断脐带之前没有夹住脐带，但埃文斯告诉法庭，这最终很可能是由于他的心脏功能受损而导致的呼吸困难。

paras.en: Baby D might have survived if someone who could do advanced resuscitation had arrived in under 10 minutes, he said, but the “root cause” was that it was not known the mother was carrying twins before the births.
paras.zh: 他说，如果有能够进行高级复苏的人在 10 分钟内赶到，婴儿 D 可能会活下来，但“根本原因”是在孩子出生前不知道母亲怀着双胞胎。

paras.en: “If [twins] had been diagnosed, at 18 weeks, as it would usually in pregnancy, there would have been very close monitoring.”
paras.zh: “如果（双胞胎）在 18 周时被诊断出来，就像怀孕期间通常会发生的那样，就会受到非常密切的监测。”

paras.en: Baby R likely died of “severe post-maturity” after being born at 43 weeks and one day in a free birth. The standard is to induce birth or perform a caesarean section at 42 weeks, as the ageing placenta puts the baby at risk.
paras.zh: R宝宝在43周零一天出生时很可能死于“严重早产”。标准是在 42 周时引产或进行剖腹产，因为老化的胎盘会使婴儿面临风险。

paras.en: The mother had been for an ultrasound at 12 weeks, which had put the date of birth at 28 July, 2020.
paras.zh: 这位母亲在第 12 周时接受了超声波检查，出生日期为 2020 年 7 月 28 日。

paras.en: But the mother distrusted hospitals and trusted Kali, her birth keeper, the court previously heard.
paras.zh: 但法庭此前获悉，这位母亲不信任医院，而是信任她的接生员卡利。

paras.en: Kali told her to calculate her due date from the date of conception, an unreliable measure that put the date of birth in mid-August.
paras.zh: 卡莉让她从受孕之日开始计算预产期，但这种方法并不可靠，将出生日期定为八月中旬。

paras.en: That recalculation, Evans wrote in his report to the court, was the “root cause” of the issue.
paras.zh: 埃文斯在提交给法庭的报告中写道，这种重新计算是问题的“根本原因”。

paras.en: “The standard practice now is that you don’t allow a pregnancy to go beyond 42 completed weeks,” Evans said on Friday.
paras.zh: 埃文斯周五表示：“现在的标准做法是怀孕时间不得超过 42 周。”

paras.en: Expert midwives earlier told the court they didn’t have statistics for babies born beyond 43 weeks because it was so rare.
paras.zh: 专业助产士早些时候告诉法庭，他们没有 43 周以上出生婴儿的统计数据，因为这种情况非常罕见。

paras.en: A 19 August ultrasound showed the pregnancy had become a medical emergency – but Kali advised her to “go home and rest”. It is “more likely than not” that the baby would have survived had she gone to hospital after the ultrasound, Evans said.
paras.zh: 8 月 19 日的超声波检查显示怀孕已成为医疗紧急情况，但卡利建议她“回家休息”。埃文斯说，如果她在超声波检查后去医院，孩子“更有可能”存活下来。

paras.en: Baby B’s mother was warned multiple times she needed to go to hospital to give birth to her twins, but she was determined to have a home birth. Rather than let her have a free birth, four midwives assisted her and the head midwife repeatedly counselled her about the risks.
paras.zh: B宝宝的母亲多次被警告她需要去医院生下双胞胎，但她决心在家分娩。四名助产士没有让她免费分娩，而是协助她，助产士主任也多次向她提出风险建议。

paras.en: The mother declined ultrasounds as well as a test for early onset group B streptococcus (GBS) – an organism present in 15 to 20% of women that infects the babies of about 2% of carriers.
paras.zh: 这位母亲拒绝接受超声波检查以及早发型 B 族链球菌 (GBS) 检测，这种细菌存在于 15% 至 20% 的女性体内，会感染约 2% 携带者的婴儿。

paras.en: Baby B likely died of GBS, pneumonia and sepsis, Evans told the court on Friday, while his twin fell ill but survived. Many infected babies survive in hospital thanks to antibiotics, he added.
paras.zh: 埃文斯周五告诉法庭，婴儿 B 很可能死于 GBS、肺炎和败血症，而他的双胞胎则生病了，但幸存下来。他补充说，由于抗生素的帮助，许多受感染的婴儿在医院存活下来。

articles.title: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales
articles.author: Catie McLeod

paras.en: Three people who lost consciousness and were hospitalised in New South Wales after using certain vapes have tested positive for the unregulated anaesthetic agent etomidate, health officials have said.
paras.zh: 卫生官员表示，新南威尔士州三名因使用某些电子烟而失去知觉并住院的人，其不受管制的麻醉剂依托咪酯检测结果呈阳性。

paras.en: NSW health on Friday issued a public warning about vape liquids containing etomidate, a strong and fast-acting sedative used as a general anaesthetic overseas but not registered for medical use in Australia.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州卫生部门周五对含有依托咪酯的电子烟液体发出公开警告，依托咪酯是一种强效速效镇静剂，在海外用作全身麻醉剂，但在澳大利亚尚未注册用于医疗用途。

paras.en: The three people who were hospitalised had used non-nicotine refillable vapes, the state health department said. Testing of their blood and urine confirmed the presence of etomidate.
paras.zh: 州卫生部门表示，住院的三人使用了不含尼古丁的可填充电子烟。他们的血液和尿液检测证实了依托咪酯的存在。

paras.en: The department would not confirm how old the three patients were, where they were hospitalised, or their condition on Friday.
paras.zh: 该部门不愿确认这三名患者的年龄、住院地点或周五的病情。

paras.en: The discovery of etomidate in vapes in NSW comes about four months after Victorian health officials announced they had found the powerful anaesthetic agent in an illicit vape sold in Melbourne.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州在电子烟中发现了依托咪酯，大约四个月前，维多利亚州卫生官员宣布他们在墨尔本出售的非法电子烟中发现了这种强效麻醉剂。

paras.en: On Friday, NSW health warned vapes sold as space pods, space oil, kpods, piu piu vapes, or zombie vapes may contain etomidate, or other substances, including ketamine, THC and potent opioids.
paras.zh: 周五，新南威尔士州卫生部门警告称，以太空舱、太空油、kpods、piu piu 电子烟或僵尸电子烟出售的电子烟可能含有依托咪酯或其他物质，包括氯胺酮、四氢大麻酚和强效阿片类药物。

paras.en: The medical director of the NSW poisons information centre, Dr Darren Roberts, said etomidate’s effects were unpredictable when used in a vape.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州毒物信息中心的医疗主任达伦·罗伯茨博士表示，依托咪酯在电子烟中使用时的效果是不可预测的。

paras.en: Roberts said etomidate could cause confusion, drowsiness, slow breathing, vomiting, muscle spasms or movements that were hard to control, and people who took it could become unresponsive.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨说，依托咪酯可能会导致意识混乱、嗜睡、呼吸缓慢、呕吐、肌肉痉挛或难以控制的运动，服用它的人可能会变得反应迟钝。

paras.en: These effects could be life threatening, especially if used with other drugs that could cause sedation, such as alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines, and GHB, Roberts said.
paras.zh: 罗伯茨说，这些影响可能会危及生命，特别是如果与其他可能导致镇静的药物一起使用，例如酒精、阿片类药物、苯二氮卓类药物和 GHB。

paras.en: He said etomidate could also cause long term harm when used regularly, including the disruption of hormones produced by the adrenal gland.
paras.zh: 他说，定期使用依托咪酯还可能造成长期伤害，包括破坏肾上腺产生的激素。

paras.en: These hormones are important in regulating stress responses and need to be replaced if they aren’t produced naturally, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，这些激素对于调节压力反应很重要，如果它们不是自然产生的，就需要更换。

paras.en: “The contents found in non-nicotine vapes vary,” Roberts said. “You can’t assume what’s inside.”
paras.zh: “非尼古丁电子烟中的含量各不相同，”罗伯茨说。 “你无法假设里面是什么。”

paras.en: He urged anyone considering using a vape to ask themselves what could be in it.
paras.zh: 他敦促任何考虑使用电子烟的人问问自己其中可能含有什么。

paras.en: “You won’t get into trouble for seeking medical care,” he said. If you feel unwell, or if your friend feels unwell, after using a vape, do something about it.”
paras.zh: “你不会因为寻求医疗服务而遇到麻烦，”他说。如果你感觉不舒服，或者你的朋友在使用电子烟后感觉不舒服，请采取一些措施。”

paras.en: NSW health officials said it recommended people administer Naloxone to anyone who became responsive after using any drug, in case they had ingested opioids.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州卫生官员表示，建议人们对任何使用任何药物后出现反应的人服用纳洛酮，以防他们摄入了阿片类药物。

paras.en: Naloxone is an opioid overdose treatment, which is free at pharmacies and does not require a prescription.
paras.zh: 纳洛酮是一种阿片类药物过量治疗药物，药店免费提供，不需要处方。

paras.en: Naloxone won’t reverse the effects of etomidate, as the sedative does not belong to the opioid class of drugs, but it is still safe to give, health officials said.
paras.zh: 卫生官员表示，纳洛酮不会逆转依托咪酯的作用，因为这种镇静剂不属于阿片类药物，但仍可以安全使用。

paras.en: The officials said anyone who witnessed someone experiencing unexpected symptoms after using drugs should call triple zero immediately or seek urgent medical attention.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，任何目睹某人在吸毒后出现意外症状的人都应立即拨打“三个零”或寻求紧急医疗救助。

articles.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis

paras.en: In the Yemeni city of Taiz, ringed by jagged mountains and Houthi rebel fighters, Ashwaq has only one way to try to soothe her frightened child - lie.
paras.zh: 在也门塔伊兹市，周围环绕着锯齿状山脉和胡塞叛军战士，阿什瓦克只有一种方法可以安抚她受惊的孩子——撒谎。

paras.en: "When my 11-year-old son hears a loud sound, I tell him, 'Don't be afraid, it's just fireworks'," she says. "I don't want him to panic, but deep down I know he is old enough to understand what is happening around him. He has lived through war for most of his life."
paras.zh: “当我 11 岁的儿子听到很大的声音时，我告诉他，‘别害怕，这只是烟花’，”她说。 “我不想让他惊慌，但在内心深处，我知道他已经足够大了，能够了解周围发生的事情。他一生的大部分时间都经历过战争。”

paras.en: Taiz has long been a prize - and a front line - in Yemen's civil war.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹长期以来一直是也门内战的战利品和前线。

paras.en: Houthi forces tightened their grip last month, fully encircling the government-controlled city, and the population - estimated to be between 600,000 and 1 million.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装上个月加强了控制，完全包围了政府控制的城市，人口估计在 60 万至 100 万之间。

paras.en: Since then, Yemen's third-largest city has been cut off from the world, and its residents have been largely unheard. We reached seven people inside the city who mapped out the anatomy of the siege.
paras.zh: 从那时起，也门第三大城市就与世隔绝，其居民的声音基本上消失了。我们联系了城内的七个人，他们绘制了围城的解剖图。

paras.en: They gave detailed accounts of the Houthis' death grip on Taiz. Only a minimal amount of food can get in. Prices for staples like rice, sugar and cooking oil have doubled or even trebled. Essential supplies, like medicine, water and fuel, are dwindling.
paras.zh: 他们详细描述了胡塞武装对塔伊兹的致命控制。只能进口极少量的食物。大米、糖和食用油等主食的价格已经翻倍甚至三倍。药品、水和燃料等基本物资正在减少。

paras.en: On streets that used to hum with traffic and background chatter, a silence has fallen. Schools are closed and restaurants are shuttered. Suffering is being heaped on suffering. Piles of rubbish are trapped inside the city, alongside the people. When residents try to get rid of it by burning it, there is a toxic smoke. Even the air is now a Houthi weapon.
paras.zh: 原本熙熙攘攘的街道上，现在一片寂静。学校关闭，餐馆关闭。痛苦是堆积在痛苦上的。成堆的垃圾和人们一起被困在城市里。当居民试图通过焚烧来清除它时，会产生有毒烟雾。现在连空气也成了胡塞武装的武器。

paras.en: From positions on the hills, rebel fighters - and snipers - can wage war on the city below.
paras.zh: 叛军战士和狙击手可以从山上的阵地向山下的城市发动战争。

paras.en: Estimates for the death toll vary widely. At the Office for Siege Affairs, a local government department, they say 148 civilians have been killed by Houthi attacks since August.
paras.zh: 对死亡人数的估计差异很大。当地政府部门围攻事务办公室表示，自 8 月以来，已有 148 名平民在胡塞武装袭击中丧生。

paras.en: Some of those we contacted in Taiz do not want to be identified because they fear for their safety. Many in the city are reluctant to even speak on the phone because the Houthis control key mobile carriers.
paras.zh: 我们在塔伊兹联系的一些人不愿透露姓名，因为他们担心自己的安全。该市许多人甚至不愿意打电话，因为胡塞武装控制着主要的移动运营商。

paras.en: "Sometimes it feels like the city has become a huge prison," says Ashwaq, a teacher and mother of three, who only wanted her first name to be used. She yearns for the old Taiz.
paras.zh: “有时感觉这座城市变成了一座巨大的监狱，”阿什瓦克说，她是一名教师，也是三个孩子的母亲，她只希望透露自己的名字。她渴望旧时的塔伊兹。

paras.en: "It used to be a lively city," she says. "People loved life, worked hard, visited one another, and had hopes for the future, despite all the difficulties. Now, we hardly go out anymore. The [Houthi] shelling can happen any time, and sniper fire near the front lines makes even a short trip dangerous."
paras.zh: “它曾经是一个充满活力的城市，”她说。 “尽管困难重重，人们仍然热爱生活，努力工作，互相拜访，对未来抱有希望。现在，我们几乎不再出门了。胡塞武装的炮击随时可能发生，前线附近的狙击手开火，即使是短途旅行也很危险。”

paras.en: She keeps her son and two elder daughters indoors.
paras.zh: 她把儿子和两个大女儿留在室内。

paras.en: "I worry about them every single day, every hour, and honestly every minute," she says.
paras.zh: “我每天、每小时、甚至每分钟都担心他们，”她说。

paras.en: War is not new to Taiz. The strategic city is the gateway to Aden - the temporary seat of the internationally recognised government - and to southern Yemen.
paras.zh: 战争对于塔伊兹来说并不陌生。这座战略城市是通往国际公认政府临时所在地亚丁和也门南部的门户。

paras.en: Houthi rebels - backed by Iran - reached the outskirts of Taiz in 2015, cutting off roads, and laying siege from three sides. A year earlier, they had seized Yemen's capital, Sanaa.
paras.zh: 受到伊朗支持的胡塞叛军于 2015 年到达塔伊兹郊区，切断道路并从三个方向进行围攻。一年前，他们占领了也门首都萨那。

paras.en: More than a decade on, the government, which is weak and fractured, has been unable to reclaim the capital and much of north-western Yemen. That's despite the backing of Saudi Arabia, and its air strikes.
paras.zh: 十多年来，软弱且四分五裂的政府一直无法收复首都和也门西北部的大部分地区。尽管有沙特阿拉伯的支持及其空袭，情况还是如此。

paras.en: In recent months, the conflict has flared up and expanded after a four-year lull. The Houthis made a lightning advance, taking territory from the government, and striking Saudi Arabia with missiles and drones.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，冲突在经历了四年的平静之后再次爆发并扩大。胡塞武装闪电般推进，从政府手中夺取领土，并用导弹和无人机袭击沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: A long-running civil war has become a threat to regional stability.
paras.zh: 长期内战已成为地区稳定的威胁。

paras.en: An emergency room doctor, whom we are calling Yaser, bears witness to that.
paras.zh: 一位急诊室医生（我们称之为亚瑟）见证了这一点。

paras.en: Among the war wounded recently brought to his hospital were four children, shot by Houthi snipers. They usually aim for the head and chest, he tells us. Two of the four children died.
paras.zh: 最近被送往他的医院的战争伤员中有四名儿童，他们被胡塞武装狙击手射杀。他告诉我们，他们通常瞄准头部和胸部。四个孩子中有两个死亡。

paras.en: The hardest thing he faces, as a father himself, is treating wounded children. "I have to rise to the responsibility, compose myself and support the families," he says. "It's a difficult situation that I cannot even put into words, when I see a father looking at his badly wounded child right in front of him."
paras.zh: 作为一名父亲，他面临的最困难的事情就是治疗受伤的孩子。 “我必须承担起责任，让自己镇定下来并支持家人，”他说。 “当我看到一位父亲在他面前看着他受重伤的孩子时，这是一种我什至无法用言语表达的困难情况。”

paras.en: Most of the injured are victims of shelling. Reaching the hospital can be an ordeal. Some families have to walk for hours from outlying areas.
paras.zh: 大多数伤者是炮击的受害者。到达医院可能是一种折磨。有些家庭必须从边远地区步行几个小时。

paras.en: They arrive exhausted, like the doctors who will treat them, and who are struggling with "everything", says Yaser. Even sterilising fluid for surgical instruments is in short supply.
paras.zh: 亚瑟说，他们到达时已经精疲力尽，就像治疗他们的医生一样，他们正在与“一切”作斗争。甚至手术器械的消毒液也供不应求。

paras.en: He tells us the hospital is running on empty, and can carry on for two more weeks, "maybe".
paras.zh: 他告诉我们，医院已经空无一人，“也许”还可以再维持两周。

paras.en: If the emergency rooms are busy, so are the graveyards.
paras.zh: 如果急诊室很忙，那么墓地也很忙。

paras.en: "Funerals heading to the cemeteries have become the defining scene in Taiz, around the clock," says Taiz's Governor, Nabil Shamsan.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹州长纳比尔·沙姆桑 (Nabil Shamsan) 表示：“全天候前往墓地举行葬礼已成为塔伊兹的标志性场景。”

paras.en: It's not just bombs and bullets that kill, he tells us.
paras.zh: 他告诉我们，杀人的不仅仅是炸弹和子弹。

paras.en: "The people of Taiz are losing their lives due to supply shortages, lack of food, and loss of income," he says. "Every single day, we bury dozens of Taiz residents."
paras.zh: “塔伊兹人民因供应短缺、食物匮乏和收入损失而失去生命，”他说。 “我们每天都会埋葬数十名塔伊兹居民。”

paras.en: He remains inside the city, and inside the siege. "I live among my people," he says.
paras.zh: 他留在城内，留在围城内。 “我生活在我的人民中间，”他说。

paras.en: On a video call, he looks weary but delivers a lengthy chronicle of a city being starved of oxygen - literally.
paras.zh: 在视频通话中，他看上去很疲倦，但实际上讲述了一座城市缺氧的长篇历史。

paras.en: He tells us that hospitals have lost 70% of their capacity, and 120 health centres have closed. Diseases are spreading, neonatal deaths have increased, and malnutrition is surging. Hundreds of kidney patients are not getting dialysis because they can't get to hospitals or because fuel is short when they do.
paras.zh: 他告诉我们，医院已经失去了 70% 的服务能力，120 个医疗中心已经关闭。疾病正在蔓延，新生儿死亡人数增加，营养不良现象激增。数百名肾病患者没有接受透析，因为他们无法前往医院，或者在接受透析时燃料短缺。

paras.en: The Houthi leader, Abdul Malik al-Houthi, has denied Taiz is besieged. Late last month, he claimed that routes remained open for food, medicine and humanitarian aid.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装领导人阿卜杜勒·马利克·胡塞否认塔伊兹被围困。上个月末，他声称食品、药品和人道主义援助的路线仍然开放。

paras.en: That is denied by the government, residents of Taiz, aid agencies and the United Nations.
paras.zh: 政府、塔伊兹居民、援助机构和联合国均否认这一点。

paras.en: What's at stake in the battle for the city is more than territory, says Shamsan.
paras.zh: 沙姆桑说，这座城市之战的利害关系不仅仅是领土。

paras.en: He says the Houthis - who mostly follow a branch of Shia Islam - want to change the character of this predominantly Sunni city, long known as a seat of learning and a bastion of resistance.
paras.zh: 他说，胡塞武装主要信奉什叶派伊斯兰教的一个分支，他们希望改变这个以逊尼派为主的城市的特征，这座城市长期以来一直被认为是学术中心和抵抗堡垒。

paras.en: "Everyone knows that Taiz is a hub of culture, a city characterised by freedom, political pluralism and all forms of civic life," he says. In sharp contrast, he says, the Houthis aim to impose their strict religious doctrine and drag the city "back to the dark ages".
paras.zh: “每个人都知道塔伊兹是一个文化中心，一个以自由、政治多元化和各种形式的公民生活为特征的城市，”他说。他说，与此形成鲜明对比的是，胡塞武装的目标是强行推行严格的宗教教义，并将这座城市“拖回黑暗时代”。

paras.en: Whatever the pressure on the city and its people, the governor insists the Houthis will never win.
paras.zh: 无论这座城市及其人民承受多大的压力，州长都坚称胡塞武装永远不会获胜。

paras.en: "Until the population perishes," he replies.
paras.zh: “直到人口灭亡，”他回答道。

paras.en: They are defending their city, alongside relatives, friends, neighbours, and five brigades of pro-government troops, who can't do the job on their own.
paras.zh: 他们与亲戚、朋友、邻居以及五个旅的亲政府部队一起保卫自己的城市，而这些部队无法独自完成这项工作。

paras.en: They don't have heavy weapons or enough numbers for the expanding front line.
paras.zh: 他们没有重型武器，也没有足够的人数来扩大前线。

paras.en: Training camps have sprung up for volunteers, but the lessons can be as brief as a day or two before they are sent to join the fight.
paras.zh: 志愿者训练营如雨后春笋般涌现，但课程可能只有一两天，然后他们就会被派去参加战斗。

paras.en: Akram (not his real name) is already a veteran. He's 31, with a child on the way.
paras.zh: 阿克拉姆（化名）已经是一名退伍军人了。他31岁了，孩子即将出生。

paras.en: When Taiz was fully encircled before, in 2015, he broke away from his studies and took up arms. In that round of fighting, the Houthis gained control of his district on the outskirts, and he was uprooted. He hasn't seen his old home since then.
paras.zh: 2015年，当塔伊兹陷入全面包围时，他就脱离了学业，拿起了武器。在那轮战斗中，胡塞武装控制了他所在郊区的地区，他被连根拔起。从那以后，他就再也没有见过他的老家。

paras.en: Last month, when Taiz was completely cut off once again, he bought a rifle, paying about $1,200 (Â£910) for a Chinese version of a Kalashnikov. It used to cost less than half that sum.
paras.zh: 上个月，当塔伊兹再次与外界完全断绝联系时，他花了大约 1,200 美元（910 英镑）买了一把中国版卡拉什尼科夫冲锋枪。过去它的成本还不到这个数字的一​​半。

paras.en: He tells us this fight is different to 2015.
paras.zh: 他告诉我们这场比赛与 2015 年不同。

paras.en: "This time the Houthis have new technology and new missiles," he says. "They can wage a war in the air with drones. We fear the death of our families and our civilians, and ourselves."
paras.zh: “这次胡塞武装拥有新技术和新导弹，”他说。 “他们可以用无人机在空中发动战争。我们担心我们的家人、平民和我们自己的死亡。”

paras.en: He has already lost four friends in the past month, who left behind wives and children.
paras.zh: 过去一个月他已经失去了四位朋友，留下了妻子和孩子。

paras.en: But Akram, and many others, see defending Taiz as their duty. He says that "all the sons of Taiz" will fight the Houthis "and their extremism".
paras.zh: 但阿克拉姆和其他许多人将保卫塔伊兹视为自己的职责。他说，“塔伊兹的所有儿子”将与胡塞武装“及其极端主义”作斗争。

paras.en: The armed group is currently designated as a foreign terrorist organisation by the US (which has gone back and forth on the issue) but not by the UK or the European Union.
paras.zh: 该武装组织目前被美国认定为外国恐怖组织（美国在这个问题上反复无常），但英国或欧盟并未将其认定为外国恐怖组织。

paras.en: "They say God gave them the right to rule everyone in Yemen. We don't accept that," says Akram. "We live in freedom. We cannot surrender; we cannot leave. We cannot breathe without our city."
paras.zh: “他们说上帝赋予他们统治也门所有人的权利。我们不接受这一点，”阿克拉姆说。 “我们生活在自由之中。我们不能投降；我们不能离开。没有我们的城市，我们就无法呼吸。”

paras.en: But it can be suffocating inside Taiz, where nightfall brings no rest.
paras.zh: 但塔伊兹的内部却令人窒息，夜幕降临，这里让人无法休息。

paras.en: "Every night we have bombing and shelling," says Ahmad Al-Basha, a photographer. "I think the Houthis prefer to fight at night. Maybe they don't want us and our children to sleep inside our homes."
paras.zh: “每天晚上我们都会遭受轰炸和炮击，”摄影师艾哈迈德·阿尔巴沙说。 “我认为胡塞武装更喜欢在晚上作战。也许他们不希望我们和我们的孩子睡在家里。”

paras.en: The people of Taiz feel let down, he tells us, by their government and by the international community. "We feel frustrated and sad," he says, "because we don't see any move to help us."
paras.zh: 他告诉我们，塔伊兹人民对他们的政府和国际社会感到失望。 “我们感到沮丧和悲伤，”他说，“因为我们看不到任何帮助我们的举措。”

paras.en: Many believe the Houthis will keep a chokehold on Taiz from the outside, and exert significant control over the city without trying to enter it.
paras.zh: 许多人认为，胡塞武装将从外部扼杀塔伊兹，并在不试图进入这座城市的情况下对这座城市施加重大控制。

paras.en: Ahmad believes it won't come to that but fears the worst if it does.
paras.zh: 艾哈迈德相信事情不会发展成这样，但他担心如果真的发生了，最坏的情况会发生。

paras.en: "Maybe they will clean Taiz of any resistance, kill people and settle scores with anyone who is against them," he says.
paras.zh: “也许他们会清除塔伊兹的任何抵抗，杀人并与任何反对他们的人算账，”他说。

paras.en: His greatest concern is for his children, who cannot escape the sounds of war.
paras.zh: 他最关心的是他的孩子们，他们无法逃避战争的声音。

paras.en: Like Ashwaq, the teacher, he tries to explain it away.
paras.zh: 就像阿什瓦克老师一样，他试图解释这一点。

paras.en: "I tell them it's a party," he says, "and if it's really loud, I say it's a big party."
paras.zh: “我告诉他们这是一场派对，”他说，“如果真的很吵，我就会说这是一场盛大的派对。”

paras.en: As Taiz endures bombing, shelling, and a sense of abandonment laced with growing hunger, Ashwaq has a parent's plea for the international community.
paras.zh: 当塔伊兹忍受着轰炸、炮击和日益严重的饥饿带来的被遗弃感时，阿什瓦克向国际社会发出了一位家长的恳求。

paras.en: "Please don't forget Taiz," she says. "We are ordinary families. We want our children to study, play and dream like other children around the world. We are not just numbers in news reports."
paras.zh: “请不要忘记塔伊兹，”她说。 “我们是普通家庭。我们希望我们的孩子像世界各地的其他孩子一样学习、玩耍和梦想。我们不仅仅是新闻报道中的数字。”

paras.en: Additional reporting by Wietske Burema and Albaraa Mansoor
paras.zh: Wietske Burema 和 Albaraa Mansoor 的补充报道

articles.title: China issues Mount Fuji warning as family of missing climber offers reward

paras.en: The Chinese embassy in Japan has warned its citizens against off-season ascents of Mount Fuji amid concerns that the hefty reward offered by a missing hiker's family could encourage more reckless climbing.
paras.zh: 中国驻日本大使馆警告公民不要在淡季攀登富士山，因为担心失踪徒步旅行者家人提供的巨额奖励可能会鼓励更多鲁莽的攀登行为。

paras.en: Chen Jie, 25, vanished on 8 November on the mountain. His family is offering 500,000 yuan ($75,000; Â£57,300) to anyone who finds him alive, and 100,000 yuan to anyone who recovers his body, say Chinese and Japanese media reports.
paras.zh: 25岁的陈杰于11月8日在山上失踪。据中国和日本媒体报道，他的家人将为任何发现他还活着的人提供 50 万元人民币（75,000 美元；57,300 英镑），并为任何找到他尸体的人提供 10 万元人民币。

paras.en: Strong winds and blizzards pose serious risks during the closed season, especially as shelter and first-aid centres are not operational, the embassy said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 大使馆周二表示，在禁运季节，强风和暴风雪会带来严重风险，特别是在避难所和急救中心无法运作的情况下。

paras.en: Mount Fuji's official climbing season runs from around early July to early September.
paras.zh: 富士山的官方攀登季节从七月初到九月初左右。

paras.en: Earlier this year, authorities of Yamanashi province, where the northern part of Mount Fuji sits, had said that people who attempt to climb Mount Fuji during off-peak seasons and then require rescue by helicopter will have to pay for the service from next year on.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，富士山北部所在的山梨县当局曾表示，从明年开始，那些试图在淡季攀登富士山然后需要直升机救援的人将不得不付费。

paras.en: Authorities will also require those looking to scale Fuji during the off-season to submit detailed climbing plans.
paras.zh: 当局还将要求那些希望在淡季期间攀登富士山的人提交详细的攀登计划。

paras.en: "We hope that these measures will cause people to rethink what climbing Mount Fuji during the winter is like," Kotaro Nagasaki, the prefecture governor, said at the time.
paras.zh: 县知事长崎幸太郎当时表示：“我们希望这些措施能让人们重新思考冬季攀登富士山的感觉。”

paras.en: On Wednesday, Nagasaki told reporters that attempts to find the missing climber could lead to "secondary disasters"
paras.zh: 周三，长崎告诉记者，寻找失踪登山者的尝试可能会导致“二次灾难”

paras.en: According to Japanese news outlet the Mainichi Shimbun, Nagasaki appeared to appeal to Chen's family, saying: "I understand that your family is important, but please refrain from doing anything that could endanger others."
paras.zh: 据日本新闻媒体《每日新闻》报道，长崎似乎向陈的家人发出呼吁，称：“我理解你的家人很重要，但请不要做任何可能危害他人的事情。”

paras.en: Some social media users in Japan have similarly expressed fears would entice people to venture into the mountains ill-prepared and lead to more accidents,
paras.zh: 日本的一些社交媒体用户也表达了类似的担忧，担心这会诱使人们在准备不足的情况下冒险进入山区并导致更多事故，

paras.en: Yamanashi police said Chen had set out on his hike on 8 November with two friends, who turned back after they realised the mountain was closed and that they weren't suitably equipped for the conditions of the trails.
paras.zh: 山梨警方称，陈于11月8日与两名朋友出发徒步旅行，他们在意识到山已经关闭并且他们没有适合步道条件的装备后折返。

paras.en: Chen pressed on alone from the fifth station of the Yoshida Trail, which sits at around 2,300m (7545ft) above sea level.
paras.zh: 陈独自从海拔约 2,300 m（7545 英尺）的吉田路线第五站继续前进。

paras.en: A friend last heard from Chen at 10:30 that day, when he sent a video message saying: "I'm going up the mountain... There's no one in sight."
paras.zh: 一位朋友最后一次听到陈的消息是在当天10点30分，当时他发视频消息说：“我要上山了……看不见人。”

paras.en: The highest point of Mount Fuji, which is Japan's tallest peak, stands at 3,776m.
paras.zh: 日本最高峰富士山的最高点高达 3,776m。

paras.en: Local authorities launched a search for Chen on 10 November, but it had to be halted several times because of poor weather.
paras.zh: 当地政府于11月10日发起对陈的搜寻，但因天气恶劣而多次中断。

paras.en: Chen's father reportedly arrived in Japan on 13 November. It is not clear when he posted the reward offer.
paras.zh: 据报道，陈的父亲于11月13日抵达日本。目前尚不清楚他何时发布了奖励提议。

articles.title: UK and EU to agree youth mobility scheme, BBC understands

paras.en: Up to 100,000 young people from the EU would be allowed to travel, work and study in the UK per year under a new youth mobility scheme set to be agreed on Friday, the BBC understands.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司了解，根据将于周五商定的新青年流动计划，每年将允许多达 10 万名欧盟年轻人在英国旅行、工作和学习。

paras.en: The same number of young Britons would be allowed into Europe under the scheme, expected to be approved at the UK-EU summit in Brussels. Downing Street has not commented on the details, but said talks were "down to the wire" on Thursday.
paras.zh: 根据该计划，同样数量的英国年轻人将被允许进入欧洲，预计将在布鲁塞尔举行的英国-欧盟峰会上获得批准。唐宁街尚未对细节发表评论，但表示周四的谈判“即将结束”。

paras.en: The prime minister has said a "Channel action plan" on immigration could also be struck, while negotiators are seeking agreements on food trade rules and carbon emissions pricing.
paras.zh: 总理表示，还可能就移民问题达成一项“渠道行动计划”，而谈判代表正在寻求就食品贸易规则和碳排放定价达成协议。

paras.en: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch has accused Andy Burnham of "reopening the divisions" of the Brexit referendum.
paras.zh: 保守党领袖凯米·巴德诺克指责安迪·伯纳姆在英国脱欧公投中“重新引发分歧”。

paras.en: A new youth mobility scheme would aim to make it easier for young people to work and travel both in the EU and UK.
paras.zh: 新的青年流动计划旨在让年轻人更容易在欧盟和英国工作和旅行。

paras.en: The UK already has schemes in place with 13 non-EU countries including Australia, Canada and India.
paras.zh: 英国已经与澳大利亚、加拿大和印度等 13 个非欧盟国家制定了计划。

paras.en: In 2024, the EU proposed allowing 18 to 30 year-olds to work or study in the EU and UK for up to four years.
paras.zh: 2024年，欧盟提议允许18至30岁的年轻人在欧盟和英国工作或学习最长四年。

paras.en: Labour, which was then in opposition, rejected the deal - arguing it amounted to reinstating freedom of movement.
paras.zh: 当时的反对党工党拒绝了这项协议，认为这相当于恢复行动自由。

paras.en: Since coming to government, the party has suggested it would consider a more restricted scheme with a time limit, a cap on the numbers coming to the UK and a ban on participants from claiming benefits.
paras.zh: 自上任以来，该党已表示将考虑一项更严格的计划，包括时限、限制前往英国的人数以及禁止参与者领取福利。

paras.en: The UK's request to limit numbers has proved to be a sticking point in negotiation ahead of the summit, along with the EU's request that EU students should pay the same tuition fees at UK universities as domestic students.
paras.zh: 事实证明，英国限制人数的要求是峰会前谈判的一个症结所在，而欧盟则要求欧盟学生在英国大学支付与国内学生相同的学费。

paras.en: Speaking to broadcasters on Thursday evening, Burnham was asked if there were any circumstances in which the UK would walk away from a deal on Friday.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆周四晚上在接受广播公司采访时被问及英国是否在任何情况下会在周五放弃协议。

paras.en: "There would always be those circumstances because I'm in this to get the best deal for Britain, always," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“总会有这种情况，因为我这样做是为了为英国争取最好的交易。”

paras.en: "But what's in it for us is the possibility of lower food prices and I can't turn my back on that, lower costs for business, cutting red tape, and a really big win potentially of more collaboration on immigration - a Channel action plan - which is a really big deal if we can land that tomorrow.
paras.zh: “但对我们来说，这可能是食品价格下降的可能性，我不能拒绝这一点，降低商业成本，减少繁文缛节，以及在移民问题上进行更多合作的潜在巨大胜利——一项海峡行动计划——如果我们明天就能实现的话，这真是一件大事。

paras.en: "So I hope people can understand why I have pushed this because it could be a really good deal for Britain."
paras.zh: “所以我希望人们能够理解我为何推动这一协议，因为这对英国来说可能是一笔非常好的协议。”

paras.en: Burnham previously said the UK and EU could link up their law enforcement efforts, including sharing more data and criminal records of foreign nationals.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆此前表示，英国和欧盟可以将执法工作联系起来，包括共享更多外国人的数据和犯罪记录。

paras.en: The prime minister's spokesman has said if a deal were secured, the government would introduce legislation to Parliament next week to implement changes.
paras.zh: 总理发言人表示，如果达成协议，政府将于下周向议会提交立法以实施变革。

paras.en: An agreement on trade could remove checks and paperwork faced by food companies exporting to the EU.
paras.zh: 贸易协议可以消除向欧盟出口的食品公司面临的检查和文书工作。

paras.en: The government argues this could add Â£5bn to the economy and cut food prices.
paras.zh: 政府认为这可以为经济增加 50 亿英镑并降低食品价格。

paras.en: However, it could mean the UK will have to follow certain EU rules on products, for example on gene-edited crops or labelling.
paras.zh: 然而，这可能意味着英国将必须遵守欧盟有关产品的某些规则，例如基因编辑作物或标签。

paras.en: Burnham has also said the summit would allow the UK to raise concerns about the Made in Europe scheme, which is designed to protect industries from unfair Chinese competition.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆还表示，此次峰会将使英国能够对“欧洲制造”计划提出担忧，该计划旨在保护行业免受中国不公平竞争的影响。

paras.en: Burnham has previously suggested he could commit Labour to building a closer long-term future relationship with Europe, including asking to rejoin the organisation as a full member - however, he has ruled out major changes before the next election.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆此前曾表示，他可以让工党致力于与欧洲建立更紧密的长期未来关系，包括要求以正式成员身份重新加入该组织——不过，他排除了在下次选举前做出重大改变的可能性。

paras.en: The party's 2024 manifesto promised not to return to the EU, the single market, customs union or freedom of movement, which allows EU citizens to live and work elsewhere in the bloc without a visa.
paras.zh: 该党的2024年宣言承诺不会重返欧盟、单一市场、关税同盟或行动自由，这允许欧盟公民无需签证即可在欧盟其他地方生活和工作。

paras.en: Earlier this week, former deputy prime minister David Lammy urged the prime minister to go into the next general election promising to rejoin the EU.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，前副首相戴维·拉米敦促首相参加下一次大选，并承诺重新加入欧盟。

paras.en: However, the subject has divided his cabinet with one minister warning of the costs that would come with reversing Brexit.
paras.zh: 然而，这个问题引起了他的内阁的分歧，一位部长警告称，扭转英国退欧将带来代价。

paras.en: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, speaking to The Sun, external, said he does "not believe for a minute" the country would "ever vote to rejoin" the EU.
paras.zh: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇在接受《太阳报》采访时表示，他“一分钟都不相信”英国会“投票重新加入”欧盟。

paras.en: He added: "I think what Burnham is doing is playing a very cynical political game. He's trying to pick up votes from the Lib Dems, pick up votes from the Greens, and using it as a massive distraction from all the problems that he can't deal with."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我认为伯纳姆正在做的是一场非常愤世嫉俗的政治游戏。他试图从自由民主党那里获得选票，从绿党那里获得选票，并利用它来分散人们对所有他无法解决的问题的注意力。”

paras.en: Speaking to the BBC's Today programme on Thursday, Badenoch said she wanted to see easier trading with the EU, but "not trade at any cost".
paras.zh: 巴德诺克周四在接受英国广播公司今日节目采访时表示，她希望看到与欧盟的贸易更加便利，但“不惜一切代价进行贸易”。

paras.en: She also said the new deals could see UK companies having to follow EU rules, even those that do not trade with the bloc.
paras.zh: 她还表示，新协议可能会让英国公司必须遵守欧盟规则，即使是那些不与欧盟进行贸易的公司。

paras.en: Appearing on BBC Breakfast on Friday, Reform UK leader Nigel Farage described the agreement as a "very, very expensive and costly error" and said Burnham has no "democratic mandate to do any of this".
paras.zh: 英国改革派领导人奈杰尔·法拉奇周五在英国广播公司早餐节目中表示，该协议是一个“非常非常昂贵且代价高昂的错误”，并表示伯纳姆没有“民主授权来做这一切”。

paras.en: He added that the Labour party manifesto was clear that the UK would not go back towards the single market and asked: "Where is our democracy?".
paras.zh: 他补充说，工党宣言明确表示英国不会回到单一市场，并问道：“我们的民主在哪里？”。

paras.en: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey told BBC Newsnight that while he agreed with Burnham on "the harms of Brexit", he did not think the prime minister was "going to go anywhere near far enough".
paras.zh: 自由民主党领袖埃德·戴维爵士告诉英国广播公司新闻之夜，虽然他同意伯纳姆关于“英国脱欧的危害”的观点，但他认为首相“不会走得足够远”。

paras.en: "We need to go further and faster," he said, including returning to freedom of movement - which Sir Ed said would help tackle immigration and boost the UK economy.
paras.zh: “我们需要走得更远、更快，”他说，包括恢复行动自由——埃德爵士表示，这将有助于解决移民问题并提振英国经济。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: TyreSafe films DVSA roadside checks as tyre defects top HGV prohibition list
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: TyreSafe films DVSA roadside checks as tyre defects top HGV prohibition list

Tyre safety charity TyreSafe has released a new educational video filmed alongside Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA) examiners, highlighting preventable tyre defects. Official enforcement data has revealed tyres were the leading cause of roadside prohibitions for both lorries and trailers between April and June 2026.

Captured at an active DVSA roadside inspection site, the film demonstrates the critical safety faults examiners routinely uncover and urges heavy goods vehicle (HGV) operators to ensure daily walkaround checks are properly executed, logged, and rectified before vehicles return to service.
2026 statistics reveal current extent of tyre defects in CV prohibitions

According to DVSA mechanical inspection figures for Q2 2026, examiners conducted 6,786 targeted inspections at roadsides and operator premises, issuing prohibitions to 21.4 per cent of vehicles, rising to 27 per cent among GB-registered lorries. Tyre defects accounted for 7.62 prohibitions per 100 lorries inspected, triple the rate of the second most common fault, exhaust emissions (2.48). on trailers, the rate doubled to 15.48 tyre defects per 100 inspections, more than two-and-a-half times the rate of brake defects (6.23). Tyres also remain the second most common cause of first-time annual test failures behind brakes.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: While HGV fatal and serious collision rates per mile have fallen faster than any other vehicle category since 2009, lorries still accounted for 7 per cent of vehicles involved in fatal collisions in 2025, with other road users making up over 90 per cent of fatalities.
‘No excuse for poor maintenance’ – TyreSafe stakeholders

Stuart Lovatt, chair of TyreSafe, said: “Our film shows what DVSA examiners see every day: tyre defects a driver could spot in a few minutes on a walkaround check. When tyres are the most common reason for a lorry or trailer to be prohibited, it’s clear that too many checks are being done but not followed through.

“Every defect a driver finds must be reported, fixed and signed off before the vehicle goes back out. Operators need to give drivers the time and training to check properly, and the systems to make sure reported defects are dealt with. Delivery pressures must never come before safety.”
Andrew Donald, DVSA enforcement policy manager, said: “DVSA continues to find tyre defects that could have been identified through an effective walkaround check.
“There is no excuse for poor maintenance – these defects put all road users at risk.

“Drivers and operators have a responsibility to keep vehicles safe and roadworthy. A thorough check of tyres, wheels, lights and other safety-critical components before a vehicle is used can prevent defects becoming a serious risk on the road.”

The campaign also features operational insight from DVSA Earned Recognition operator Ainscough Cranes. Lee Sixsmith, operations director UK, Ainscough Cranes, said: “As a DVSA Earned Recognition operator, we treat the daily walkaround check as the most important few minutes of the working day. Our drivers are trained to check every tyre and wheel properly, and they are given the time to do it.

“Just as important is what happens next. Every defect a driver reports is logged, fixed and signed off before that vehicle goes back out. That is what keeps our fleet safe, legal and working, and we were glad to help TyreSafe show what good practice looks like.”

To help fleets protect their Operator Compliance Risk Score (OCRS) and avoid costly roadside delays, TyreSafe is reminding drivers to apply its ACT inspection protocol alongside wheel nut security checks:
- Air pressure: Verify against manufacturer load recommendations, including inner twin tyres.

- Condition: Inspect for cuts, bulges, exposed cords, embedded objects, irregular wear, and ensure tyres on front steered axles of vehicles over 3,500kg are under 10 years old with legible date codes.
- Tread: Ensure at least 1mm of tread depth across the central three-quarters of the tyre around its entire circumference.

Any safety-critical defect should be reported in writing, and the vehicle kept off the road until it is fixed. Roadside prohibitions also count against an operator’s Operator Compliance Risk Score (OCRS), which makes future stops more likely.
TyreSafe is encouraging transport managers to distribute the film to drivers and maintenance teams and align internal procedures with the DVSA’s ‘Guide to maintaining roadworthiness’.

articles.title: GEICO Donates $100,000 to Expand Collision Repair Tech Pipeline
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Engineering Career Alliance announced a $100,000 grant from the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation, GEICO’s charitable arm, that will give partner colleges standardized tools to attract students, engage employers and strengthen the pipeline of skilled collision repair technicians nationwide.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics projects 14,600 annual openings for collision repair technicians through 2034. Training programs supply only 42% of that demand, according to the TechForce Foundation 2026 Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report.

Through a two-year associate degree and paid, hands-on apprenticeships, Collision Engineering helps students turn an interest in vehicle repair into a career. The grant will help partner colleges share that opportunity with more students.

“By donating to Collision Engineering, we’re opening doors for the next generation of technicians and helping address a workforce shortage that affects drivers, repair shops and insurers alike,” said Alan Durand, board member of the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation and head of associate experience at GEICO. “We’re proud to stand with Collision Engineering, educators and our industry partners to build a stronger workforce for the future.”
Grant to Support Recruitment and Employer Engagement
The contribution will support national infrastructure for student recruitment and employer engagement, including:
- A standardized recruitment framework and training for college recruiters, college staff and high school counselors
- Quarterly webinars and ongoing education
- A repeatable approach to student recruitment, employer engagement and placement
Together, these resources will help partner colleges reach more students, connect them with employers and expand the Collision Engineering model across the country.

“This donation gives Collision Engineering the national backbone every partner college needs to recruit more effectively, engage more employers and grow with confidence,” said Mary Mahoney, president of the Collision Engineering Career Alliance. “When industry, education and employers come together like this, we can offer more students in more communities hands-on training, paid apprenticeships and meaningful careers.”

Collision Engineering unites employers, colleges, industry partners and workforce leaders to build a stronger, more connected talent pipeline. The program combines a two-year associate degree with paid, hands-on apprenticeships at qualified collision repair facilities, and it is recognized by the U.S. Department of Labor as the standard for training collision engineering technicians. Students gain real-world experience, and employers gain access to a stronger pipeline of skilled talent.

“The collision repair industry talks a lot about the technician shortage, but solving it requires more than recognition,” said Laura Lozano, professor of collision repair technology and chair of the Automotive Department at Contra Costa College. “We need to introduce more young people to these careers and, just as importantly, connect them with employers willing to train and mentor them. GPF’s donation will help build those connections and give schools like ours the resources to reach more students and industry partners.”
