SÃ¡nchez-Villagra, Florencia Paolucci, Jorge VÃ©lez-Juarbe, Alberto Collareta, Apolline Alfsen, Alton Dooley, Dan Omura, Mario Urbina, Rodolfo Salas-Gismondi, Gabriel Aguirre-FernÃ¡ndez. Extreme cranial asymmetry in extinct benthic feeding sperm whales. Communications Biology, 2026; 9 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s42003-026-11074-2
paras.zh: - 阿尔多·贝尼特斯-帕洛米诺、马塞洛·R·桑切斯-维拉格拉、弗洛伦西亚·保鲁奇、豪尔赫·韦莱斯-贾尔贝、阿尔贝托·科拉雷塔、阿波琳·阿尔夫森、奥尔顿·杜利、丹·奥村、马里奥·乌尔维纳、鲁道夫·萨拉斯-吉斯蒙迪、加布里埃尔·阿吉雷-费尔南德斯。已灭绝的底栖​​进食抹香鲸的颅骨极度不对称。通讯生物学，2026； 9 (1) DOI：10.1038/s42003-026-11074-2

articles.title: Scientists tested 212 plant-based foods. Every single one contained fungal toxins

paras.en: Scientists tested 212 plant-based foods. Every single one contained fungal toxins
paras.zh: 科学家测试了 212 种植物性食品。每一颗都含有真菌毒素

paras.en: - A new study has uncovered a surprising concern hiding in popular plant-based foods and drinks. Researchers tested 212 vegan and vegetarian products sold in the UK, including meat alternatives, oat milk, almond milk, and soy milk, and found that every single one contained at least one potentially harmful fungal toxin. Known as mycotoxins, these naturally occurring compounds can contaminate grains, legumes, and seeds during farming and storage.
paras.zh: - 一项新研究揭示了流行的植物性食品和饮料中隐藏的令人惊讶的担忧。研究人员测试了在英国销售的 212 种纯素和素食产品，包括肉类替代品、燕麦奶、杏仁奶和豆奶，发现每一种都含有至少一种潜在有害的真菌毒素。这些天然存在的化合物被称为霉菌毒素，会在农业和储存过程中污染谷物、豆类和种子。

paras.en: Every one of 212 plant-based foods and drinks tested in a new study contained at least one naturally occurring fungal toxin, raising questions about the potential health effects of regularly consuming these products.
paras.zh: 一项新研究测试的 212 种植物性食品和饮料中，每一种都至少含有一种天然存在的真菌毒素，这引发了人们对经常食用这些产品对健康的潜在影响的质疑。

paras.en: Researchers examined a wide selection of vegetarian and vegan products sold in the UK, including meat alternatives and dairy substitutes. They detected at least one of 19 mycotoxins in every product, and many contained multiple toxins.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了在英国销售的多种素食和纯素产品，包括肉类替代品和乳制品替代品。他们在每种产品中检测到 19 种霉菌毒素中的至少一种，并且许多产品含有多种毒素。

paras.en: Mycotoxins are poisonous substances produced by certain fungi, including molds. They can enter the food supply when agricultural crops become contaminated during growing, harvesting, or storage.
paras.zh: 霉菌毒素是某些真菌（包括霉菌）产生的有毒物质。当农作物在种植、收获或储存过程中受到污染时，它们就会进入食品供应。

paras.en: The investigation was led by scientists at the University of Parma in Italy, with contributions from Cranfield University. The researchers analyzed 212 products, including plant-based meat alternatives (PMBAs) and plant-based beverages (PBBs). The selection covered foods commonly found on supermarket shelves, such as vegan burgers, vegetarian chicken pieces, vegan sausages, and oat, almond, and soy milk.
paras.zh: 这项调查由意大利帕尔马大学的科学家领导，克兰菲尔德大学也做出了贡献。研究人员分析了 212 种产品，包括植物性肉类替代品 (PMBA) 和植物性饮料 (PBB)。这些选择涵盖了超市货架上常见的食物，如纯素汉堡、纯素鸡块、纯素香肠、燕麦、杏仁和豆奶。

paras.en: Although the findings highlight how widespread these naturally occurring contaminants can be, the researchers also identified an important reassuring detail. Every product contained mycotoxin concentrations below recommended European Union guideline levels, which the team said reflected the high food quality standards maintained by the UK food industry.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果强调了这些自然产生的污染物的广泛分布，但研究人员还发现了一个重要的令人放心的细节。每种产品的霉菌毒素浓度均低于欧盟建议的指导水平，该团队表示，这反映了英国食品行业维持的高食品质量标准。

paras.en: Why Plant-Based Foods Can Contain Fungal Toxins
paras.zh: 为什么植物性食品可能含有真菌毒素

paras.en: Many of the ingredients used to manufacture plant-based foods are particularly susceptible to fungal contamination. Grains, legumes, and seeds can encounter mold in fields or storage facilities, creating opportunities for mycotoxins to develop before the ingredients reach food manufacturers.
paras.zh: 用于制造植物性食品的许多成分特别容易受到真菌污染。谷物、豆类和种子可能会在田间或储存设施中遇到霉菌，从而在原料到达食品制造商之前为霉菌毒素的产生创造机会。

paras.en: Unlike bacteria or viruses, mycotoxins are chemical substances produced by certain fungi. Their presence in food does not necessarily mean the product contains living mold, and detecting a toxin does not automatically mean the food is unsafe. The potential health risk depends on factors such as the type of toxin, its concentration, and how much a person consumes over time.
paras.zh: 与细菌或病毒不同，霉菌毒素是某些真菌产生的化学物质。它们在食品中的存在并不一定意味着该产品含有活霉菌，检测到毒素并不自动意味着食品不安全。潜在的健康风险取决于毒素的类型、浓度以及一个人随着时间的推移摄入的量等因素。

paras.en: This distinction is especially important for people who eat plant-based products frequently. Someone whose diet regularly includes meat substitutes, dairy alternatives, grains, and legumes may encounter these substances through several different foods rather than a single source.
paras.zh: 这种区别对于经常食用植物性产品的人来说尤其重要。饮食中经常含有肉类替代品、乳制品替代品、谷物和豆类的人可能会通过几种不同的食物而不是单一来源接触到这些物质。

paras.en: Could Repeated Exposure Pose Health Risks?
paras.zh: 反复接触会造成健康风险吗？

paras.en: While the concentrations detected in the UK products were below recommended EU guidelines, researchers say the potential effects of repeated exposure deserve closer attention.
paras.zh: 虽然英国产品中检测到的浓度低于欧盟建议的指导方针，但研究人员表示，反复接触的潜在影响值得密切关注。

paras.en: Earlier studies have suggested that consuming small amounts of mycotoxins regularly may contribute to cumulative exposure and potentially increase health risks. In other words, assessing a single product may not provide a complete picture of a person's overall dietary exposure.
paras.zh: 早期研究表明，定期摄入少量霉菌毒素可能会导致累积暴露并可能增加健康风险。换句话说，评估单一产品可能无法提供一个人整体饮食暴露的完整情况。

paras.en: Eating one of these products occasionally is unlikely to cause problems based on the levels reported. However, a diet that relies heavily or exclusively on plant-based foods could involve repeated exposure to mycotoxins from numerous ingredients and products. Researchers say understanding the combined effects is important for evaluating possible long-term health consequences.
paras.zh: 根据报告的水平，偶尔吃其中一种产品不太可能引起问题。然而，严重或完全依赖植物性食品的饮食可能会导致反复接触多种成分和产品中的霉菌毒素。研究人员表示，了解综合影响对于评估可能的长期健康后果非常重要。

paras.en: The severity of mycotoxin exposure varies depending on the compounds involved and the amount consumed. At sufficiently high or harmful exposure levels, certain mycotoxins can damage the liver and kidneys, interfere with normal immune system function, and increase the risk of cancer.
paras.zh: 霉菌毒素暴露的严重程度取决于所涉及的化合物和消耗量。在足够高或有害的接触水平下，某些霉菌毒素会损害肝脏和肾脏，干扰正常的免疫系统功能，并增加患癌症的风险。

paras.en: The new findings do not establish that the tested products cause these conditions. Instead, they provide information that scientists can use to estimate how much exposure consumers may receive through their diets and develop more accurate food safety risk assessments for the UK population.
paras.zh: 新的发现并不能证明所测试的产品会导致这些情况。相反，他们提供的信息可供科学家用来估计消费者通过饮食可能受到的暴露程度，并为英国人口制定更准确的食品安全风险评估。

paras.en: Scientists Call for Better Monitoring of Plant-Based Ingredients
paras.zh: 科学家呼吁更好地监测植物成分

paras.en: Andrea Patriarca, Senior Lecturer in Mycology at Cranfield University, emphasized that mycotoxins are a natural part of the food environment and should not discourage people from eating a varied diet. Mycology is the branch of biology devoted to studying fungi, including molds and yeasts.
paras.zh: 克兰菲尔德大学真菌学高级讲师安德里亚·帕特里亚卡（Andrea Patriarca）强调，霉菌毒素是食物环境的自然组成部分，不应阻止人们多样化饮食。真菌学是生物学的一个分支，致力于研究真菌，包括霉菌和酵母。

paras.en: "Mycotoxins occur naturally in foods and cannot be completely avoided. As consumers, we should not be frightened or deterred from enjoying a variety of products.
paras.zh: “霉菌毒素自然存在于食品中，无法完全避免。作为消费者，我们不应该害怕或阻止享用各种产品。

paras.en: However, a significant concern arises when new foods enter the market, as there are currently no established regulations to monitor mycotoxins. We collaborate closely with various sectors in the food industry, from farmers to food companies, to help implement effective mycotoxin management integrated within food safety standards. The data from our research helps food safety organizations in assessing risks, particularly in complex multi-ingredient products.
paras.zh: 然而，当新食品进入市场时，就会出现一个重大问题，因为目前还没有监测霉菌毒素的既定法规。我们与食品行业的各个部门（从农民到食品公司）密切合作，帮助实施纳入食品安全标准的有效霉菌毒素管理。我们的研究数据可帮助食品安全组织评估风险，特别是复杂的多成分产品。

paras.en: We are currently collaborating with the University of Parma to evaluate the risks faced by the population based on different dietary habits. Our aim is to advise policymakers and raise awareness among vulnerable consumers."
paras.zh: 我们目前正在与帕尔马大学合作，根据不同的饮食习惯评估人群面临的风险。我们的目标是为政策制定者提供建议并提高弱势消费者的认识。”

paras.en: The researchers are particularly interested in how food safety monitoring can keep pace with the growing range of plant-based products. Foods made from multiple ingredients present additional challenges because each component may introduce different contaminants, making overall exposure more difficult to assess.
paras.zh: 研究人员特别感兴趣的是食品安全监测如何跟上植物性产品不断增长的步伐。由多种成分制成的食品带来了额外的挑战，因为每种成分可能会引入不同的污染物，从而使整体暴露更难以评估。

paras.en: Their work also underscores the importance of monitoring raw materials throughout the food production process. Identifying and controlling contamination before ingredients are combined into finished products could help manufacturers manage potential risks more effectively.
paras.zh: 他们的工作还强调了在整个食品生产过程中监测原材料的重要性。在将成分组合成成品之前识别和控制污染可以帮助制造商更有效地管理潜在风险。

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for Plant-Based Diets
paras.zh: 研究结果对植物性饮食意味着什么

paras.en: The discovery of fungal toxins in all 212 products highlights the importance of studying dietary exposure across multiple foods, rather than evaluating each product in isolation.
paras.zh: 在所有 212 种产品中发现真菌毒素凸显了研究多种食物的膳食暴露而不是单独评估每种产品的重要性。

paras.en: For consumers, the results are not a reason to abandon vegan or vegetarian foods. The concentrations measured were below recommended EU guidelines, and the researchers stress that mycotoxins cannot be completely eliminated from the food supply.
paras.zh: 对于消费者来说，结果并不是放弃纯素或素食食品的理由。测量的浓度低于欧盟建议的指导方针，研究人员强调，霉菌毒素无法从食品供应中完全消除。

paras.en: Instead, the study points to the need for continued research into how different eating habits influence exposure, particularly among people who depend heavily on plant-based products. The University of Parma and Cranfield University are continuing their collaboration to investigate these dietary patterns, identify potentially vulnerable groups, and provide evidence that can inform future food safety policies.
paras.zh: 相反，该研究指出需要继续研究不同的饮食习惯如何影响暴露，特别是对于严重依赖植物性产品的人。帕尔马大学和克兰菲尔德大学正在继续合作，调查这些饮食模式，识别潜在的弱势群体，并提供可为未来食品安全政策提供依据的证据。

paras.en: The research, titled "Mycotoxin contamination in plant-based beverages and meat alternatives: A survey of the UK market," was published in the journal Food Control.
paras.zh: 这项研究题为“植物性饮料和肉类替代品中的霉菌毒素污染：英国市场调查”，发表在《食品控制》杂志上。

paras.en: The study was conducted as part of the European Union-funded Horizon Europe FunShield4Med project (HORIZON-WIDERA-2021-ACCESS-03), Grant Agreement No 101079173.
paras.zh: 该研究是欧盟资助的 Horizo​​n Europe FunShield4Med 项目 (HORIZON-WIDERA-2021-ACCESS-03) 的一部分，拨款协议编号 101079173。

paras.en: Materials provided by Cranfield University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由克兰菲尔德大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Get $400 off the first Vaonis Vespera Pro model ahead of Black Friday — only eight left in stock
articles.author: Harry Bennett

articles.title: China rolls out rocket for launch of 1st international astronaut to Tiangong space station (video)
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: China's space station is set to receive its first foreign astronaut.
paras.zh: 中国的空间站即将接收第一位外国宇航员。

paras.en: A Long March 2F rocket, topped with the Shenzhou-24 crew spacecraft, was rolled out to the pad at Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center in northwest China, on Tuesday (Nov. 17), with launch expected in the next week.
paras.zh: 周二（11 月 17 日），搭载神舟二十四号载人飞船的长征二号F运载火箭在中国西北部酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空，预计下周发射。

paras.en: The 191-foot-tall (58 meters) rocket was transferred 0.93 miles (1.5 kilometers) from a vertical integration building to the pad over the course of around two hours, starting around 4 a.m. EST (0900 GMT, or 5 p.m. Beijing Time), according to China Central Television (CCTV).
paras.zh: 据中国中央电视台 (CCTV) 报道，这枚高 191 英尺（58 米）的火箭在美国东部时间凌晨 4 点（格林威治标准时间 0900，即北京时间下午 5 点）左右开始，在大约两个小时的时间内从垂直一体化建筑转移到发射台，距离 0.93 英里（1.5 公里）。

paras.en: China's human spaceflight agency, CMSA, stated that all facilities and equipment at the launch site are in good condition, adding that the launch is scheduled to take place in the coming days, without providing a date.
paras.zh: 中国载人航天工程局表示，发射场的所有设施和设备状况良好，并补充说发射计划在未来几天内进行，但没有提供具体日期。

paras.en: CMSA typically holds a press conference at Jiuquan a day ahead of launch, during which the crew for the mission is revealed to the public. This time, one of the three crew members will, for the first time, be an international astronaut. One of two Pakistani astronaut candidates will fly to the Tiangong space station on Shenzhou-24, marking a first both for China's outpost and for Pakistan, which will see one its astronauts reach orbit for the first time.
paras.zh: CMSA 通常在发射前一天在酒泉举行新闻发布会，在此期间向公众公布执行任务的机组人员。这次，三名机组人员中的一名将首次成为国际宇航员。两名巴基斯坦宇航员候选人中的一名将乘坐神舟二十四号飞往天宫空间站，这对中国和巴基斯坦来说都是第一次，其中一名宇航员将首次进入轨道。

paras.en: Though public details are sparse, it is thought that the Pakistani astronaut, operating as a payload specialist, will stay aboard Tiangong for around a week, returning home on the departing Shenzhou-23 spacecraft.
paras.zh: 尽管公开细节很少，但据信，这位作为有效载荷专家的巴基斯坦宇航员将在天宫号上停留大约一周，然后乘坐离开的神舟二十三号飞船返回家园。

paras.en: One of the three Shenzhou-23 astronauts — who are approaching the end of their six-month-long mission, having launched on May 24 — will stay aboard Tiangong for another half a year. This will provide the international visitor with a seat home on Shenzhou-23, and allow a Chinese astronaut to make the country's first year-long stay in orbit. This extra-long mission will supply China with data on physiology ahead of crewed lunar flights and other long-duration missions.
paras.zh: 神舟二十三号三名宇航员于 5 月 24 日发射升空，即将结束为期六个月的任务，其中一名宇航员将在天宫号上再停留半年。这将为国际游客提供一个乘坐神舟二十三号回家的座位，并让中国宇航员首次在轨道上停留一年。这项超长任务将为中国在载人登月飞行和其他长期任务之前提供生理学数据。

paras.en: China approved its human spaceflight program in 1992 and launched its first orbital crewed mission in 2003, with Yang Liwei becoming the first Chinese national in space. The country then completed the three-module Tiangong space station in late 2022 and has kept the orbital outpost constantly crewed ever since, with rotating six-month-long missions with brief handovers between crews.
paras.zh: 中国于1992年批准了载人航天计划，并于2003年发射了首次轨道载人飞行任务，杨利伟成为第一个进入太空的中国人。随后，中国于 2022 年底建成了由三模块组成的天宫空间站，此后一直在轨道前哨站配备载人人员，轮流执行为期六个月的任务，并在机组人员之间进行短暂的交接。

paras.en: Shenzhou-24 will be China's 18th crewed mission and will mark the first time a foreign national is flying on a Shenzhou spacecraft. China is also looking to double the size of Tiangong in the coming years, potentially opening the way to further international missions and space tourist visits.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是中国第18次载人飞行任务，也是外国公民首次乘坐神舟飞船飞行。中国还计划在未来几年将天宫号的规模扩大一倍，这可能为进一步的国际任务和太空旅游访问开辟道路。

paras.en: Andrew is a freelance space journalist with a focus on reporting on China's rapidly growing space sector. He began writing for Space.com in 2019 and writes for SpaceNews, IEEE Spectrum, National Geographic, Sky & Telescope, New Scientist and others. Andrew first caught the space bug when, as a youngster, he saw Voyager images of other worlds in our solar system for the first time. Away from space, Andrew enjoys trail running in the forests of Finland. You can follow him on Twitter @AJ_FI.
paras.zh: 安德鲁是一名自由太空记者，专注于报道中国快速发展的太空行业。他于 2019 年开始为 Space.com 撰稿，并为 SpaceNews、IEEE Spectrum、国家地理、Sky & Telescope、New Scientist 等杂志撰稿。安德鲁第一次对太空产生了兴趣，当时他还是个年轻人，第一次看到航海者号拍摄的太阳系其他世界的图像。远离太空，安德鲁喜欢在芬兰的森林里进行越野跑。您可以在 Twitter 上关注他@AJ_FI。

articles.title: No more asteroid landing: Engine trouble forces Japan's Hayabusa2 probe to change plans
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: Japan's space agency has decided to switch destinations and objectives for the final act of its Hayabusa2 mission, due to the spacecraft suffering trouble with its ion thrusters.
paras.zh: 由于隼鸟二号飞船的离子推进器出现故障，日本航天局决定改变隼鸟二号任务最后一幕的目的地和目标。

paras.en: The veteran Hayabusa2 spacecraft launched back in 2014 to collect material from the asteroid Ryugu. Since delivering the samples to Earth in December 2020 via a reentry capsule, the main spacecraft has been conducting an extended mission of exploration and in July made a super-close flyby of the two-headed asteroid Torifune.
paras.zh: 经验丰富的隼鸟 2 号航天器于 2014 年发射升空，从小行星龙宫收集物质。自从 2020 年 12 月通过再入舱将样本运送到地球以来，主航天器一直在执行长期的探索任务，并于 7 月超近距离飞越了双头小行星鸟船号。

paras.en: But Hayabusa2's continued adventures are now set for a premature end. The spacecraft was scheduled to rendezvous with, and attempt to land on, the tiny, 36-foot-wide (11 meters) near-Earth asteroid 1998 KY26 in 2031, but trouble with the aging spacecraft's engines has forced a change of plan.
paras.zh: 但隼鸟二号持续的冒险现在将提前结束。该航天器原定于 2031 年与 36 英尺宽（11 米）的微小近地小行星 1998 KY26 会合并尝试着陆，但航天器老化的发动机出现问题迫使计划发生变化。

paras.en: The spacecraft will instead target 2015 BM510, another tiny asteroid. And there will be no landing: Hayabusa2 is scheduled to make a high-speed flyby of the near-Earth object in April 2028.
paras.zh: 该航天器将瞄准另一颗微小小行星 2015 BM510。而且不会着陆：隼鸟二号计划于 2028 年 4 月高速飞越这个近地天体。

paras.en: The decision was announced at a Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) press conference on Tuesday (Nov. 17), a day after a Cabinet Office space policy subcommittee meeting. The final functioning thruster out of Hayabusa2's four ion engines suffered a malfunction in mid-August, according to JAXA officials, while a sensor detected unexpected erosion of the spacecraft's surface during its long voyage in space.
paras.zh: 该决定是在内阁府太空政策小组委员会会议第二天（11 月 17 日）日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 (JAXA) 新闻发布会上宣布的。据日本宇宙航空研究开发机构（JAXA）官员称，隼鸟二号的四个离子发动机中最后一个正常运行的推进器在八月中旬发生故障，而传感器在太空长途航行期间检测到航天器表面出现了意外的侵蚀。

paras.en: "The deterioration of the onboard equipment ... is becoming increasingly evident," Japan Times quoted Yuya Mimasu, team leader of the extended mission, as saying.
paras.zh: 《日本时报》援引扩展任务小组组长 Yuya Mimasu 的话说：“机载设备的恶化……正变得越来越明显。”

paras.en: Despite losing the opportunity to land on KY26, the Hayabusa2 mission has been a huge success for JAXA, and the new direction promises its own intrigues. Asteroid 2015 BM510 has already attracted interest; it's the primary target of a proposal for the European Space Agency's mini-Fast mission series. Scientists describe the body as a D-type asteroid, meaning it's thought to be organic-rich and comet-like, and may have originated in the outer solar system.
paras.zh: 尽管失去了登陆 KY26 的机会，隼鸟 2 号任务对 JAXA 来说还是取得了巨大成功，新的方向也预示着它自己的阴谋。小行星 2015 BM510 已经引起了人们的兴趣；它是欧洲航天局迷你快速任务系列提案的主要目标。科学家将其描述为 D 型小行星，这意味着它被认为富含有机物且类似彗星，可能起源于太阳系外层。

paras.en: Around the same time as Hayabusa2 conducts its high-speed flyby in April 2028, JAXA is also scheduled to launch its next asteroid mission, Destiny+. Launching along with ESA's Ramses mission to study Apophis, Destiny+ will first make a flyby of the infamous asteroid ahead of its very close approach to Earth in 2029 before heading to asteroid 3200 Phaethon, the parent body of the Geminid meteor shower.
paras.zh: 大约在 2028 年 4 月隼鸟 2 号进行高速飞越的同时，JAXA 也计划启动下一个小行星任务“命运+”。与欧空局拉美西斯研究阿波菲斯任务一起发射的“命运+”将首先在这颗臭名昭著的小行星于 2029 年非常接近地球之前飞越它，然后前往小行星 3200 Phaethon（双子座流星雨的母体）。

He began writing for Space.com in 2019 and writes for SpaceNews, IEEE Spectrum, National Geographic, Sky & Telescope, New Scientist and others. Away from space, Andrew enjoys trail running in the forests of Finland. You can follow him on Twitter @AJ_FI.

articles.title: How AI is pushing satellites to evolve
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: During the first day of Space Tech Expo Europe, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss sits down with Pieter van Duijn, the chief technology officer of Loft Orbital. They discuss the growing level of trust in artificial intelligence in the commercial space industry, how using a satellite can be like renting a car and the obstacles to adoption.
paras.zh: 在欧洲航天科技博览会的第一天，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Loft Orbital 的首席技术官 Pieter van Duijn 进行了座谈。他们讨论了商业航天行业对人工智能日益增长的信任度、使用卫星如何像租车一样以及采用的障碍。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Space Inventor
paras.zh: 本集由 Space Inventor 赞助

paras.en: Satellites built in Denmark for the ultimate combination of pioneer and partner – where bold innovation meets absolute reliability. articles.title: NASA Conducts Latest RS-25 Engine Test in Support of Future Artemis Missions
articles.author: LaToya Dean

paras.en: NASA tested RS-25 engine No. 10001 on Nov. 18 on the Fred Haise Test Stand at NASA’s Stennis Space Center near Bay St. Louis, Mississippi.
paras.zh: NASA 于 11 月 18 日在密西西比州圣路易斯湾附近的 NASA 斯坦尼斯航天中心的 Fred Haise 试验台上测试了 10001 号 RS-25 发动机。

paras.en: Test teams fired the developmental engine for the planned duration of three minutes and 20 seconds (200 seconds).
paras.zh: 测试团队在计划的 3 分 20 秒（200 秒）时间内启动了开发引擎。

paras.en: While this developmental engine will not be used in flight, the hot fire test provides NASA and NASA’s prime contractor L3Harris Technologies with the capability to capture critical data to improve engine performance and reliability for future Artemis missions.
paras.zh: 虽然这款正在开发的发动机不会在飞行中使用，但热火测试为 NASA 和 NASA 的主承包商 L3Harris Technologies 提供了捕获关键数据的能力，以提高未来 Artemis 任务的发动机性能和可靠性。

paras.en: For the Artemis IV Moon landing mission in 2028, the SLS rocket will launch astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. This mission will be a key step in the agency’s broader goals to explore the lunar South Pole, establish an enduring human presence on the lunar surface, and build on the agency’s foundation for the first crewed mission to Mars.
paras.zh: 对于 2028 年阿耳忒弥斯 IV 登月任务，SLS 火箭将从美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心将宇航员送上猎户座飞船。此次任务将是该机构探索月球南极、在月球表面建立持久人类存在以及为该机构首次载人火星任务奠定基础的更广泛目标的关键一步。

paras.en: For each Artemis mission, four RS-25 engines produce up to 2 million pounds of combined thrust to help launch the SLS rocket.
paras.zh: 对于每次 Artemis 任务，四台 RS-25 发动机可产生高达 200 万磅的联合推力，以帮助发射 SLS 火箭。

paras.en: All RS-25 engines are tested and proven flightworthy at NASA Stennis prior to use. Tests are conducted by a team of operators from NASA, L3Harris, and Nova Space Solutions.
paras.zh: 所有 RS-25 发动机在使用前均经过 NASA 斯坦尼斯测试并证明适合飞行。测试由来自 NASA、L3Harris 和 Nova Space Solutions 的操作员团队进行。

articles.title: NASA Science Data Powers New Method to Discover Hard-to-Find Pulsars

paras.en: An international team of scientists has developed a method that can find pulsars in publicly available NASA data about a million times faster than before. This opens the door to discovering many more of these rapidly spinning objects. A paper describing the results published Thursday in the Physical Review Letters.
paras.zh: 一个国际科学家团队开发了一种方法，可以在 NASA 公开数据中找到脉冲星，速度比以前快一百万倍。这为发现更多这些快速旋转的物体打开了大门。周四发表在《物理评论快报》上的一篇描述结果的论文。

paras.en: Using 15 years of data from NASA's Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope and a cryptography-based method developed by study co-authors Dotan Gazith and Barak Zackay from the Weizmann Institute of Science in Israel, the team found PSR J1622−7204, an isolated pulsar spinning 261 times per second, using the equivalent of 10 hours of computing time on a standard computer processor.
paras.zh: 利用来自 NASA 费米伽马射线太空望远镜 15 年的数据以及以色列魏茨曼科学研究所的研究合著者 Dotan Gazith 和 Barak Zackay 开发的基于密码学的方法，研究小组发现了 PSR J1622−7204，一颗每秒旋转 261 次的孤立脉冲星，相当于标准计算机处理器上 10 小时的计算时间。

paras.en: By comparison, the previous best method failed to find the pulsar, despite using enough computing power that a standard processor would take 600 years to perform the calculation.
paras.zh: 相比之下，以前的最佳方法未能找到脉冲星，尽管使用了足够的计算能力，标准处理器需要 600 年才能执行计算。

paras.en: A pulsar is a rapidly spinning neutron star that sweeps beams of radiation toward Earth, much like a lighthouse. Finding pulsars in gamma-ray data is extraordinarily difficult because Fermi detects only a tiny number of photons from a given pulsar, mixed in with background noise from other gamma-ray-emitting sources and the broader universe. To find the signal, researchers must accurately guess several unknowns at once: how fast the star spins, how quickly the spin is slowing down, and precisely where it sits in the sky. Searching every possible combination would require an impossible number of computations.
paras.zh: 脉冲星是一颗快速旋转的中子星，它向地球发射辐射束，就像灯塔一样。在伽马射线数据中寻找脉冲星非常困难，因为费米只能检测到来自给定脉冲星的极少量光子，这些光子与其他伽马射线发射源和更广阔的宇宙的背景噪声混合在一起。为了找到信号，研究人员必须同时准确猜测几个未知数：恒星自转的速度有多快，自转减速的速度有多快，以及它在天空中的精确位置。搜索每种可能的组合将需要大量的计算。

paras.en: "We don't see every rotation from the pulsar, and we can't just count the rotations to work out where the photon came from," said lead author Daniel Pook-Kolb, a scientist at the Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute) in Germany. “We have a four-dimensional grid, and we must search each direction with millions of trials in it. There’s just not enough computing power on Earth to do it.”
paras.zh: 德国马克斯·普朗克引力物理研究所（阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦研究所）的科学家、主要作者丹尼尔·普克-科尔布（Daniel Pook-Kolb）说：“我们看不到脉冲星的每次旋转，我们不能仅通过计算旋转来确定光子的来源。” “我们有一个四维网格，我们必须在其中进行数百万次试验来搜索每个方向。地球上没有足够的计算能力来做到这一点。”

paras.en: Traditionally, scientists have searched for these pulsars by breaking Fermi data into smaller chunks and analyzing them by crowdsourcing computing power from volunteers around the world. Even with these volunteers contributing their computers’ unused processing power to run searches, it typically took the equivalent of hundreds of computer-years to identify a single pulsar.
paras.zh: 传统上，科学家通过将费米数据分解成更小的块并通过世界各地志愿者的众包计算能力来分析它们来寻找这些脉冲星。即使这些志愿者贡献了计算机未使用的处理能力来进行搜索，通常也需要相当于数百计算机年的时间才能识别出一颗脉冲星。

paras.en: Gazith and Zackay realized that the search could be transformed into a geometry problem: finding the shortest vector in a high-dimensional lattice, or a regularly spaced array of points. This lattice technique draws on algorithms developed by cryptographers trying to break encryption systems designed to resist code-breaking by future quantum computers. The method has also been used to help make satellite navigation systems more efficient.
paras.zh: Gazith 和 Zackay 意识到搜索可以转化为几何问题：在高维晶格或规则间隔的点数组中找到最短向量。这种晶格技术利用了密码学家开发的算法，试图破解旨在抵抗未来量子计算机破解密码的加密系统。该方法还被用来帮助提高卫星导航系统的效率。

paras.en: "We have nothing to do with cryptography in our analysis here, but those algorithms can help us solve the problem of searching for pulsars in our data," Gazith said.
paras.zh: 加齐斯说：“我们的分析与密码学无关，但这些算法可以帮助我们解决在数据中搜索脉冲星的问题。”

paras.en: Each trial run of the algorithm took about five minutes on a single computer core — easily doable on a standard laptop, which usually has between two and eight cores. Once the lattice method identified a pulsar candidate, the researchers confirmed it by feeding in the full Fermi data set, revealing a signal so strong it could not be a chance occurrence.
paras.zh: 该算法的每次试运行在单个计算机核心上大约需要五分钟——在通常有两到八个核心的标准笔记本电脑上很容易完成。一旦晶格方法识别出一颗脉冲星候选者，研究人员就通过输入完整的费米数据集来确认它，揭示了一个如此强烈的信号，不可能是偶然发生的。

paras.en: The team’s next goal is even more ambitious: finding pulsars in binary systems, where a pulsar orbits a star. These discoveries have long been considered out of reach because a companion star’s gravity distorts the signal in ways that have made these pulsars essentially impossible to discover with traditional methods.
paras.zh: 该团队的下一个目标更加雄心勃勃：在双星系统中寻找脉冲星，其中脉冲星绕恒星运行。这些发现长期以来被认为是遥不可及的，因为伴星的引力会扭曲信号，使得这些脉冲星基本上不可能用传统方法发现。

paras.en: "We know that there are probably tens or maybe even hundreds of these pulsars in the data set that we just couldn't find," said Colin Clark, an astrophysicist at the Max Planck Institute who co-authored the study. "The next goal is to extend the searches and use the combination of the new algorithm and the crowdsourced computing power from volunteers in our Einstein@Home program to hopefully find many new pulsars that we think should be there.”
paras.zh: 该研究的共同作者、马克斯·普朗克研究所的天体物理学家科林·克拉克说：“我们知道，数据集中可能有数十个甚至数百个我们无法找到的脉冲星。” “下一个目标是扩大搜索范围，并结合使用新算法和 Einstein@Home 项目志愿者的众包计算能力，希望能找到许多我们认为应该存在的新脉冲星。”

paras.en: The discovery would not have happened without NASA's longstanding, Gold Standard Science policy of making its science data, including data from Fermi, freely available to anyone. Launched in 2008, Fermi surveys the entire sky every three hours, observing the universe in gamma rays — the highest-energy form of light. After an initial one-year calibration period, all Fermi data became fully public and continues to be released as soon as it is processed.
paras.zh: 如果没有美国宇航局长期以来的黄金标准科学政策，即向任何人免费提供其科学数据（包括来自费米的数据），这一发现就不会发生。费米于 2008 年发射，每三个小时巡视一次整个天空，以伽马射线（光的最高能量形式）观察宇宙。经过最初一年的校准期后，所有费米数据都完全公开，并在处理后立即继续发布。

paras.en: "The nice thing about NASA data is it's all open," Clark said. "All 18 years of Fermi data have been made public, and the data just keeps growing."
paras.zh: “美国宇航局数据的好处在于它是完全开放的，”克拉克说。 “所有 18 年的费米数据都已经公开，而且数据还在不断增长。”

paras.en: That openness allowed researchers from outside the Fermi mission, including the cryptography-inspired team, to apply a completely new approach to the dataset. NASA’s support for the science community, through open software and tools such as NASA's Fermitools, enabled the team to prepare their dataset before beginning their analysis.
paras.zh: 这种开放性使得费米任务之外的研究人员（包括受密码学启发的团队）能够对数据集应用一种全新的方法。 NASA 通过开放软件和工具（例如 NASA 的费米工具）对科学界的支持，使团队能够在开始分析之前准备好数据集。

paras.en: The Fermi mission has grown its catalog from a few hundred gamma ray sources to thousands, with new findings emerging as scientists apply fresh ideas to the same data.
paras.zh: 费米任务的伽马射线源目录已从几百个增加到数千个，随着科学家将新的想法应用于相同的数据，新的发现不断出现。

paras.en: "Any search that one team is doing, another team can just go and do that and check the search," said Elizabeth Hays, Fermi project scientist at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland. "It's made all of the science better."
paras.zh: “一个团队正在进行的任何搜索，另一个团队都可以去做并检查搜索结果，”位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的费米项目科学家伊丽莎白·海斯说。 “它让所有的科学变得更好。”

articles.title: World’s top court finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya

paras.en: World’s top court finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
paras.zh: 世界最高法院裁定缅甸犯有针对罗兴亚人的种族灭绝罪

paras.en: The International Court of Justice, the principal judicial organ of the UN, delivered its judgment on Thursday in the case of The Gambia v. Myanmar on the application of the Genocide Convention, finding Myanmar responsible for the crime against the country’s ethnic Rohingya, the first such ruling against a State.
paras.zh: 联合国主要司法机关国际法院周四就冈比亚诉缅甸适用《种族灭绝公约》一案作出判决，认定缅甸应对针对该国罗兴亚人的罪行负责，这是针对国家的首次此类裁决。

paras.en: At the end of a three-hour ruling at the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague, President Yuji Iwasawa of Japan also declared that Myanmar had failed to prevent and punish genocide, after detailing how Myanmar’s military had perpetrated “extreme violence” against mainly Muslim Rohingya communities in Rakhine state.
paras.zh: 在海牙国际法院（ICJ）历时三个小时的裁决结束时，日本总统岩泽雄二在详细介绍了缅甸军方如何针对若开邦主要​​穆斯林罗兴亚人社区实施“极端暴力”后，还宣布缅甸未能防止和惩罚种族灭绝。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres welcomed the judgment as a “powerful recognition of the Rohingya victims of genocide. It is a demonstration of international justice and a reaffirmation that impunity for such horrific acts must not stand.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯对这一判决表示欢迎，称其“是对种族灭绝受害者罗兴亚人的有力承认。这是国际正义的体现，也重申了这种可怕行为不得有罪不罚的现象。”

paras.en: The UN chief stressed that ending impunity in Myanmar and ensuring accountability remained essential to national reconciliation and added that the judgment “will be studied carefully within the United Nations. International law, including the Genocide Convention, must be respected by all.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长强调，结束缅甸的有罪不罚现象并确保追究责任对于民族和解仍然至关重要，并补充说，该判决“将在联合国内仔细研究。包括《种族灭绝公约》在内的国际法必须得到所有人的尊重。”

paras.en: The ruling establishes that Myanmar’s security forces “and other State organs” intentionally committed specifically prohibited acts covered by Article II of the Genocide Convention.
paras.zh: 该裁决认定，缅甸安全部队“和其他国家机关”故意实施《灭绝种族罪公约》第二条所涵盖的明确禁止的行为。

paras.en: These are Article II(a) – killing members of a group, Article II(b) – causing seriously bodily or mental harm to members of the group and Article II(d) – imposing measures intended to prevent births within the group.
paras.zh: 它们是第二条（a）款——杀害团体成员，第二条（b）款——对团体成员造成严重的身体或精神伤害，以及第二条（d）款——采取旨在防止团体内生育的措施。

paras.en: The ICJ ruling came after studying graphic evidence and testimonies provided by survivors and reports from international investigators describing how Rohingya villages and bridges had been set alight and bulldozed, with men and boys executed and girls and women raped during military clearance operations in northern Rakhine in 2017.
paras.zh: 国际法院在研究了幸存者提供的图文证据和证词以及国际调查人员的报告后做出了裁决，这些报告描述了 2017 年若开邦北部的军事清理行动中罗兴亚村庄和桥梁如何被纵火和推平，男子和男孩被处决，女孩和妇女被强奸。

paras.en: The military clearance operations also involved the murder of infants, which “supports the inference that Myanmar’s security forces acted with the intent to prevent births among the group”, Judge Iwasawa continued.
paras.zh: 岩泽法官继续说道，军事清理行动还涉及谋杀婴儿，这“支持了缅甸安全部队采取行动的目的是防止该群体生育的推论”。

paras.en: Delivering the court’s ruling, the ICJ President described how the mainly Muslim Rohingya living in Rakhine state in western Myanmar had been the target of successive clearance operations by the State military, after decades of intercommunal violence.
paras.zh: 国际法院院长在宣读法院裁决时描述了，在经历了数十年的部族间暴力之后，生活在缅甸西部若开邦的以穆斯林为主的罗兴亚人如何成为国家军队连续清除行动的目标。

paras.en: The 2017 clearance operations prompted widespread international condemnation after some 700,000 Rohingya fled northern Rakhine state across the border to Bangladesh.
paras.zh: 约 70 万罗兴亚人越过边境逃离若开邦北部，前往孟加拉国后，2017 年的清理行动引发了国际社会的广泛谴责。

paras.en: According to the court, an estimated 10,000 Rohingya were killed during the clearance operations, citing supporting evidence.
paras.zh: 法院援引相关证据称，估计有 10,000 名罗兴亚人在清理行动中被杀。

paras.en: The case at the ICJ was initiated by The Gambia in November 2019; it has become one of the most closely watched proceedings before the world’s highest court.
paras.zh: 国际法院的此案由冈比亚于 2019 年 11 月提起；它已成为世界最高法院最受关注的诉讼程序之一。

paras.en: Related to the exodus and mass killings, rape and other sexual violence, the court heard testimonies from three witnesses from the Rakhine state villages of Min Gyi, Chut Pyin and Maung Nu.
paras.zh: 与逃亡和大规模杀戮、强奸和其他性暴力有关的案件，法庭听取了来自若开邦敏吉、楚宾和貌努村庄的三名证人的证词。

paras.en: In addition, one witness called by Myanmar gave an account of an attack in which Rohingya insurgents the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA) allegedly killed around 100 civilians.
paras.zh: 此外，缅甸传唤的一名目击者讲述了罗兴亚叛乱分子若开罗兴亚救世军 (ARSA) 据称杀害约 100 名平民的袭击事件。

paras.en: The court heard that nearly 400 villages – approximately 40 per cent of the almost 1,000 villages in the three townships of northern Rakhine state – were partially or totally destroyed during and after the 2017 clearance operations.
paras.zh: 法院获悉，近 400 个村庄（约占若开邦北部三个乡镇近 1,000 个村庄的 40%）在 2017 年清理行动期间和之后被部分或全部摧毁。

paras.en: “Bulldozing and large-scale terrain clearance often followed the destruction…in turn, rapid construction took place on the cleared sites, including security installations, new villages and houses, and other civilian infrastructure,” Judge Iwasawa explained.
paras.zh: 岩泽法官解释说：“破坏之后往往会进行推土机和大规模地形清理……反过来，在清理后的场地上进行快速建设，包括安全设施、新村庄和房屋以及其他民用基础设施。”

paras.en: As a consequence of these breaches of the Genocide Convention, the Court ordered Myanmar: to cease any ongoing violations by enacting legislation giving full effect to its obligations under the Convention; to take immediate and effective steps to investigate all persons reasonably suspected of having committed acts contrary to the Convention and, if warranted, to prosecute and punish them.
paras.zh: 由于这些违反《灭绝种族罪公约》的行为，法院命令缅甸： 颁布立法，充分履行《公约》规定的义务，停止任何正在发生的违法行为；立即采取有效措施，调查所有合理怀疑犯有违反《公约》行为的人，并在有正当理由的情况下起诉和惩罚他们。

paras.en: In addition, the ruling orders Myanmar to provide assurances and guarantees of non-repetition and prevent similar violations from occurring in the future; to adopt measures of restitution in the interest of the Rohingya, including allowing the safe, voluntary and dignified return to their place of residence and reunification of families for the Rohingya who were displaced as a result of the Respondent’s wrongful acts, whether they were displaced within Myanmar or abroad; and to compensate the Rohingya group and its members for the damage caused.
paras.zh: 此外，裁决命令缅甸提供不再重犯的保证和保证，并防止今后发生类似的违法行为；为了罗兴亚人的利益采取恢复原状的措施，包括允许因被告的不法行为而流离失所的罗兴亚人安全、自愿和有尊严地返回居住地并与家人团聚，无论他们是在缅甸境内还是国外流离失所；并赔偿罗兴亚群体及其成员所造成的损失。

paras.en: Finally, the Court decided that the question of the amount and the modalities of compensation or other reparation should be determined in a subsequent phase of the proceedings, and that, to that end, Myanmar should transmit to it, within two years of today’s Judgment, a report on the measures of restitution it has adopted and the amount and modalities of compensation.
paras.zh: 最后，法院决定，赔偿或其他赔偿的金额和方式问题应在诉讼程序的后续阶段确定，为此，缅甸应在今天判决后两年内向法院提交一份关于其已采取的归还措施以及赔偿金额和方式的报告。

paras.en: The judgment is final, binding on the parties to the case and without appeal.
paras.zh: 该判决为终审判决，对案件各方均有约束力，不得上诉。

paras.en: Bosnia and Herzegovina v. Serbia and Montenegro (filed 1993; judgment 2007): The Court ruled that Serbia did not commit genocide itself, but found that it violated the Genocide Convention by failing to prevent the 1995 Srebrenica genocide and failing to punish or transfer perpetrators.
paras.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那诉塞尔维亚和黑山（1993 年提起；2007 年判决）：法院裁定塞尔维亚本身没有实施种族灭绝，但发现其未能阻止 1995 年斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝，也未能惩罚或移交肇事者，违反了《种族灭绝公约》。

paras.en: Croatia v. Serbia (filed 1999; judgment 2015): The Court dismissed both Croatia's main claim and Serbia's counterclaim, finding that neither state proved the specific genocidal intent (dolus specialis) required under the Convention during the Croatian War of Independence.
paras.zh: 克罗地亚诉塞尔维亚（1999 年提起；2015 年判决）：法院驳回了克罗地亚的主要诉求和塞尔维亚的反诉，认为两国都未能证明克罗地亚独立战争期间《公约》所要求的具体种族灭绝意图（dolusspecialis）。

articles.title: No government approval needed to form or join a group, UN rights committee says

paras.en: No government approval needed to form or join a group, UN rights committee says
paras.zh: 联合国人权委员会表示，组建或加入团体无需政府批准

paras.en: General Comment No. 38 sets out how Article 22 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights should be interpreted. Article 22 guarantees the right to freedom of association.
paras.zh: 第 38 号一般性意见规定了如何解释《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第 22 条。第 22 条保障结社自由权。

paras.en: The guidance comes at a time when civil society groups, human rights defenders, trade unions, political parties and grassroots movements face growing legal and administrative hurdles.
paras.zh: 该指导意见出台之际，民间社会团体、人权维护者、工会、政党和草根运动面临着越来越多的法律和行政障碍。

paras.en: Freedom of association allows people to come together voluntarily – including at work – to pursue shared goals. The committee called it a cornerstone of democracy and essential to the enjoyment of other rights.
paras.zh: 结社自由允许人们自愿聚集在一起（包括在工作中）以追求共同的目标。该委员会称其为民主的基石，对于享受其他权利至关重要。

paras.en: “Attacks and infringements on the right to freedom of association are thus a crucial barometer of a broader crackdown on human rights, the rule of law and democracy,” it said.
paras.zh: 报告称：“因此，对结社自由权的攻击和侵犯是更广泛镇压人权、法治和民主的一个重要晴雨表。”

paras.en: “The right to freedom of association is not conditioned by a State’s authorisation or acknowledgement. This means that no prior authorisation is needed for its enjoyment and exercise.”
paras.zh: “结社自由权不受国家授权或承认的条件。这意味着该权利的享有和行使无需事先授权。”

paras.en: The committee stressed that people must be free to choose whether to form or join registered or informal associations, a decision that “rests solely with the individuals themselves”.
paras.zh: 委员会强调，人们必须自由选择是否组建或加入注册或非正式协会，这一决定“完全取决于个人自己”。

paras.en: Simply joining or belonging to an unregistered association “must not be criminalised or sanctioned”, it added.
paras.zh: 它补充说，仅仅加入或属于未注册的协会“不得被定罪或受到制裁”。

paras.en: The right also covers ideas and activities that may be seen as “controversial, dissent or disruptive”, including “peaceful collective civil disobedience actions”.
paras.zh: 该权利还涵盖可能被视为“有争议、异议或破坏性”的想法和活动，包括“和平集体公民不服从行动”。

paras.en: The committee warned against misusing counter-terrorism and national security laws, including vaguely worded laws targeting so-called “extremist” or “undesirable” organizations.
paras.zh: 该委员会警告不要滥用反恐和国家安全法，包括针对所谓“极端主义”或“不良”组织的措辞含糊的法律。

paras.en: Associations are also entitled to seek, receive and use funding, including from abroad, and to cooperate internationally “without the risk of being labelled a ‘foreign agent’ or any similar label or a threat to national security”.
paras.zh: 协会还有权寻求、接受和使用资金，包括来自国外的资金，并进行国际合作，“而不会有被贴上‘外国代理人’或任何类似标签或对国家安全构成威胁的风险”。

paras.en: The committee also cautioned against surveillance of associations and their members, including digital surveillance, and against infiltration by undercover police or intelligence agents.
paras.zh: 该委员会还警告不要对协会及其成员进行监视，包括数字监视，以及卧底警察或情报人员的渗透。

paras.en: Freedom of association is not absolute. However, the committee said any restrictions must be the exception and must have a clear legal basis and a legitimate aim. They must also be strictly necessary and proportionate.
paras.zh: 结社自由不是绝对的。不过，该委员会表示，任何限制都必须是例外，并且必须有明确的法律依据和合法目的。它们还必须是严格必要和相称的。

paras.en: Forcibly suspending or dissolving an association should only ever be a last resort and must be subject to judicial safeguards, it added. The committee stressed that “the relation between right and restriction and between rule and exception must not be reversed”.
paras.zh: 它补充说，强制暂停或解散协会只能是最后手段，并且必须受到司法保障。委员会强调，“权利与限制、规则与例外的关系决不能颠倒”。

paras.en: The UN Human Rights Committee is made up of 18 international experts who monitor how countries implement the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, which 175 States have ratified.
paras.zh: 联合国人权委员会由 18 名国际专家组成，负责监督各国执行《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》的情况，该公约已获得 175 个国家的批准。

paras.en: Members are elected by States parties for four-year terms. They are not UN staff and are not paid for their work.
paras.zh: 成员由缔约国选举产生，任期四年。他们不是联合国工作人员，也没有报酬。

articles.title: COP31: Ambition goes missing as fossil fuel language drops from draft deal

paras.en: COP31: Ambition goes missing as fossil fuel language drops from draft deal
paras.zh: COP31：随着化石燃料语言从协议草案中删除，野心消失了

paras.en: A cat named Ambition went missing again at COP31 on Thursday. While activists delivered the message with humour, it reflected a serious concern: explicit references to moving away from fossil fuels had disappeared from the latest draft climate agreement. On the eve of the summit's scheduled close, ministers and the Presidency were still trying to bridge sharp differences as civil society groups pressed for stronger action.
paras.zh: 周四，一只名叫 Ambition 的猫在 COP31 上再次失踪。虽然活动人士以幽默的方式传达了这一信息，但它反映出了一个严重的担忧：关于摆脱化石燃料的明确提及在最新的气候协议草案中消失了。在峰会预定闭幕前夕，随着民间社会团体敦促采取更强有力的行动，部长们和总统仍在努力弥合尖锐分歧。

paras.en: - A new draft agreement drops: The text removes explicit references to transitioning away from coal, oil and gas, but acknowledges the 1.5°C goal overshoot.
paras.zh: - 一份新的协议草案被放弃：文本删除了对摆脱煤炭、石油和天然气转型的明确提及，但承认 1.5°C 目标超调。

paras.en: - Key negotiation tracks still stalled: Finance, adaptation and just transition negotiation tracks remain unresolved as Friday's deadline approaches.
paras.zh: - 关键谈判轨道仍然停滞不前：随着周五截止日期的临近，财务、适应和公正过渡谈判轨道仍未解决。

paras.en: - Climate action advances: New electrification package highlights clean energy investments and progress across more than 150 countries plus the EU.
paras.zh: - 气候行动取得进展：新的电气化一揽子计划强调了 150 多个国家及欧盟的清洁能源投资和进展。

paras.en: - Progress remains uneven: UN Climate Change Yearbook finds improvement in just 44 of 96 global climate indicators.
paras.zh: - 进展仍然不平衡：《联合国气候变化年鉴》发现 96 项全球气候指标中只有 44 项有所改善。

paras.en: - El Niño in Africa: Ugandan activists demand better disaster preparedness as El Niño threatens their communities.
paras.zh: - 非洲的厄尔尼诺现象：乌干达活动人士要求加强备灾，因为厄尔尼诺现象威胁着他们的社区。

paras.en: Under a grey Antalya sky on Thursday morning, climate activists held up crumpled missing-cat posters outside the COP31 venue. One featured a green-eyed cat in a pink collar; another, a ginger tabby.
paras.zh: 周四早上，在安塔利亚灰色的天空下，气候活动人士在 COP31 会场外举起了皱巴巴的失踪猫海报。其中一张是一只戴着粉色项圈的绿眼睛猫；另一张是一只戴着粉色项圈的猫。另一只是姜黄色虎斑猫。

paras.en: Both were called Ambition. And apparently, both had gone missing. Again.
paras.zh: 两者都被称为“野心”。显然，两人都失踪了。再次。

paras.en: “Ambition” hates overshooting the 1.5°C temperature limit, loves a transition away from fossil fuels (now known as TAFF) and responds to climate justice.
paras.zh: “野心”讨厌超过 1.5°C 的温度限制，喜欢摆脱化石燃料（现在称为 TAFF）并响应气候正义。

paras.en: Philippine Menager of the Ecología y Desarrollo Foundation explained the campaign.
paras.zh: Ecología y Desarrollo 基金会的菲律宾 Menager 解释了该活动。

paras.en: “Right now, in this COP we are missing ambition,” she told UN News, adding that the cats would only come home with a meaningful roadmap for moving away from fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 她告诉《联合国新闻》：“目前，在本届缔约方大会上，我们缺少雄心壮志。”她补充说，猫回家时只会带着一份有意义的摆脱化石燃料的路线图。

paras.en: The campaign began at COP29, she said, and Ambition has apparently been disappearing ever since.
paras.zh: 她说，这项活动始于 COP29，但从那以后，野心显然就消失了。

paras.en: But behind the cat humour is a serious demand that has resonated across the venue for the past 10 days: governments must agree on how to move away from coal, oil and gas while protecting workers and communities.
paras.zh: 但猫式幽默的背后是一个严肃的要求，在过去的十天里在整个会场引起了共鸣：各国政府必须就如何在保护工人和社区的同时摆脱煤炭、石油和天然气达成一致。

paras.en: The cats were not the only ones struggling to find what they wanted.
paras.zh: 猫并不是唯一努力寻找自己想要的东西的动物。

paras.en: On Wednesday evening, COP31 President Murat Kurum gathered ministers for a Divan, a Turkish-style political exchange inspired by Ottoman tradition, in an effort to break the deadlock. Some described it as constructive; ministers from vulnerable countries said little progress had been made.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，COP31 主席穆拉特·库鲁姆 (Murat Kurum) 召集部长们举行 Divan，这是一种受奥斯曼传统启发的土耳其式政治交流活动，旨在打破僵局。一些人认为这是建设性的；另一些人则认为这是有建设性的。来自脆弱国家的部长们表示，进展甚微。

paras.en: On Thursday afternoon, the latest draft of the summit's political agreement – known as the cover decision – had dropped explicit references to moving away from fossil fuels.
paras.zh: 周四下午，峰会政治协议的最新草案（即所谓的封面决定）放弃了明确提及摆脱化石燃料的内容。

paras.en: Instead, the text emphasizes clean energy and electrification, including Türkiye's proposed 35 by 35 target.
paras.zh: 相反，文本强调清洁能源和电气化，包括土耳其提出的 35 x 35 目标。

paras.en: On adaptation finance, it reaffirmed the goal of tripling funding by 2035 but left crucial details, including how to calculate that increase, for further discussion.
paras.zh: 在适应资金方面，它重申了到 2035 年将资金增加两倍的目标，但留下了关键细节，包括如何计算增加额，以供进一步讨论。

paras.en: At a press conference presenting the text, Australia’s Chris Bowen, who is leading the negotiations, said COP31 would be the first climate summit to acknowledge that the world would fail to hold warming to the 1.5°C limit set out in the Paris Agreement.
paras.zh: 在介绍文本的新闻发布会上，负责谈判的澳大利亚的克里斯·鲍文表示，COP31 将是第一次承认世界无法将升温控制在《巴黎协定》规定的 1.5°C 限制之内的气候峰会。

paras.en: “But we are determined that COP31 is not remembered for that, but is remembered as a COP which decides clearly and strongly that that is not acceptable,” he said, referring to the language in the cover text calling for any 1.5°C overshoot to be kept as small and short as possible.
paras.zh: “但我们决定，COP31 不会因此而被人们记住，而是因为 COP 明确而强烈地决定这是不可接受的，”他说，指的是封面文本中呼吁将任何 1.5°C 的超调保持在尽可能小和短的时间内。

paras.en: Mr. Bowen pledged to continue consultations through the night, adding: ‘We won't be leaving the rooms of Antalya until we have that consensus.”
paras.zh: 鲍文先生承诺彻夜继续磋商，并补充道：“在达成共识之前，我们不会离开安塔利亚的会议室。”

paras.en: But with Friday’s deadline approaching, civil society groups are losing patience.
paras.zh: 但随着周五最后期限的临近，民间社会团体正在失去耐心。

paras.en: “Announcements in the cover decision won’t cover up the fact that negotiations are struggling,” Teresa Anderson of ActionAid International told journalists at a press conference.
paras.zh: 国际行动援助组织的特蕾莎·安德森在新闻发布会上对记者说：“封面决定中的公告并不能掩盖谈判陷入困境的事实。”

paras.en: She argued that developing countries were still being asked to do more without adequate financial support.
paras.zh: 她认为，在没有足够的财政支持的情况下，发展中国家仍然被要求做更多的事情。

paras.en: “Adaptation finance is not nice to have. Adaptation is how we all survive this climate crisis together”.
paras.zh: “适应融资并不好。适应是我们共同度过这场气候危机的方式”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a new UN Climate Change report offered a more encouraging, if incomplete, picture of global climate action.
paras.zh: 与此同时，一份新的联合国气候变化报告为全球气候行动提供了一幅更加令人鼓舞（尽管并不完整）的图景。

paras.en: The Global Climate Action Agenda brings together governments, businesses, cities and civil society to advance voluntary climate solutions. Its annual Yearbook tracks global progress and identifies where efforts are falling short.
paras.zh: 全球气候行动议程汇集了政府、企业、城市和民间社会，共同推进自愿气候解决方案。其年度年鉴追踪全球进展并找出不足之处。

paras.en: The 2026 edition found that 44 of 96 indicators were moving in the right direction, while 19 showed no progress and 33 lacked sufficient data. Renewable energy capacity grew by 17 per cent between 2024 and 2025, but energy efficiency gains remained well below what is needed, while adaptation finance fell from $81.5 billion in 2022 to $64.1 billion in 2024.
paras.zh: 2026 年版发现，96 项指标中有 44 项正在朝着正确的方向发展，19 项没有进展，33 项缺乏足够的数据。 2024 年至 2025 年间，可再生能源产能增长了 17%，但能源效率收益仍远低于所需水平，而适应资金从 2022 年的 815 亿美元下降到 2024 年的 641 亿美元。

paras.en: At a high-level event on Thursday, the COP31 Presidency presented an electrification package supporting Türkiye’s goal of increasing electricity’s share of global final energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035.
paras.zh: 在周四的一次高级别活动上，COP31 主席国提出了一项电气化一揽子计划，支持土耳其的目标，即到 2035 年将电力在全球最终能源消耗中的份额提高到 35%。

paras.en: The package brings together activities involving more than 150 countries plus the European Union, 37 cities and over 260 businesses, from expanding electricity grids to electrifying transport and industry.
paras.zh: 该计划汇集了涉及 150 多个国家和欧盟、37 个城市和 260 多家企业的活动，从扩大电网到交通和工业电气化。

paras.en: Among the results highlighted were more than 21,000 kilometres of electricity grids built in 2025 and annual investment plans of at least $156 billion for grids, renewable energy and storage.
paras.zh: 其中重点强调的成果包括2025年建成超过21,000公里的电网以及至少1,560亿美元的年度电网、可再生能源和存储投资计划。

paras.en: But UN climate chief Simon Stiell acknowledged that the benefits must reach further.
paras.zh: 但联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔承认，效益必须进一步扩大。

paras.en: “Vulnerable developing countries need affordable finance and technology. Workers and communities must help to shape and be supported through major change. Across the board, we need to move far faster to meet the demands of the science," he said.
paras.zh: “脆弱的发展中国家需要负担得起的资金和技术。工人和社区必须帮助塑造并通过重大变革获得支持。总体而言，我们需要更快地采取行动，以满足科学的需求，”他说。

paras.en: Across the venue, participants made sure to show delegates the human consequences of their political decisions.
paras.zh: 在整个会场，参与者确保向代表们展示他们的政治决策对人类造成的后果。

paras.en: Kneeling before a crowd, a doctor told the story of Carter, a Canadian boy with asthma who went to the park, played in the water and attended a birthday party, unaware that nearby wildfires were thickening the air around him.
paras.zh: 一名医生跪在人群面前，讲述了卡特的故事。卡特是一名患有哮喘的加拿大男孩，他去公园、在水里玩耍、参加生日聚会，却没有意识到附近的野火正在使他周围的空气变得更加浓重。

paras.en: Carter struggled to breathe, and his parents rushed him to the emergency room, but he did not survive.
paras.zh: 卡特呼吸困难，他的父母赶紧将他送往急诊室，但他还是没能活下来。

paras.en: “Sometimes emergency doctors can’t fix everything,” the doctor said, adding that Carter’s parents wanted his story to be told at COP31.
paras.zh: “有时急诊医生无法解决所有问题，”医生说，并补充说卡特的父母希望在 COP31 上讲述他的故事。

paras.en: Young Ugandans brought another warning: the growing threat of El Niño.
paras.zh: 乌干达年轻人带来了另一个警告：厄尔尼诺现象的威胁日益严重。

paras.en: Alison Nisima, from the village of Kakonkoma in southwestern Uganda, described children struggling along flooded paths to school, women walking long distances in search of safe water and families whose livelihoods depend on the rain, even when it becomes dangerous.
paras.zh: 来自乌干达西南部卡孔科马村的艾莉森·尼西玛（Alison Nisima）描述了孩子们沿着被洪水淹没的道路艰难上学的情景，妇女们长途跋涉寻找安全用水，以及依靠雨水维持生计的家庭，即使雨水变得危险。

paras.en: “For some, heavy rainfall may mean carrying an umbrella or changing travel plans. For a child whose route to school is flooded, it may mean missing class,” she told a press conference.
paras.zh: “对于一些人来说，大雨可能意味着携带雨伞或改变旅行计划。对于上学路线被洪水淹没的孩子来说，这可能意味着缺课，”她在新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: With El Niño raising fears of further flooding in parts of East Africa, Ms. Nisima questioned whether communities would be able to act on warnings before disaster struck.
paras.zh: 随着厄尔尼诺现象引发人们对东非部分地区进一步发生洪水的担忧，尼西玛女士质疑社区是否能够在灾难发生之前根据警告采取行动。

paras.en: “A family may know flooding is coming, but where can they go?” she asked.
paras.zh: “一个家庭可能知道洪水即将来临，但他们能去哪里呢？”她问道。

paras.en: She urged leaders to invest in safe water, roads and local preparedness, and to involve young people who know firsthand which areas are most vulnerable.
paras.zh: 她敦促领导人投资于安全用水、道路和当地的防备工作，并让那些直接了解哪些地区最脆弱的年轻人参与进来。

paras.en: “The purpose of an early warning should never be simply to tell people that danger is approaching. It should give them a fair chance to face it,” she urged.
paras.zh: “预警的目的绝不应该只是告诉人们危险正在逼近。它应该给他们一个公平的机会面对危险，”她敦促道。

paras.en: Follow the latest developments from COP31 through our new podcast, Talk & Action, and our special daily coverage of the conference.
paras.zh: 通过我们的新播客、Talk & Action 以及我们对会议的每日特别报道，关注 COP31 的最新进展。

articles.title: FIA to introduce full-time F1 stewards

paras.en: FIA announce introduction of full-time F1 stewards from 2027 ahead of Las Vegas Grand Prix
paras.zh: 国际汽联宣布从 2027 年起在拉斯维加斯大奖赛前引入全职 F1 赛事管家

paras.en: Formula 1's governing body, the FIA, has revealed full-time stewards will be used for the first time from next year; watch the Las Vegas GP weekend on Sky Sports F1, with Friday's practice sessions at 12.30am and 4pm
paras.zh: 一级方程式赛车的管理机构国际汽联透露，从明年起将首次启用全职赛事管理员。在天空体育 F1 观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，周五中午 12.30 和下午 4 点进行练习赛

paras.en: The FIA has announced it will introduce full-time Formula 1 stewards from 2027 with the aim of having "greater consistency in decision-making".
paras.zh: 国际汽联宣布将从 2027 年起引入全职一级方程式赛事管理员，目的是“提高决策的一致性”。

paras.en: The use of full-time stewards has been a consistent talking point in F1 as different stewards, who adjudicate all racing and technical matters on a race weekend, are used at each event over the season.
paras.zh: 使用全职赛事管理员一直是 F1 中的一个持续话题，因为整个赛季的每场赛事都会使用不同的赛事管理员，他们负责在比赛周末裁决所有比赛和技术问题。

paras.en: There has been an argument that this leads to inconsistencies in decision-making when it comes to imposing penalties, or the severity of a penalty.
paras.zh: 有人认为，这会导致在实施处罚或处罚严重程度时决策不一致。

paras.zh: - 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：英国赛程以及如何在天空体育上观看

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: But the FIA announced on Thursday, ahead of this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, they will begin to recruit full-time stewards with a phased introduction from next year with the aim of establishing 12-15 full-time stewards over the coming years.
paras.zh: 但国际汽联周四宣布，在本周末的拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前，他们将从明年开始分阶段招募全职赛事干事，目标是在未来几年内建立 12-15 名全职赛事干事。

paras.en: Currently, there are four stewards drawn from a large FIA pool of officials and one of those is a former racing driver. The new structure will continue to use the knowledge of driver stewards at each event and the FIA say full-time stewards will "allow for deeper implementation of best practice and greater consistency in decision-making".
paras.zh: 目前，有四名干事是从国际汽联众多官员中选拔出来的，其中一名是前赛车手。新的结构将继续在每场赛事中利用车手管家的知识，国际汽联表示，全职管家将“允许更深入地实施最佳实践并提高决策的一致性”。

paras.en: The news comes a month after the opening of the FIA Remote Operations Centre at Biggin Hill in the UK, following a reorganisation of Race Control in 2022 following the controversial 2021 season which saw Max Verstappen overtake Lewis Hamilton on the last lap of the season-ending Abu Dhabi Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 这一消息是在国际汽联位于英国比金山的远程操作中心开业一个月后发布的，此前，在备受争议的 2021 赛季中，马克斯·维斯塔潘在赛季结束的阿布扎比​​大奖赛的最后一圈超越了刘易斯·汉密尔顿，之后，比赛控制中心于 2022 年进行了重组。

paras.en: "This latest major investment in FIA officiating reflects our dedication to delivering the highest standards of decision-making, fairness and integrity in motorsport," said FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem.
paras.zh: 国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆表示：“这项对国际汽联裁判的最新重大投资反映了我们致力于在赛车运动中提供最高标准的决策、公平和诚信。”

paras.en: "The recruitment of full-time stewards is a significant step in our longstanding mission of building a dedicated officiating ecosystem in the FIA Formula One World Championship, it is also an investment in the future of our sport.
paras.zh: “招募全职管家是我们在国际汽联一级方程式世界锦标赛中建立专门的裁判生态系统的长期使命中迈出的重要一步，也是对我们这项运动未来的投资。

paras.en: "Following the milestone opening of the new FIA Remote Operations Centre and strengthening of officiating development through initiatives such as the FIA High Performance Programme, this development will help to build greater expertise and continuity within our stewarding structure, strengthening our ability to review and improve regulations, support the development of future officials and ensure the highest standards of consistent officiating across all our championships."
paras.zh: “继新的国际汽联远程操作中心具有里程碑意义的开业，以及通过国际汽联高性能计划等举措加强裁判发展之后，这一发展将有助于在我们的管理结构中建立更强大的专业知识和连续性，增强我们审查和改进法规的能力，支持未来官员的发展，并确保我们所有锦标赛中一致裁判的最高标准。”

articles.title: Palestinians flee as Israeli tanks cross Gaza ceasefire’s ‘yellow line’
articles.author: Chantal Da Silva

paras.en: Israel’s ground operation across the yellow ceasefire line in Gaza, which forced Palestinians to flee their makeshift shelters, marks a fresh escalation in the conflict and risks undermining an already floundering truce with Hamas, analysts said Thursday.
paras.zh: 分析人士周四表示，以色列跨越加沙黄色停火线的地面行动迫使巴勒斯坦人逃离临时避难所，这标志着冲突再次升级，并有可能破坏与哈马斯本已岌岌可危的休战协议。

paras.en: As tanks rolled into central Gaza on Wednesday, residents could be seen carrying blankets and other belongings away from their tents in pictures and video taken shortly after the Israeli military began what it said was an operation targeting a “terror tunnel.”
paras.zh: 周三，当坦克开进加沙中部时，在以色列军方开始所谓的针对“恐怖隧道”的行动后不久拍摄的照片和视频中，可以看到居民从帐篷里搬出毯子和其他物品。

paras.en: Others could be seen rolling away mattresses on carts and pushing loved ones in wheelchairs away from the scene near the Nuseirat camp in central Gaza. At least one person was reported to have been killed in an Israeli airstrike near the raid, Palestinian medics said, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 可以看到其他人将床垫推到推车上，并将坐轮椅的亲人推离加沙中部努塞拉特营地附近的现场。据路透社报道，巴勒斯坦医务人员称，据报道，至少一人在袭击附近的以色列空袭中丧生。

paras.en: “Bullets were fired at us,” Amna al-Gasar, 49, told NBC News after she fled the scene with her young children, her baby in a pink fluffy sweater strapped to her chest. She said her family had received “evacuation orders” from the Israeli military and that tanks had advanced on the area.
paras.zh: “子弹向我们射击，”49 岁的阿姆娜·加萨尔 (Amna al-Gasar) 带着年幼的孩子逃离现场后告诉 NBC 新闻，她的孩子穿着一件粉色毛衣，绑在胸前。她说，她的家人收到了以色列军方的“疏散命令”，坦克已经向该地区推进。

paras.en: “This is the 14th time that we’re getting displaced,” al-Gasar said, who added that she is from Gaza City in the north of the enclave which is now on the side of the “yellow line” occupied by Israeli forces. “Where should we go? We are exhausted. This is not a life,” she said.
paras.zh: 加萨尔说：“这是我们第 14 次流离失所。”她补充说，她来自飞地北部的加沙城，该飞地现在位于以色列军队占领的“黄线”一侧。 “我们该去哪里？我们已经筋疲力尽了。这不是生活，”她说。

paras.en: Muna Abu Shehadeh, 37, said in a separate interview that along with some of her relatives, she left “with nothing but our children — no bedding, no food, and no water.” She added that she had a daughter who was ill, as well as a baby, and that they had to leave behind what few supplies they had.
paras.zh: 37 岁的穆纳·阿布·谢哈德 (Muna Abu Shehadeh) 在另一次采访中表示，她和她的一些亲戚“除了孩子们什么也没带走——没有被褥、没有食物、没有水。”她补充说，她有一个生病的女儿和一个婴儿，他们不得不留下仅有的少量物资。

paras.en: The Israeli military told NBC News the ground operation was the first to be executed beyond the yellow line — the boundary marking the roughly 60% of Gaza that remains occupied by Israeli forces — since the U.S.-brokered ceasefire with Hamas came into effect in October 2025.
paras.zh: 以色列军方告诉 NBC 新闻，自美国斡旋与哈马斯停火于 2025 年 10 月生效以来，这次地面行动是在黄线之外执行的第一次地面行动。黄线标志着仍被以色列军队占领的加沙约 60% 的地区。

paras.en: Separately, in a joint statement with the Israel Security Agency, or Shin Bet, the Israel Defense Forces said the operation was a “targeted” assault aimed at dismantling a tunnel that “posed an immediate and direct threat” to troops.
paras.zh: 另外，以色列国防军在与以色列安全局（Shin Bet）的联合声明中表示，这次行动是一次“有针对性的”攻击，旨在拆除一条对部队“构成直接威胁”的隧道。

paras.en: They said a warning had been issued to civilians in the area prior to the operation, though they did not expand on how exactly warnings were issued and whether they expanded beyond an announcement published online, when asked by NBC News.
paras.zh: 他们表示，在行动之前已向该地区的平民发出了警告，但当 NBC 新闻询问时，他们没有详细说明警告的具体发出方式以及警告是否超出了在网上发布的公告范围。

paras.en: Israeli forces would continue to operate to “remove any immediate threat and thwart attempts” by Hamas to harm Israeli civilians or troops, the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，以色列军队将继续采取行动，“消除任何直接威胁并挫败哈马斯伤害以色列平民或军队的企图”。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the Israeli military said Thursday that the operation west of the yellow line had “ended,” though they could not confirm when exactly the offensive came to a close. Hamas condemned the ground operation, calling it a violation of the ceasefire agreement.
paras.zh: 以色列军方发言人周四表示，黄线以西的行动已经“结束”，但他们无法确认进攻何时结束。哈马斯谴责地面行动，称其违反停火协议。

paras.en: Andreas Krieg, a senior lecturer at King’s College London’s School of Security Studies, said he also believed the incursion was a “clear violation of the fundamental premise of the ceasefire.”
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院安全研究学院高级讲师安德烈亚斯·克里格表示，他还认为这次入侵“明显违反了停火的基本前提”。

paras.en: “Israel agreed to withdraw to the ‘yellow line,’ which was supposed to establish a mutually understood boundary until further withdrawals could be negotiated,” he said Thursday. Sending ground forces a few hundred feet beyond that line and “forcing civilians to flee undermines the agreement,” he added.
paras.zh: 他周四表示：“以色列同意撤退到‘黄线’，这条线本应建立一条相互理解的边界，直到就进一步撤军进行谈判。”他补充说，将地面部队派遣到该线之外数百英尺并“迫使平民逃离破坏了协议”。

paras.en: “Israel cannot simply invoke security concerns whenever it wants to cross a boundary it agreed to respect,” he said, adding that its assertion of a threat had “not been independently substantiated.” The operation risked undermining “any meaning” the yellow line has held as a boundary under the ceasefire agreement, he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“每当以色列想要跨越其同意尊重的边界时，就不能简单地援引安全问题。”他补充说，其威胁的说法“尚未得到独立证实”。他说，这次行动可能会破坏黄线作为停火协议规定的边界的“任何意义”。

paras.en: The Israeli government and military did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the accusation that the ceasefire agreement had been violated.
paras.zh: 以色列政府和军方没有立即回应有关违反停火协议指控的置评请求。

paras.en: The truce has already been marked by regular Israeli strikes, with more than 1,600 people killed in the enclave since the truce began, according to the Palestinian Health Ministry in the territory. Israel says at least five soldiers have been killed within the same amount of time, according to Reuters.
paras.zh: 据该地区巴勒斯坦卫生部称，自停战开始以来，以色列定期发动袭击，导致该飞地内有 1,600 多人死亡。据路透社报道，以色列表示，同一时间内至少有五名士兵被杀。

paras.en: Both Israel and Hamas have repeatedly traded accusations of ceasefire violations.
paras.zh: 以色列和哈马斯都多次相互指责违反停火协议。

paras.en: “Israel has been violating the ceasefire pretty periodically since it came into place, so it’s nothing new on that front,” Rob Geist Pinfold, a lecturer in defense studies at King’s College London, said Thursday of the Israeli military’s ground operation.
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院国防研究讲师罗布·盖斯特·平福德(Rob Geist Pinfold)周四在谈到以色列军方的地面行动时表示：“自停火协议生效以来，以色列经常违反停火协议，因此这方面并不是什么新鲜事。”

paras.en: “It’s the scale of the violation,” he said, adding the ground assault and use of tanks signifying an “escalation” from Israel.
paras.zh: 他说：“这就是侵犯行为的规模。”他补充说，地面袭击和使用坦克标志着以色列的“升级”。

paras.en: Both Pinfold and Krieg noted that the ground operation comes at a time of great political uncertainty for Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces losing his prime ministership after elections last month.
paras.zh: 平福德和克里格都指出，此次地面行动是在本雅明·内塔尼亚胡面临巨大政治不确定性之际进行的，他在上个月的选举后面临失去总理职位的风险。

paras.en: While Netanyahu’s Likud party gained the most votes, President Isaac Herzog tasked his main rival, Gadi Eiskenot, with forming a coalition government based on the premise that he was most likely to succeed in doing so.
paras.zh: 虽然内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团获得最多选票，但总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格责成他的主要竞争对手加迪·艾斯克诺特组建联合政府，前提是他最有可能成功组建联合政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu has railed against the possibility of Israel’s Arab-led parties joining a coalition and both Pinfold and Krieg suggested that he might be seeking to ramp up pressure around security concerns.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡反对以色列阿拉伯领导的政党加入联盟的可能性，平福德和克里格都表示，他可能会寻求围绕安全问题加大压力。

paras.en: Pinfold said Netanyahu was also likely “trying to see how far he can go on the Gaza front,” particularly as the U.S. continues to sideline Israeli involvement in the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 平福德表示，内塔尼亚胡也可能“试图看看他能在加沙前线走多远”，特别是在美国继续回避以色列参与与伊朗的战争的情况下。

paras.en: “I suspect Israel is testing how far it can push the Americans without provoking a serious response,” Krieg said. Israel could also be seeking to “establish a precedent for what amounts to a permanent right of hot pursuit” in Gaza, even beyond its current “yellow line” and even into the future as efforts to advance the peace continue to stall, he added.
paras.zh: 克里格说：“我怀疑以色列正在测试它能在不引起严重反应的情况下将美国人逼到什么程度。”他补充说，以色列还可能寻求在加沙“建立相当于永久紧追权的先例”，甚至超越目前的“黄线”，甚至在推进和平的努力继续陷入停滞的未来。

paras.en: Elsewhere, President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, the body that is overseeing the execution of the U.S.-brokered ceasefire, delivered a bleak report Tuesday on its progress to the United Nations Security Council, warning that the fragile deal was in danger of collapse, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，唐纳德·特朗普总统的和平委员会周二向联合国安理会提交了一份黯淡的进展报告，警告说这项脆弱的协议有破裂的危险。

paras.en: The board said both Israel and Hamas should uphold the commitments made in the agreement, according to Reuters, which obtained a copy of the report. But Hamas’ disarmament and the militant group’s calls for the Israeli military’s withdrawal from Gaza have proven major sticking points in efforts to propel the deal forward.
paras.zh: 据获得该报告副本的路透社报道，该委员会表示，以色列和哈马斯都应恪守协议中的承诺。但哈马斯的解除武装以及该激进组织要求以色列军队从加沙撤军的呼吁已被证明是推动协议进展的主要症结所在。

paras.en: Fleeing from the area of Israel’s ground operation Wednesday, al-Gasar said Palestinians “need a solution.”
paras.zh: 周三逃离以色列地面行动地区的加萨尔表示，巴勒斯坦人“需要一个解决方案”。

paras.en: “All we ask for is safety and security. We’re not asking for a lot,” she said. “All of this talk in the media about advancement in negotiations, but instead we find advancement of tanks.”
paras.zh: “我们所要求的只是安全和保障。我们要求的并不太多，”她说。 “媒体上所有这些都在谈论谈判的进展，但我们却发现了坦克的进步。”

articles.title: The growing factions and fractures behind the Sandpapergate saga
articles.author: Audrey Courty and Simon Smale

paras.en: Eight years after a ball-tampering scandal rocked Australian cricket, Usman Khawaja's bombshell autobiography has reopened old wounds.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球界发生篡球丑闻八年后，乌斯曼·卡瓦贾的爆炸性自传重新揭开了旧伤。

paras.en: During a 2018 Test against South Africa in Cape Town, Cameron Bancroft was caught on camera using sandpaper to roughen one side of the ball in an attempt to generate reverse swing.
paras.zh: 2018 年在开普敦对阵南非的测试赛中，摄像机拍到卡梅伦·班克罗夫特使用砂纸打磨球的一侧，试图产生反向挥杆。

paras.en: A Cricket Australia investigation had found captain Steve Smith, vice-captain David Warner and Bancroft were involved in the scheme, handing them suspensions.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚板球协会的一项调查发现，队长史蒂夫·史密斯、副队长大卫·沃纳和班克罗夫特参与了这一计划，并给予他们停赛处罚。

paras.en: But Khawaja has now challenged that version of events, alleging the practice extended beyond Cape Town and that the wider squad knew what was happening.
paras.zh: 但卡瓦贾现在对这种说法提出了质疑，声称这种做法超出了开普敦的范围，而且更广泛的球队都知道发生了什么。

paras.en: The renewed controversy has prompted Cricket Australia to establish a forum where former players and staff can share their recollections, though emphasising the original investigation would not reopen.
paras.zh: 新的争议促使澳大利亚板球协会建立了一个论坛，前球员和工作人员可以分享他们的回忆，但强调最初的调查不会重新启动。

paras.en: Here's a collection what players and coaches have said — then and now — about the saga that become widely known as Sandpapergate.
paras.zh: 以下是球员和教练在当时和现在对这个被广泛称为“沙纸门”的传奇故事的评价合集。

paras.en: In one chapter of his new autobiography, Sabr, Khawaja provided a detailed account of what he says happened during Australia's 2018 South African tour.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾在新自传《萨布尔》的一章中详细描述了他所说的 2018 年澳大利亚南非之行期间发生的事情。

paras.en: The former batter, who retired this year, alleged sandpaper was used on the ball during the second Test in Port Elizabeth, weeks before Bancroft was caught on camera in Cape Town.
paras.zh: 这位今年退役的前击球手声称，在班克罗夫特在开普敦被摄像机拍到的几周前，在伊丽莎白港举行的第二次测试中，球上使用了砂纸。

paras.en: Khawaja described a discussion before the first Test in Durban, alleging a member of the coaching staff told the team they needed to find a way to make the ball move in the air.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾描述了德班第一次测试之前的一次讨论，声称教练组的一名成员告诉球队，他们需要找到一种方法让球在空中移动。

paras.en: Khawaja described how Bancroft picked up the ball after a break in play during the Port Elizabeth Test and used sandpaper to roughen one side.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾描述了班克罗夫特如何在伊丽莎白港测试中休息后捡起球，并用砂纸将一侧打磨粗糙。

paras.en: He said the ball was then passed around the fielding team, including to him at gully, and that he noticed how dramatically it was reverse-swinging.
paras.zh: 他说，球随后被传给守备队，包括在沟壑处传给他，他注意到球的反向摆动有多么戏剧化。

paras.en: Khawaja recalled one bowler commenting during a huddle:
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾回忆起一位投球手在一次聚会中评论道：

paras.en: "Guys, it's going heaps now. Just don't do anything else to it, because it's silly how much it's going."
paras.zh: “伙计们，现在事情进展得很顺利。不要对它做任何其他事情，因为事情进展得如此之快是很愚蠢的。”

paras.en: He alleged a member of the coaching staff later approached Bancroft during the Cape Town Test and encouraged him to do more of what he had been doing to the ball.
paras.zh: 他声称教练组的一名成员后来在开普敦测试期间找到班克罗夫特，并鼓励他做更多他一直在对球所做的事情。

paras.en: Khawaja said that after Bancroft was caught, he argued with team manager Gavin Dovey that everyone should accept responsibility.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾表示，班克罗夫特被捕后，他与球队经理加文·多维争论，每个人都应该承担责任。

paras.en: "We need to cop this as a team," he wrote.
paras.zh: “我们需要作为一个团队来应对这个问题，”他写道。

paras.en: "We did it as a team, so we cop it as a team."
paras.zh: “我们作为一个团队做到了这一点，所以我们作为一个团队来应对它。”

paras.en: Khawaja said most players agreed when he raised the issue at a subsequent team meeting, but then-captain Tim Paine knew not everyone supported the idea.
paras.zh: 卡瓦贾表示，当他在随后的球队会议上提出这个问题时，大多数球员都同意，但时任队长蒂姆·潘恩知道并不是每个人都支持这个想法。

paras.en: The chapter ends with him saying, "I can only speak for myself, and it's very clear I knew what was going on."
paras.zh: 在这一章的结尾，他说：“我只能代表我自己，很明显我知道发生了什么事。”

paras.en: In a subsequent interview with the ABC's 7.30, Khawaja said he wanted to tell his story and stand by the three players who had been made out to be the only people involved.
paras.zh: 在随后接受美国广播公司 7.30 节目采访时，卡瓦贾表示，他想讲述自己的故事，并支持被认为是唯一涉案人员的三名球员。

paras.en: "It wasn't just them," he told Sarah Ferguson.
paras.zh: “不仅仅是他们，”他告诉莎拉·弗格森。

paras.en: "We were all involved in it as a team, as a squad."
paras.zh: “我们作为一个团队、一个小队都参与其中。”

paras.en: He declined to speculate about whether individual bowlers knew sandpaper was being used.
paras.zh: 他拒绝猜测个别投球手是否知道正在使用砂纸。

paras.en: "Twenty-two pages is what sandpaper is," he said.
paras.zh: “二十二页就像砂纸一样，”他说。

paras.en: "I've tried my best in that to explain my version of events."
paras.zh: “我已尽力解释我对事件的看法。”

paras.en: Warner has strongly endorsed Khawaja's account of how the ball-tampering scheme unfolded.
paras.zh: 华纳强烈支持卡瓦贾对球篡改计划如何展开的描述。

paras.en: "It's 100 per cent accurate what you've said," the former vice-captain said in a social media video.
paras.zh: “你说的百分百准确，”这位前副队长在社交媒体视频中说道。

paras.en: Warner was suspended from domestic and international cricket as a result of the sandpaper plot, and was also permanently barred from leadership positions.
paras.zh: 由于砂纸阴谋，华纳被暂停参加国内和国际板球比赛，并被永久禁止担任领导职务。

paras.en: In the recent social media video, he criticised Cricket Australia's original investigation, describing it as "rushed" and "botched".
paras.zh: 在最近的社交媒体视频中，他批评澳大利亚板球协会最初的调查，称其“仓促”和“拙劣”。

paras.en: In further social media posts, Warner questioned whether the bowlers were properly interviewed, saying he had not been told they had provided statements.
paras.zh: 在进一步的社交媒体帖子中，华纳质疑保龄球手是否接受了适当的采访，称他没有被告知他们提供了声明。

paras.en: "That stinks of a cover-up," he said, though multiple media outlets, including ABC Sport, have reported the bowlers were interviewed by Cricket Australia.
paras.zh: “这有点掩盖事实的味道，”他说，尽管包括美国广播公司体育频道在内的多家媒体报道称，这些保龄球手接受了澳大利亚板球协会的采访。

paras.en: Warner also criticised Cummins after the Australia captain rejected Khawaja's allegations.
paras.zh: 在澳大利亚队长拒绝卡瓦贾的指控后，华纳还批评了康明斯。

paras.en: "I feel the captain today threw Ussie [Khawaja] under the bus and I'm very, very disappointed by that," he said.
paras.zh: “我觉得队长今天把乌西·哈瓦贾扔到了公共汽车下，我对此非常非常失望，”他说。

paras.en: Warner argued that he and the other two sanctioned players were left to carry the consequences without the full circumstances being made public.
paras.zh: 华纳辩称，他和另外两名受制裁的球员必须承担后果，而没有公开全部情况。

paras.en: "We've been served a life punishment," he said.
paras.zh: “我们被判处终身监禁，”他说。

paras.en: "It was a quick one to get it over and done with. Some of the questions were quite challenging in the way it was being planted on us, and we had to move on and just accept responsibility."
paras.zh: “很快就解决了。有些问题对我们来说非常具有挑战性，我们必须继续前进并承担责任。”

paras.en: Australian fast bowler Starc has rejected Khawaja's claim the ball-tampering plot was known by all members of the team.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚快速投球手斯塔克否认了卡瓦贾的说法，即球队所有成员都知道篡改球的阴谋。

paras.en: "I won't speak on behalf of the bowlers, but where I stand, my opinion hasn't changed," Starc said on November 10.
paras.zh: “我不会代表投球手发言，但我的立场是，我的观点没有改变，”斯塔克在 11 月 10 日表示。

paras.en: "We weren't aware anything was taken on the field to be tampered with."
paras.zh: “我们不知道现场有任何东西被篡改。”

paras.en: In 2021, Starc joined fellow bowlers Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Nathan Lyon in releasing a statement disputing any suggestion they had wider knowledge of the scheme.
paras.zh: 2021 年，斯塔克与其他保龄球手康明斯、乔什·黑兹尔伍德和内森·里昂一起发表声明，对任何有关他们对该计划有更广泛了解的说法提出质疑。

paras.en: "We did not know a foreign substance was taken onto the field to alter the condition of the ball until we saw the images on the big screen at Newlands [in Cape Town]," the 2021 statement said.
paras.zh: 2021 年的声明称：“直到我们在开普敦纽兰兹的大屏幕上看到这些图像，我们才知道球场上有异物来改变球的状况。”

paras.en: Starc also said he knew nothing about Khawaja's claim that sandpaper had been used to tamper with the ball in the Test before Cape Town.
paras.zh: 斯塔克还表示，他对卡瓦贾声称在开普敦之前的测试中使用砂纸篡改球的说法一无所知。

paras.en: White-ball captain Mitchell Marsh refused to address key aspects of the scandal at a press conference last week, saying it was not time for him to share his story.
paras.zh: 白球队长米切尔·马什拒绝在上周的新闻发布会上讨论丑闻的关键方面，称现在还不是他分享自己故事的时候。

paras.en: "I respect that others probably haven't, but I have, and I hope that's respected.
paras.zh: “我尊重其他人可能没有做到的，但我做到了，我希望这一点得到尊重。

paras.en: "This is my choice to not go back there. Who knows? Maybe I'll write a book one day."
paras.zh: “我选择不回去。谁知道呢？也许有一天我会写一本书。”

paras.en: Marsh, who played in all four Tests of Australia's 2018 series against South Africa, said he held no grudges against Khawaja.
paras.zh: 马什参加了 2018 年澳大利亚对阵南非系列赛的全部四场测试赛，他表示他对卡瓦贾没有怨恨。

paras.en: "I respect Uzzy for telling his story and for writing his book, and I don't sit here coming from a place of judgement," he said.
paras.zh: “我尊重乌兹讲述他的故事和写他的书，我坐在这里并不是出于评判，”他说。

paras.en: "Everyone's got their story. Some will be willing to share it, and others might not, purely on the basis of the fact that they've moved on.
paras.zh: “每个人都有自己的故事。有些人愿意分享，有些人可能不愿意，纯粹是因为他们已经离开了。

paras.en: "I think it's really important that at some stage we do."
paras.zh: “我认为在某个阶段我们这样做非常重要。”

paras.en: Cummins, who was a key bowler at the time, has strongly rejected suggestions he knew about or helped organise the ball-tampering scheme.
paras.zh: 康明斯当时是一名关键的投球手，他强烈否认他知道或帮助组织篡改球计划的说法。

paras.en: At a lengthy press conference on November 13, the now-Test captain said Khawaja had been "casual" with people's lives and reputations.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 13 日举行的一场冗长的新闻发布会上，现任测试队长表示，卡瓦贾对人们的生活和声誉“漫不经心”。

paras.en: "When he says 'we all knew', if by that he means we knew sandpaper was going out on the field, he's 100 per cent wrong," he said.
paras.zh: “当他说‘我们都知道’时，如果他的意思是我们知道砂纸会出现在球场上，那么他就百分百错了，”他说。

paras.en: "But I think Usman actually says things that are far more serious than that.
paras.zh: “但我认为乌斯曼实际上所说的事情远比这严重得多。

paras.en: "He says that I and others were architects of a scheme to ball tamper with sandpaper; that's complete and utter nonsense."
paras.zh: “他说我和其他人是用砂纸进行球篡改计划的建筑师；这完全是胡说八道。”

paras.en: Cummins said he had consistently maintained for the past eight years that he did not know sandpaper was being used.
paras.zh: 康明斯表示，过去八年他一直坚称自己不知道正在使用砂纸。

paras.en: He also said he did not remember any conversations around the team taking collective responsibility, as Khawaja claimed in his memoir he had pushed for.
paras.zh: 他还表示，他不记得团队中有任何关于承担集体责任的对话，正如卡瓦贾在他的回忆录中所主张的那样。

paras.en: "In his book, Uzzy's been casual with my life and the lives of many others, and I think Australian cricket," he said.
paras.zh: “在他的书中，乌兹对我和其他许多人的生活很随意，我认为是澳大利亚板球，”他说。

paras.en: "I support his right to tell a story. I'm really glad that he feels like he can. But we have to be accountable for the things that we say and do."
paras.zh: “我支持他讲故事的权利。我真的很高兴他觉得自己可以。但我们必须对我们所说和所做的事情负责。”

paras.en: Following Bancroft's latest allegations, Cummins's agent said his position had not changed:
paras.zh: 在班克罗夫特提出最新指控后，康明斯的经纪人表示他的立场没有改变：

paras.en: "Whilst we feel for Cam [Bancroft] and everything he's been through, there's nothing in the statement that hasn't been answered by Pat in his press conference."
paras.zh: “虽然我们对卡姆（班克罗夫特）和他所经历的一切感到同情，但帕特在新闻发布会上对声明中的所有内容都做出了回应。”

paras.en: Sayers, who was part of Australia's 2018 touring squad, has also backed Khawaja's account.
paras.zh: 塞耶斯是 2018 年澳大利亚巡回赛队员之一，他也支持卡瓦贾的说法。

paras.en: Speaking to SEN in a radio interview on Sunday, the one-time Test fast bowler said:
paras.zh: 这位曾经的测试快速投球手在周日接受 SEN 电台采访时表示：

paras.en: "I believe that everyone in that side knew what was going on and what was being used."
paras.zh: “我相信那边的每个人都知道发生了什么以及正在使用什么。”

paras.en: Sayers said there had been discussions about the use of sandpaper to tamper the ball and that he was "neutral in all this".
paras.zh: 塞耶斯表示，曾有过关于使用砂纸篡改球的讨论，他“对这一切持中立态度”。

paras.en: "I'm just trying to tell my side of the story and what I believe happened," he told SEN.
paras.zh: “我只是想讲述我的故事以及我认为发生的事情，”他告诉 SEN。

paras.en: "My recollection isn't as clear as it was obviously eight years ago.
paras.zh: “我的记忆显然不如八年前那么清晰。

paras.en: "I just know that there was numerous conversations of it around in the change rooms."
paras.zh: “我只知道更衣室里有很多关于这件事的谈话。”

paras.en: He added that he was relieved the matter was finally being discussed openly after years of players having to remain silent:
paras.zh: 他补充说，在球员们多年来不得不保持沉默之后，此事终于得到公开讨论，他感到很欣慰：

paras.en: "It's been hard because you obviously got to tip-toe around and not be able to tell the truth."
paras.zh: “这很难，因为你显然必须小心翼翼，却无法说出真相。”

paras.en: Bancroft, who was caught on camera using sandpaper during the Cape Town Test in 2018, has made some of the most significant new allegations.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特在 2018 年开普敦测试期间使用砂纸被摄像机拍到，他提出了一些最重要的新指控。

paras.en: In a lengthy account shared with the media on Wednesday, he said the original public version of events did not reflect what he experienced during the tour.
paras.zh: 在周三与媒体分享的一份长篇报道中，他表示最初的公开版本并未反映他在巡演期间的经历。

paras.en: "It was not just the three of us — Steve Smith, David Warner and I — who knew about me using sandpaper on the ball in South Africa," he writes.
paras.zh: “不仅仅是我们三个人——史蒂夫·史密斯、大卫·沃纳和我——知道我在南非用砂纸打磨球，”他写道。

paras.en: Bancroft said Warner proposed the idea and that he regularly discussed the ball's reverse swing with the bowlers, including Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Josh Hazlewood and Mitchell Marsh.
paras.zh: 班克罗夫特说，华纳提出了这个想法，他定期与投球手讨论球的反向挥杆，其中包括康明斯、米切尔·斯塔克、乔什·黑兹尔伍德和米切尔·马什。

paras.en: "How else am I to know if what I'm doing is effective or not if I don't have these conversations with the bowlers bowling with it and the wicketkeeper?" he writes.
paras.zh: “如果我不与投球的投球手和守门员进行这些对话，我怎么知道我所做的是否有效？”他写道。

paras.en: "All the bowlers gave me feedback if my work on the ball was working. It was helpful."
paras.zh: “如果我的投球工作有效，所有投球手都会给我反馈。这很有帮助。”
